No human subjects, personal data, surveys, or experiments were involved in the preparation of this work.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding received.

detail.abstract: India's MVNO market remains one of the most underdeveloped among major economies. A bold regulatory reset by TRAI-reducing entry fees, streamlining licensing, and leveraging BSNL's underutilised infrastructure-could catalyse a new billion-dollar economy spanning IoT, rural connectivity, and niche digital services.

AI.tldr: 本文指出印度MVNO（移动虚拟网络运营商）市场在主要经济体中仍处于欠发达状态，并建议印度电信监管局（TRAI）通过降低准入门槛、简化许可流程以及利用国有运营商BSNL未充分利用的基础设施等监管改革，来催化一个涵盖物联网、农村连接和利基数字服务的价值数十亿美元的新经济生态。
AI.research_question: 如何通过监管重塑来释放印度MVNO市场的巨大潜力，从而推动物联网、农村连接和利基数字服务领域的新经济增长？
AI.motivation: 印度MVNO市场在主要经济体中发展最为滞后，但若加以适当监管改革，有潜力撬动涵盖多个高增长领域的数字经济。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管经济学、电信市场结构理论、网络基础设施共享理论。
AI.method: 政策分析与行业评述（基于对印度电信监管现状、市场结构和基础设施利用情况的定性分析）。
AI.findings: 1）印度MVNO市场严重欠发达；2）TRAI可通过三大举措（降低准入费、简化许可、利用BSNL闲置基础设施）实现监管重塑；3）改革后有望催化覆盖物联网、农村连接和数字服务的十亿美元级新经济。
AI.theory_contributions: 为电信监管改革与新兴数字经济之间的因果关系提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度电信监管机构（TRAI）提供了具体的政策改革建议，并揭示了MVNO作为增长催化剂在释放农村和物联网市场价值中的作用。

title: Regime-Dependent Basis Attribution in Gold Futures: Why Sign-Flipping is Not Noise

detail.title: Regime-Dependent Basis Attribution in Gold Futures: Why Sign-Flipping is Not Noise

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available market data and does not involve human subjects
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding

detail.abstract: Rolling-window factor models for the gold futures basis exhibit persistent coefficient sign-flipping: the DXY dollar index coefficient is positive in some periods and negative in others, with only 64% sign consistency over a decade. We show this instability is regime-dependent, not noise. Using a dual Hidden Markov Model framework-one classifying market risk conditions (VIX and DXY levels) and another classifying CFTC positioning regimes (commercial-led versus speculator-led)we identify market states in which factor signs become statistically consistent. In the Risk-Off/Commercial-Led regime, VIX sign consistency rises from 59% to 75% (bootstrap 95% CI excludes coin-toss; overlap-adjusted z-test p = 0.046). Critically, F-tests show no evidence that regimes alter mean coefficient magnitudes (p = 0.531), while Brown-Forsythe tests confirm that regimes significantly alter coefficient dispersion (p < 0.001 for both DXY and VIX). The regime effect operates on the temporal distribution of coefficient signs, not on coefficient levels-a second-moment effect that we directly measure, not merely infer. This framework adds interpretive value, informing practitioners when to trust factor attribution, without improving point forecasts.

AI.tldr: 本文发现黄金期货基差的滚动窗口因子模型存在系数符号持续翻转现象（如DXY美元指数系数正负交替，十年间符号一致性仅64%），并证明这种不稳定性并非噪声，而是依赖于市场体制。通过双隐马尔可夫模型（一个分类市场风险状态VIX和DXY，另一个分类CFTC持仓体制），识别出因子符号统计一致的体制区间，并揭示该体制效应作用于系数符号的时间分布（二阶矩效应），而非系数水平（一阶矩）。
AI.research_question: 黄金期货基差滚动窗口因子模型中，因子系数符号为何持续翻转？这种不稳定性是噪声还是体制依赖？其作用机制是影响系数水平还是一阶矩或二阶矩？
AI.motivation: 现有滚动窗口因子模型在黄金基差应用中，系数符号频繁正负交替（如DXY系数仅64%符号一致性），传统观点可能将其视为估计噪声。然而，这种符号翻转可能隐含体制切换信息，影响因子归因的可信度和实践应用价值，亟需系统性解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双隐马尔可夫模型（Dual HMM）：第一层分类市场风险条件（基于VIX和DXY水平），第二层分类CFTC持仓体制（商业主导vs投机者主导）。此外，运用F检验检验体制对系数均值的影响，Brown-Forsythe检验检验体制对系数离散度的影响。
AI.method: 采用双隐马尔可夫模型识别市场体制，通过滚动窗口回归估计因子系数，并利用F检验（检验均值差异）和Brown-Forsythe检验（检验方差差异）区分体制效应是作用于系数的一阶矩（均值）还是二阶矩（离散度/符号分布）。
AI.findings: （1）在风险规避/商业主导体制下，VIX符号一致性从59%提升至75%（bootstrap 95% CI排除随机猜测；z检验p=0.046）；（2）F检验显示体制不改变系数均值（p=0.531）；（3）Brown-Forsythe检验确认体制显著改变系数离散度（DXY和VIX均p<0.001）；（4）体制效应作用于系数符号的时间分布（二阶矩），而非系数水平。该框架提供解释价值，告知实践者何时信任因子归因，但不提高点预测精度。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将滚动窗口因子模型中的系数符号翻转现象系统性地归因为体制依赖的"二阶矩效应"，而非估计噪声或一阶矩变化。提出双隐马尔可夫模型框架，将市场风险条件和持仓结构两类体制分类相结合，为因子不稳定性的来源提供了新解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为黄金基差交易者提供了识别"可信因子归因区间"的方法，帮助实践者判断何时因子符号是统计一致的，从而避免在体制切换时误判因子方向。该框架不提高点预测精度，但增强了因子解释的可靠性。

title: Firm-Level Energy Demand Elasticity in Slovakia: An Empirical Analysis *
affiliations: and Comenius University in Bratislava

detail.title: Firm-Level Energy Demand Elasticity in Slovakia: An Empirical Analysis *
detail.abstract: This paper estimates the energy price elasticity in Slovakia across five broad sectors; industry, agriculture, construction, transportation, and services for the year 2023. To this end, we exploit firm-level balance sheet data from the Register of Financial Statements of the Slovak Ministry of Finance. Using seemingly unrelated regression method, we derive sector-specific own and cross energy price elasticities. Our results indicate substantial heterogeneity across sectors, with construction exhibiting the lowest (own) energy price elasticity and agriculture the highest. Beyond sectoral differences, we examine heterogeneity in energy price elasticity based on firm size level and energy intensity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用斯洛伐克2023年企业层面数据，采用似不相关回归方法估计了五个部门（工业、农业、建筑业、交通运输业、服务业）的能源价格弹性，发现不同部门、企业规模和能源强度之间存在显著的异质性。
AI.research_question: 斯洛伐克各行业的能源价格弹性如何？该弹性在不同行业、企业规模和能源强度之间是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 理解能源价格弹性对于制定有效的能源政策和应对气候变化的措施至关重要，但现有研究缺乏对斯洛伐克2023年最新企业层面数据的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源需求理论；价格弹性理论；企业生产率异质性理论
AI.method: 使用斯洛伐克财政部财务报表登记处的企业层面资产负债表数据，采用似不相关回归（SUR）方法估计各行业的自身和交叉能源价格弹性。
AI.findings: 不同行业的能源价格弹性存在显著异质性，其中建筑业的自身能源价格弹性最低，农业最高。此外，企业规模和能源强度也会影响能源价格弹性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了斯洛伐克2023年企业层面能源价格弹性的最新实证估计，丰富了能源经济学关于价格弹性异质性的文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为斯洛伐克及类似经济体制定差异化能源政策提供了依据，有助于政策制定者根据不同行业、企业规模和能源强度的特点设计更有针对性的能源定价和减排措施。

title: The Economic Epidemiology of Malaria and Economic Growth

detail.title: The Economic Epidemiology of Malaria and Economic Growth
detail.abstract: This paper develops an economic epidemiological model of malaria that integrates utility-maximizing individual decisions about preventive and curative care with aggregate disease dynamics and income growth. The model's core contribution is the endogenization of the susceptible population through individual utility maximization. The model shows how private information, preventive care costs, and productivity losses jointly determine equilibrium disease prevalence. Comparing this framework's predictions with those of classical biological models reveals substantially different macroeconomic effects of malaria. Calibrated to data from sub-Saharan Africa, the model is used to simulate the effects of preventive care subsidies, awareness education, and vector control. The paper characterizes the conditions under which malaria-endemic economies fall into a Neo-Malthusian poverty trap with persistently low productivity growth and demonstrates that integrated policy interventions can substantially reduce endemic prevalence and improve long-run growth outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个整合个体效用最大化决策与宏观疾病动态的经济流行病学模型，揭示了疟疾如何通过个体行为选择形成贫困陷阱，并论证了综合性政策干预能够有效降低疟疾流行率并改善长期经济增长。
AI.research_question: 个体预防和治疗决策如何通过影响易感人群规模，进而决定疟疾的均衡流行率及宏观经济增长？
AI.motivation: 传统生物学模型忽视了微观个体的理性决策行为，无法准确预测疟疾的宏观经济影响及政策效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济流行病学模型（整合效用最大化的个体决策与疾病动态）、内生易感人群机制、新马尔萨斯贫困陷阱理论
AI.method: 理论建模（动态一般均衡框架）、撒哈拉以南非洲数据校准、政策模拟（预防补贴、教育宣传、病媒控制）
AI.findings: (1) 私人信息、预防成本与生产力损失共同决定均衡患病率；(2) 与经典生物学模型相比，疟疾的宏观经济效应存在显著差异；(3) 疟疾流行经济体可能陷入新马尔萨斯贫困陷阱；(4) 综合性政策干预比单一措施更有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将易感人群规模通过个体效用最大化内生化的经济流行病学模型，揭示了微观行为与宏观疾病动态之间的双向反馈机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为疟疾流行地区的政策制定提供了定量分析工具，证明预防补贴、教育宣传和病媒控制的组合干预策略能够有效降低疾病负担并促进长期经济增长。

title: Medical Device Regulation: We Can’t Just Go Back (nor Should We)
affiliations: UC Law, San Francisco

detail.title: Medical Device Regulation: We Can’t Just Go Back (nor Should We)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work involves no patients and no research paticipants.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was funded solely through my salary at UC Law San Francisco.

detail.abstract: For much of the twentieth century, the federal Food and Drug Administration maintained its reputation as the preeminent regulatory agency, renowned for providing vigilant and scientifically rigorous oversight that ensured the safety and effectiveness of drugs and medical devices. But a former FDA commissioner recently lamented that "[t]he FDA as we've known it is finished." Many commentators have raised concerns that reductions in force will leave the Agency understaffed, that these shortages will prolong review times, and that the standards applied to premarket evaluations of medical products will allow unsafe and ineffective products to reach the market. But in the half-century since the modern medical device regulatory regime took effect, critics had already identified many of these same problems. Thus, while the new administration's policies will hobble FDA's ability to fulfill its mission of ensuring safety and effectiveness and of permitting, and even of fostering innovation, simply returning to the old status quo cannot be the goal. Reforming the framework under which FDA regulates medical products and reconstructing the networks of expertise that are currently being shredded will be necessary steps. But we will also need to look beyond FDA for ways to achieve these goals.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了FDA（美国食品药品监督管理局）面临的危机：新政策削弱了其监管能力，但作者指出这些问题在半个世纪前就已存在，简单地回归旧状并非解决之道，需要从根本上改革医疗器械监管框架并重建专家网络。
AI.research_question: 在FDA面临监管能力被削弱的情况下，如何改革医疗器械监管框架以保障安全、有效性和促进创新？
AI.motivation: 一位前FDA局长感叹"我们所知的FDA已经完了"，评论界担忧人员削减导致审评延迟、不合格产品上市，但作者指出这些问题早已存在，因此不能仅回归旧状，需要寻找更深层的改革路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管治理理论、专家网络理论、制度演进理论
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（Normative legal analysis），基于历史回顾和制度批评的定性研究
AI.findings: （1）FDA当前面临的人员削减和审评标准下降问题并非新问题，半个世纪前已有类似批评；（2）新政策确实会削弱FDA保障安全性和有效性的能力；（3）简单地回归旧状不可取，需要根本性改革监管框架并重建专家网络；（4）还需要在FDA之外寻找实现目标的途径。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示制度危机往往源于长期积累的结构性问题，而非单一政策冲击；提出监管改革不能仅回归旧状，需要制度性重构的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为FDA改革提供政策建议：需要重建监管框架和专家网络，同时超越FDA本身寻找解决方案，为医疗器械监管的制度改革指明方向。

title: Strategic Undergrounding: A Benefit-Cost Analysis of Targeted Electric Distribution Conversions in Michigan
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Strategic Undergrounding: A Benefit-Cost Analysis of Targeted Electric Distribution Conversions in Michigan
detail.abstract: This study evaluates the economic viability of converting overhead electric distribution lines to underground in Consumers Energy’s service territory in Michigan in the U.S. The circuit-level benefit-cost analyses incorporate value streams focusing on reliability and resilience improvements and changes to utility system expenditures. The findings reveal that undergrounding can provide substantial net benefits, averaging approximately $300,000 per mile (1 mile = 1.61 km; $186,000 per km) with a benefit-cost ratio of 1.9. While higher capital expenditures drive costs, these are offset by reduced operational and power interruption costs. Two-thirds of total benefits arise from improved reliability and resilience during storm events, avoiding outage impacts and response activities. Over 70% of circuits show net positive returns from undergrounding, though outcomes vary widely. The top 10% of circuits deliver far higher returns, with an average net benefit of $1.5 million per mile and a benefit-cost ratio of 5.3. A targeted program focusing on one-mile projects across the 35 most cost-effective circuits could produce $98 million (95% CI: $34.3M to $211M) in net benefits and achieve a benefit-cost ratio of 8.5 (95% CI: 2.9 to 22)—without incurring utility system net costs. These results suggest that undergrounding can be economically justified when implemented selectively, underscoring the value of a data-driven approach to infrastructure resilience.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了美国密歇根州Consumers Energy公司服务区域内将架空配电线路改为地下电缆的经济可行性。研究发现，地下化改造每英里可带来约30万美元的净收益，效益成本比为1.9，其中三分之二的收益源于风暴期间可靠性和韧性的提升。若对35个最具成本效益的电路实施针对性改造，净收益可达9800万美元，效益成本比高达8.5。
AI.research_question: 在美国密歇根州Consumers Energy公司服务区域内，将架空配电线路地下化改造在经济上是否可行？
AI.motivation: 极端天气事件频发对电力基础设施韧性提出更高要求，但地下化改造成本高昂，需要严谨的经济分析来评估其投资回报，为电力公司和政策制定者提供决策依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本效益分析（Benefit-Cost Analysis），整合了可靠性提升、韧性改善和公用事业系统支出变化等价值流。
AI.method: 基于电路层面的效益成本分析，量化评估可靠性、韧性改善以及公用事业系统支出变化带来的价值。
AI.findings: 地下化改造平均每英里净收益约30万美元（每公里18.6万美元），效益成本比为1.9；三分之二收益来自风暴事件期间的可靠性和韧性改善；超过70%的电路呈现正净回报；对35个最具成本效益电路实施针对性项目，净收益可达9800万美元，效益成本比为8.5。
AI.theory_contributions: 为电力基础设施地下化改造提供了系统的成本效益分析框架，特别强调了在韧性提升方面的量化评估方法，丰富了基础设施韧性投资的经济学分析理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明了地下化改造在选择性实施时具有经济合理性，为电力公司提供了数据驱动的投资决策方法，有助于优化基础设施韧性建设策略，提高公共资源配置效率。

title: Interpretable Physics-Informed Residual Learning for Photovoltaic Power Forecasting: From Accuracy to Diagnostic Insight
affiliations: , ,  and

detail.title: Interpretable Physics-Informed Residual Learning for Photovoltaic Power Forecasting: From Accuracy to Diagnostic Insight
detail.abstract:
Accurate forecasting of photovoltaic power, while still respecting physical laws, plays a central role in today’s energy systems. It matters for grid stability, for market participation, and for the real deployment of digital twins. Purelydata-driven models often look impressive on paper—they reach low numerical errors—but they sometimes miss what truly governs the system. They may predict output at night, misjudge inverter clipping, or forget that heat changes performance.
Small details, yet crucial ones, that make these models unreliable when conditions shift.
To deal with that, our work develops a Physics-Informed Residual Neural Network (PINN-Residual) built upon a hybrid DC model. It combines PVWatts’ linear temperature correction with Huld’s logarithmic refinement for low-irradiance behavior.

Instead of forcing equations directly, the network learns two residual terms—multiplicative (δₐ) and additive (δᵦ)—that describe systematic gaps between the physical baseline and what sensors actually record. During training, a time-adaptive physics loss keeps those corrections from drifting too far, so the learning process stays consistent with the real plant’s dynamics.

When applied to the PVOD v1.0 dataset (stations 00, 04 and 08), the model achieved high numerical accuracy (R² ≈ 0.97–0.99) while improving physical realism and smoothness through time. More interestingly, the residuals themselves carry meaning: δₐ tends to trace gradual module aging, whereas δᵦ mirrors inverter or wiring losses. What begins as a predictor ends up behaving like a diagnostic tool—one that can explain why deviations appear, not just when.

Overall, the study supports physics-oriented residual learning as a dependable and interpretable path for renewable-energy forecasting. It offers an approach that remains practical for operations yet transparent enough to guide future digital-twin developments in photovoltaic plants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种物理信息残差神经网络（PINN-Residual），通过混合DC模型（PVWatts+Huld）结合可学习的乘性和加性残差项，在PVOD v1.0数据集上实现高精度光伏功率预测（R²≈0.97–0.99），同时确保预测符合物理规律，残差项还可作为解释模块老化与逆变器损耗的诊断工具。
AI.research_question: 如何在保证光伏功率预测高精度的同时，确保预测结果符合物理规律（如夜间零出力、逆变器限幅、温度影响等），并提升模型的可解释性和物理真实性？
AI.motivation: 纯数据驱动模型虽然在数值误差上表现良好，但常违反物理定律（如预测夜间出力、忽略温度对性能的影响），导致在工况发生变化时不可靠。需要一种既能保持数值精度又能尊重物理规律的预测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 物理信息残差神经网络（PINN-Residual）；混合DC模型（PVWatts线性温度校正 + Huld低辐照对数修正）；乘性残差δₐ与加性残差δᵦ；时间自适应物理损失函数。
AI.method: 在物理模型基础上，网络学习两个残差项（乘性δₐ和加性δᵦ）来捕捉传感器读数与物理基线之间的系统性偏差。训练过程中引入时间自适应物理损失，防止残差偏离物理约束。
AI.findings: 在PVOD v1.0数据集（站点00、04、08）上，模型R²约达0.97–0.99，具有高数值精度和良好的时域平滑性。残差项具有可解释性：δₐ反映组件逐渐老化，δᵦ反映逆变器或线路损耗。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了物理导向残差学习范式，将物理模型与可学习残差相结合，在保证物理一致性的同时提升预测精度；揭示了残差项可作为诊断工具，不仅预测出力还能解释偏差来源。
AI.practical_contributions: 为光伏电站的数字孪生开发提供了透明且可靠的方法；模型兼具运行实用性和可解释性，可用于设备老化监测与故障诊断；适用于可再生能源预测的高可靠性场景。

title: Price Path Continuity and the Cross-Section of Cryptocurrency Returns

detail.title: Price Path Continuity and the Cross-Section of Cryptocurrency Returns
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the continuity of past price trajectories predicts the cross-section of cryptocurrency returns. The Frog-in-the-Pan hypothesis argues that investors underreact more strongly when information arrives gradually rather than discretely. I extend this logic to cryptocurrency markets, where conventional cash-flow anchors are limited and price movements themselves play a central informational role. To measure the structure of return formation, I construct a short-term Rank-Weighted Price Path Continuity measure (PPC) using daily returns over the prior 14 days and apply it to a broad, survivorship-bias-mitigated cryptocurrency sample from January 2020 to April 2026. Weekly Fama-MacBeth regressions show that short-term past returns are reversal-like on average, but become increasingly predictive of continuation when they are accumulated through smoother, more continuous price paths. The effect is robust across alternative horizons, alternative continuity measures, size-exclusion samples, market states, abnormal-volume environments, and cryptocurrency-policy-uncertainty regimes. Overall, the evidence shows that the path of past returns contains incremental information about delayed price adjustment in cryptocurrency markets, consistent with limited-attention interpretations of the Frog-in-the-Pan hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了价格路径的连续性（而非仅涨跌方向）如何预测加密货币的横截面收益。作者构建了短期秩加权价格路径连续性指标（PPC），发现过去收益在通过更平滑、更连续的路径积累时，会从平均的反转效应转变为持续的动量效应，支持了"温水煮青蛙"假设中有限注意力的解释。
AI.research_question: 过去价格轨迹的连续性是否能够预测加密货币的横截面收益？
AI.motivation: 传统资产定价中，投资者对渐进信息（vs.离散信息）的反应不足更强烈（"温水煮青蛙"假设）。加密货币市场缺乏传统的现金流锚定，价格变动本身承担了核心信息角色，因此这一逻辑可能更为适用。
AI.theoretical_framework: "温水煮青蛙"（Frog-in-the-Pan）假设：投资者对渐进到达的信息反应不足程度强于离散到达的信息；有限注意力理论。
AI.method: 构建短期秩加权价格路径连续性指标（PPC），基于过去14个交易日的日度收益率；采用周度Fama-MacBeth横截面回归；样本为2020年1月至2026年4月的加密货币数据，并缓解了幸存者偏差。
AI.findings: 短期历史收益率平均呈现反转特征，但当收益率通过更平滑、更连续的路径积累时，反而呈现持续的动量效应。该结果在多种稳健性检验（不同窗口期、连续性度量、规模排除样本、市场状态、异常成交量环境、加密货币政策不确定性 regime）下均成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"温水煮青蛙"假设从传统金融市场拓展至加密货币市场，证实了价格路径结构（而非仅收益率符号和大小）包含关于延迟价格调整的增量信息。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币交易策略提供了新的预测因子（PPC），有助于投资者识别和利用渐进信息下的价格持续调整现象。

title: The Economic Burden of Violence against Women & Children in Canada: A Comprehensive Costing Study
affiliations: University of Toronto, University of Toronto - Institute of Health Policy, Management, and Evaluation, University of Toronto, University of Toronto, University of Toronto, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - David Geffen School of Medicine and University of Galway

detail.title: The Economic Burden of Violence against Women & Children in Canada: A Comprehensive Costing Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No competing interests to declare.
declarations.funderStatement: Funding from Fondation Botnar, Institute for Gender and the Economy (Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto), The Black Research Network (University of Toronto) and the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada (CRC#) supported this research.

detail.abstract:
Background: Violence against women (VAW) and violence against children (VAC) carry profound physical, emotional, and economic consequences. Yet the full economic burden has not been comprehensively characterised. This study assesses the economic burden of VAC and VAW in Canada.

Methods: We conducted a multi-method, population-based economic assessment for children under 15 and women 15-75 years, guided by an adapted costing framework. Costing captured individual, public system, and macroeconomic perspectives over annual and lifetime horizons, using the 2018 Survey on Safety in Public and Private Spaces and administrative data. Analyses incorporated healthcare utilisation, productivity losses, labour market impacts, attributable health outcomes. Costs are in 2024 Canadian dollars.

Findings: The annual economic burden of VAC was $51.2 billion ($31.7-$57.6 billion), driven by future earnings losses ($43.2 billion) and child protection expenditures ($8.0 billion). For VAW, the annual burden was $6.2 billion ($4.5-$7.4 billion), borne by individuals ($4.5 billion) and by public systems ($1.7 billion) and macroeconomic losses reached $0.6 billion. Combined, the economic burden of VAC and VAW exceeds $58 billion, equivalent to 2.4% of GDP and approximately 88.1% of federal health expenditures. Lifetime health-related costs (VAC: $22.6 billion; VAW: $25.2 billion) were dominated by mental health conditions.

Interpretation: This is the first integrated Canadian estimate of the economic burden of VAC and VAW, demonstrating that violence is a public health and economic crisis. Findings support urgent investment in prevention, early intervention, trauma-informed care, and cross-sectoral policy responses. Our framework is transferable for monitoring progress and evaluating policy reform.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次综合评估了加拿大针对儿童暴力（VAC）和针对女性暴力（VAW）的经济负担，发现两者合计年经济负担超过580亿加元，占GDP的2.4%，相当于联邦卫生支出的88.1%。其中VAC年负担约512亿加元，VAW年负担约62亿加元，主要由未来收入损失、精神健康问题和儿童保护支出驱动。
AI.research_question: 加拿大针对儿童暴力和针对女性暴力的全面经济负担是多少？
AI.motivation: 暴力对女性和儿童的身心及经济后果深远，但尚缺乏对其全面经济负担的综合量化评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 适应性成本核算框架（adapted costing framework），涵盖个人、公共系统和宏观经济三个视角，以及年度和终身两个时间维度。
AI.method: 多方法、基于人群的经济评估，使用2018年公共和私人空间安全调查数据及行政数据，纳入医疗保健利用、生产力损失、劳动力市场影响和可归因健康结果等分析。
AI.findings: VAC年经济负担512亿加元（主要来自未来收入损失432亿加元和儿童保护支出80亿加元）；VAW年经济负担62亿加元（个人承担45亿加元，公共系统17亿加元，宏观损失6亿加元）；两者合计超580亿加元，占GDP的2.4%；终身健康相关成本中精神健康问题占主导。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供加拿大VAC和VAW经济负担的综合估计，证明暴力是一场公共卫生和经济危机，并建立了可转移的评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 支持紧急投资于预防、早期干预、创伤知情护理和跨部门政策响应；框架可用于监测进展和评估政策改革。

AI.theoretical_framework: 经济压力理论、经济依赖理论、流动性冲击与家庭暴力关系理论。
AI.method: 基于抽象信息，具体方法不详，可能涉及准自然实验或面板数据分析等因果推断方法。
AI.findings: 抽象不完整，具体发现需进一步阅读全文。
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济冲击与婚内暴力和求助行为联系起来，拓展了IPV的经济决定因素理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者在经济危机期间预防和应对家庭暴力提供实证依据，指导援助资源配置。

title: From Technologist to Business Architect: The CIO's Evolving Role as Enterprise AI Strategist and Governance Leader

detail.title: From Technologist to Business Architect: The CIO's Evolving Role as Enterprise AI Strategist and Governance Leader

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could influence this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research is a conceptual governance architecture analysis utilizing aggregate industry surveys and open protocol documentation.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Corporate hierarchies rarely reconfigure themselves overnight, yet the Chief Information Officer role has undergone precisely that kind of abrupt structural upheaval. Four independent industry surveys conducted between late 2024 and early 2026 (Foundry/CIO.com, n=1,156; Deloitte, n=622; Gartner, n=3,186; McKinsey, n=632) converge on a striking portrait: 65% of CIOs now report directly to the CEO, 36% carry profit-and-loss accountability, and 80% spearhead enterprise AI evaluation. Grounding these practitioner findings in upper echelons theory, strategic alignment theory, and established IT governance frameworks, this paper documents the metamorphosis and contends that governing autonomous AI agents constitutes the CIO's most consequential emerging obligation. We scrutinize the security vulnerabilities that the Model Context Protocol (MCP) introduces into enterprise architectures, marshaling evidence that 80% of organizations have encountered hazardous AI agent behaviors and that 41.7% of audited MCP deployments harbor exploitable weaknesses. We then propose ContextGuard, a zero-trust governance architecture purpose-built for AI context protocol security, and advance three falsifiable research propositions linking CIO strategic positioning, zerotrust governance maturity, and organizational AI value realization.

AI.tldr: 本文基于四项大规模行业调查（总样本量超5,500人），揭示了CIO角色在2024-2026年间发生的结构性剧变：65%直接向CEO汇报、36%承担盈亏责任、80%主导企业AI评估。在此基础上，论文认为治理自主AI代理已成为CIO最重要的新兴职责，重点分析了Model Context Protocol（MCP）引入的安全漏洞，并提出了一套零信任治理架构ContextGuard，最终提出三个可检验的研究命题。
AI.research_question: CIO角色在2024-2026年间经历了怎样的结构性变革？AI代理治理（尤其是MCP协议安全）如何成为CIO的新核心职责？零信任治理架构如何应对这一挑战？
AI.motivation: 企业层级结构通常变化缓慢，但CIO角色在极短时间内经历了罕见的结构性剧变，这一现象缺乏理论解释和系统性实证研究。同时，AI代理在企业中的广泛部署带来了新的安全治理挑战，亟需理论与实践相结合的治理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 上层梯队理论（Upper Echelons Theory）、战略对齐理论（Strategic Alignment Theory）、IT治理框架
AI.method: 四项独立行业调查（Foundry/CIO.com, n=1,156; Deloitte, n=622; Gartner, n=3,186; McKinsey, n=632）的实证数据分析，结合安全审计与架构设计。
AI.findings: 65%的CIO直接向CEO汇报；36%承担盈亏责任；80%主导企业AI评估；80%的企业遇到过危险的AI代理行为；41.7%的MCP部署存在可利用的安全漏洞。
AI.theory_contributions: 将上层梯队理论与战略对齐理论延伸至AI治理情境，提出了CIO角色剧变的理论解释框架；构建了零信任AI代理治理的理论基础；提出了三个可检验的研究命题，为后续实证研究提供方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了ContextGuard零信任治理架构，为企业应对MCP协议安全威胁提供了可操作的解决方案；揭示了CIO角色转型的关键趋势，为企业董事会和高管层的CIO定位与职责设计提供决策依据；提供了AI代理治理的实践指南。

title: Artificial Intelligence in International Trade Logistics: Opportunities and Risks
affiliations: , Nakhchivan State University, Nakhchivan State University, Nakhchivan State University and Nakhchivan State University

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence in International Trade Logistics: Opportunities and Risks
detail.abstract: This study examines the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in international trade logistics, focusing on its opportunities and associated risks. The research highlights how AI-driven systems are transforming global supply chain management through automation, predictive analytics, and decision-support systems. At the same time, it explores potential challenges such as cybersecurity risks, labor displacement, and technological inequality. Using a qualitative analytical approach based on secondary data, the study demonstrates that AI significantly enhances efficiency, transparency, and sustainability in international logistics systems. However, effective governance and regulatory frameworks are required to mitigate emerging risks and ensure balanced development.

AI.tldr: 本文研究人工智能在国际贸易物流中的作用，发现AI通过自动化、预测分析和决策支持系统显著提升了物流效率、透明度和可持续性，但也带来了网络安全、劳动力替代和技术不平等等风险，需要有效的治理和监管框架来平衡发展。
AI.research_question: 人工智能在国际贸易物流中的作用是什么？它带来了哪些机遇和风险？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在全球供应链中的广泛应用，亟需系统性地评估其对国际贸易物流的正面影响和潜在风险，为政策制定者提供参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI驱动的自动化、预测分析和决策支持系统理论，结合国际贸易物流与供应链管理理论。
AI.method: 定性分析方法，基于二手数据（secondary data）进行分析。
AI.findings: AI显著提升了国际物流的效率、透明度和可持续性；但同时存在网络安全风险、劳动力替代问题和技术不平等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地整合了AI技术在国际物流中的机遇与风险，构建了AI驱动物流变革的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供了AI物流应用的利弊评估，强调了建立有效治理和监管框架的必要性，以趋利避害。

title: The Walls That Go Nowhere: Enclosure, Landscape, and the Long Memory of the Commons
affiliations: Dignity Alliance Massachusetts

detail.title: The Walls That Go Nowhere: Enclosure, Landscape, and the Long Memory of the Commons

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No financial relationship
declarations.ethicsApproval: no consents needed
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: This essay argues that the concept of enclosure—the conversion of shared commons into private property—provides the most analytically precise frame for understanding a series of structural transformations that are typically treated as separate phenomena: the British parliamentary enclosures of the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, the Irish plantation system and its famine consequences, the Campanian masseria system and southern Italian emigration, the corporate capture of the internet commons, the enclosure of human creative and intellectual output in proprietary AI training data, and the emerging contest over renewable energy infrastructure. Drawing on the theoretical frameworks of E.P. Thompson, Karl Polanyi, Amartya Sen, Shoshana Zuboff, and Peter Linebaugh, and grounded in the author’s direct engagement with the landscapes of Ireland, Campania, and rural Massachusetts, the essay contends that enclosure is not a historical episode but a recurrent structural mechanism through which capital creates the conditions for accumulation by destroying the commons that previously sustained communities. The essay concludes by locating the care economy—the irreducibly relational work of sustaining human life across generations—as both the ultimate target of extractive enclosure and the most durable site of resistance to it.

AI.tldr: 本文论证"圈地"（将公共资源转化为私有财产）并非历史事件，而是一种反复出现的结构性机制。资本通过摧毁维持社区生存的公共资源，为积累创造条件。从18世纪英国议会圈地到爱尔兰种植园制度，从互联网公共资源的企业化到人工智能训练数据的私有化，再到可再生能源基础设施的争夺，这一机制始终在运作。文章最终将关怀经济定位为圈地运动的核心目标与最持久的抵抗阵地。
AI.research_question: "圈地"作为一种结构性机制，如何在不同的历史时期和社会领域中反复出现并发挥作用？关怀经济如何成为对抗这种结构性机制的核心场域？
AI.motivation: 作者观察到多个通常被分开处理的现象（英国圈地运动、爱尔兰饥荒、意大利移民、互联网私有化、AI训练数据圈地、可再生能源争夺）实际上共享同一逻辑，因此需要一个统一的分析框架来揭示其深层结构性特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: E.P. Thompson的道德经济学、Karl Polanyi的"嵌入"与"脱嵌"理论、Amartya Sen的能力方法、Shoshana Zuboff的监视资本主义、Peter Linebaugh的 commons 理论。
AI.method: 理论综合与比较历史分析，结合作者在爱尔兰、坎帕尼亚和马萨诸塞州农村的实地参与式观察。
AI.findings: 圈地不是一次性历史事件，而是资本积累的反复结构性机制；圈地不仅涉及土地，还包括数字公共资源、人类创造力和知识产权；关怀经济（代际间维持生命的不可化约的关系性劳动）既是圈地的最新目标，也是抵抗圈地的最持久阵地。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"圈地"概念从特定历史事件提升为跨历史、跨领域的结构性分析范畴，整合了政治经济学、生态学、数字技术批判和关怀伦理等多个理论脉络。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当今AI训练数据私有化、互联网平台垄断和可再生能源基础设施争夺等当代议题提供了历史纵深和理论武器，并指出关怀经济作为抵抗实践的核心场域。

title: The Mobility Ceiling: How Institutional Ranks Actually Move in Indian Higher Education, 2020–2025
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Mobility Ceiling: How Institutional Ranks Actually Move in Indian Higher Education, 2020–2025
detail.abstract: Indian higher-education institutions routinely set ranking ambitions — "top 50 in three years," "break into the top 100" — that assume a fluidity the data does not support. Using a six-year panel of ranked institutions across twelve NIRF disciplines (2020–2025; 3,282 year-over-year transitions), this paper characterises the actual dynamics of rank movement. It documents a pronounced mobility ceiling: 62% of institutions move five positions or fewer in a year, 81% move ten or fewer, and only 3.0% move more than 25 positions. Beneath this lies steep score compression — the total-score gap between adjacent ranks is roughly thirteen times larger at the top of a list than near the bottom — so the marginal effort to advance one place rises sharply with rank. Apparent cross-discipline volatility inverts depending on measurement: the deepest lists look most turbulent by raw positions, but the smallest disciplines are most volatile once cohort size is accounted for. Year-over-year movement is multifactorial, tracking faculty-capacity indicators most strongly in professional and teaching-led disciplines and research-output indicators most strongly in research-led ones, with no single indicator dominant. Movement into and out of the ranked lists is shown to be driven largely by administrative resizing of those lists rather than by competitive displacement. The findings reframe institutional strategy: advancement rewards precision over volume of effort, and the binding constraints on movement are structural.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度NIRF 2020-2025年12个学科的3282次院校排名变动数据，发现排名存在明显的"流动性天花板"：62%的院校年度变动不超过5位，仅3%变动超过25位。排名顶部与底部的分数差距约13倍，导致越靠前进步难度越大。排名的进出主要由榜单行政规模调整驱动，而非竞争性替代。研究结论认为，院校排名提升战略应注重精准而非投入规模，结构性约束是主要限制因素。
AI.research_question: 印度高等教育机构的排名变动具有怎样的实际动态特征？排名流动性的结构性约束是什么？
AI.motivation: 印度高等教育机构常设定不合实际的排名目标（如"三年内进入前50"），但这些目标假设排名具有高度流动性，而数据并不支持这一假设。本文旨在揭示排名变动的真实格局，为院校战略制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 排名流动性理论、分数压缩效应、结构性约束理论
AI.method: 基于NIRF 2020-2025年12个学科的3282次年对年排名变动数据，采用描述性统计、分数差距分析、跨学科波动性比较、多因素回归分析等方法。
AI.findings: ①62%院校年度变动≤5位，81%≤10位，仅3%变动>25位，存在显著的"流动性天花板"；②排名顶部与底部相邻院校的分数差距相差约13倍，分数严重压缩，越靠前边际努力需求越高；③表面上的跨学科波动性因测量方式而异——长榜单按原始位置看波动最大，但考虑队列规模后小规模学科波动最大；④排名变动受多因素影响，专业型/教学型学科中教师能力指标影响最大，研究型学科中研究产出指标影响最大，无单一主导因素；⑤排名进出主要由榜单行政规模调整驱动，而非竞争性替代。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"流动性天花板"概念，揭示了排名系统中结构性约束的存在；区分了表面波动与真实波动（考虑队列规模后的波动）；阐明了排名进出机制的真实驱动力是行政调整而非竞争。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度高等教育机构提供排名提升战略指导：进步需要精准而非投入规模，需认识到结构性约束的存在，避免设定不切实际的排名目标。

title: From Financial Access to Financial Resilience: The Behavioral Financial Inclusion Gap
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Financial Access to Financial Resilience: The Behavioral Financial Inclusion Gap
detail.abstract: Formal access to financial services does not always translate into practices that strengthen resilience under economic stress. This paper investigates whether this disconnect is associated with weaker financial resilience by introducing the Behavioral Financial Inclusion Gap (BFIG), defined as the discrepancy between formal access and effective financial behavior. Using worldwide individual-level Global Findex microdata, we construct a score-based BFIG and an MCA-based alternative for robustness. We then examine its association with three complementary dimensions of resilience: the ability to sustain household expenses after an income shock, the use of savings as the main emergency coping mechanism, and the capacity to mobilize emergency funds from any substantive source. The empirical strategy combines binary logit models with a predictive extension using regularized logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost to assess whether the relationship remains stable under more flexible specifications. Across all models, evidence reveals a consistent pattern: a wider BFIG is associated with weaker resilience. The relationship is strongest for savings-based coping and coping capacity, indicating that incomplete behavioral inclusion affects not only whether households can respond to shocks, but also the quality and breadth of the resources they can mobilize. The predictive results reinforce this conclusion by showing that the BFIG remains relevant along with broader socioeconomic and digital-access characteristics. In general, the findings suggest that financial inclusion should be judged not only by formal access, but also by the degree to which that access is translated into effective financial behavior that improves resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"行为性金融包容差距"（BFIG）概念，即正规金融准入与实际金融行为之间的差距，并利用全球Findex微观数据证明：BFIG越大，家庭在面对经济冲击时的韧性越弱，尤其是在储蓄应对和应急资金调动能力方面。
AI.research_question: 正规金融服务准入未能转化为增强经济韧性实践的这一脱节现象，是否与较弱的金融韧性相关？具体而言，行为性金融包容差距（BFIG）与家庭经济韧性之间是否存在负向关联？
AI.motivation: 尽管全球金融包容性取得了显著进展，但仅有准入并不足以确保家庭在经济压力下具备韧性。现有研究较少关注"准入-行为"之间的差距及其对韧性的影响，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为性金融包容差距（BFIG）：正规金融服务准入与有效金融行为之间的差距；金融韧性三维度：收入冲击后维持家庭开支的能力、将储蓄作为主要应急机制的能力、从实质性来源调动应急资金的能力。
AI.method: 利用全球Findex个体层面微观数据，构建基于评分法的BFIG指标及基于MCA的稳健性替代指标；采用二元Logit模型进行基准回归，并运用正则化逻辑回归、随机森林和XGBoost进行预测拓展以检验稳健性。
AI.findings: 所有模型均显示一致模式：BFIG越大，韧性越弱；该关系在储蓄应对和应急资金调动能力维度上最为显著；在考虑更广泛的社会经济和数字接入特征后，BFIG仍保持预测相关性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并操作化了"行为性金融包容差距"这一新概念，将金融包容性研究从"准入导向"拓展为"行为导向"；揭示了金融行为不完全转化对韧性不同维度的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议政策制定者不应仅以金融准入作为衡量金融包容性的标准，而应关注准入是否转化为改善韧性的有效金融行为，为设计和评估金融包容政策提供了新的参考维度。

title: Europe Needs a Strategy to Close the Artificial Intelligence Compute Gap
affiliations: Bruegel and Tilburg Law and Economics Center (TILEC)

detail.title: Europe Needs a Strategy to Close the Artificial Intelligence Compute Gap
detail.abstract: The race to dominate artificial intelligence is to a large extent a race for compute, or processing power. Advanced AI systems require vast quantities of specialised chips able to run the calculations that train and operate large models. Whoever controls that infrastructure shapes the technology and sets the economic and strategic terms on which others access it.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能领域的竞争本质上是算力（计算能力）的竞争。先进的AI系统需要大量专用芯片来训练和运行大型模型，而控制这一基础设施的一方将主导技术发展方向，并决定他人获取该技术的经济和战略条件。
AI.research_question: 人工智能竞争的核心要素是什么？算力控制权如何影响技术发展、经济格局和战略态势？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术的快速发展，理解算力这一核心资源如何塑造产业竞争格局和权力分配具有重要的理论和现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施权力理论、技术-经济范式理论、战略资源依赖理论
AI.method: 概念性分析/理论论述（基于对AI产业现状和趋势的分析）
AI.findings: 算力是AI竞争的关键瓶颈，控制专用芯片（如GPU）等算力基础设施的实体将获得对技术发展路径、经济回报和战略优势的主导权。
AI.theory_contributions: 将算力视为AI时代的核心战略资源，揭示了基础设施控制权与技术权力之间的深层关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了关于AI算力供应链安全、自主可控以及国际竞争格局的战略启示。

title: Child Labor and Forced Work in the Cocoa Agroindustrial Supply Chain:: Certification Gaps, Traceability Deficits, and the Strategic Role of the United States in Building Ethical Sourcing Standards
affiliations: Universidad ECOTEC (Ecuador)

detail.title: Child Labor and Forced Work in the Cocoa Agroindustrial Supply Chain:: Certification Gaps, Traceability Deficits, and the Strategic Role of the United States in Building Ethical Sourcing Standards
detail.abstract: The global cocoa supply chain, which underlies a USD 130 billion chocolate industry, remains structurally exposed to child labor and forced labor, particularly in West African producing regions that account for approximately 70% of world cocoa output. Despite decades of voluntary industry commitments and the proliferation of third-party certification schemes-including Fairtrade, Rainforest Alliance, and UTZ-independent audits and investigative reports consistently document persistent labor violations affecting an estimated 1.56 million children in cocoa farming households in Ghana and Côte d'Ivoire alone (U.S. Department of Labor, 2022). This paper argues that existing certification frameworks suffer from three systemic deficiencies: (1) limited farmlevel traceability due to fragmented smallholder structures; (2) auditability gaps arising from multi-tier supply chains with opaque intermediary networks; and (3) insufficient integration with mandatory regulatory frameworks at the import level. Against this background, the United States Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act (UFLPA, 2021) and the broader HRDD (Human Rights Due Diligence) regulatory trend signal an imminent shift toward enforceable traceability requirements. This paper proposes an integrated model combining digital traceability technologies, farm-level registration systems, and policy-aligned certification standards as a viable pathway to close the current governance gap. The author draws on 18 years of direct operational experience in cocoa agroindustrial supply chains, logistics systems, and international trade compliance to identify actionable interventions that are technically feasible, economically viable, and strategically aligned with U.S. import policy objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文指出全球可可供应链中的第三方认证体系存在可追溯性、可审计性和政策整合三大缺陷，提出结合数字追溯技术、农场注册系统和政策对齐标准的综合模式，以应对童工和强迫劳动问题。
AI.research_question: 现有的第三方认证体系为何无法有效消除全球可可供应链中的童工和强迫劳动问题？如何构建一个更有效的治理框架？
AI.motivation: 尽管可可行业存在大量自愿承诺和第三方认证，但西非产区的劳工违规问题持续存在，约156万儿童受影响，现有认证框架存在系统性缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链治理理论、认证体系有效性理论、人权尽职调查（HRDD）监管框架
AI.method: 基于作者18年可可农工供应链、物流系统和国际贸易合规的直接运营经验，结合现有审计报告和调查证据进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 现有认证体系存在三大缺陷：1) 碎片化小农结构导致农场级可追溯性有限；2) 多层供应链和不透明中间商网络造成可审计性缺口；3) 与进口国强制性监管框架整合不足。美国UFLPA及HRDD监管趋势预示着向可强制执行的可追溯性要求转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了第三方认证在复杂供应链中治理失灵的机制性原因，提出了数字技术、登记制度与政策标准三位一体的整合治理模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了技术上可行、经济上可承受且与美国进口政策目标一致的具体干预措施，为可可行业合规和政府监管提供了可操作路径。

title: Anticipatory Responses to U.S. EV Mandates and Global Energy Markets
affiliations: and University of Abuja, Abuja, Nigeria

detail.title: Anticipatory Responses to U.S. EV Mandates and Global Energy Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise. AI-assisted tools were used solely for code debugging and computational formatting support. All core research design, model specifications, analysis, and writing were independently executed by the author, who accepts full responsibility for the manuscript’s integrity.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses secondary, de-identified state-level administrative and energy data obtained from publicly available federal sources, including the U.S. Energy Information Administration, Bureau of Economic Analysis, Bureau of Labor Statistics, and Federal Highway Administration. No direct interaction with human subjects occurred; therefore, institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors received no specific funding for this work.

detail.abstract: Energy transition economics asks whether credible climate policy can reduce petroleum dependence before regulations become legally binding. This paper examines anticipatory responses to California's Advanced Clean Cars II (ACC II) regulation, adopted across 14 U.S. states during 2022-2023, with binding requirements beginning only in model years 2026-2027. Using a staggered difference-indifferences design on a balanced panel of 51 states from 2016 to 2023, we find no significant average anticipatory effect on electric vehicle adoption overall. However, later-adopting states exhibit a 3.9% increase in electric vehicle stock, consistent with a policy credibility mechanism. We calibrate the estimated policy effects into a GTAP-E-Power framework to evaluate global welfare and energy-security implications. Credible electric vehicle mandates reduce petroleum dependence and redistribute welfare primarily through terms-of-trade adjustments, operating through the same transmission channels as major oil supply disruptions, but in the opposite direction. The findings have direct implications for energy security policy in petroleum-importing economies seeking to reduce geopolitical exposure to global fossil fuel supply chains.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了加州ACC II法规的可信度如何影响各州的电动汽车采用和全球能源转型，发现后期采纳州的电动汽车存量增加3.9%，并通过GTAP-E-Power模型揭示了可信的电动车政策通过贸易条件渠道减少石油依赖并重新分配福利。
AI.research_question: 可信的气候政策能否在法律约束力生效之前就减少石油依赖？
AI.motivation: 能源转型经济学关注气候政策的可信度是否能在法规正式生效前就引发预期反应，从而提前减少石油依赖。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策可信度机制；贸易条件调整理论
AI.method: 使用交错双重差分法（Staggered DiD），基于2016-2023年51个州的平衡面板数据，结合GTAP-E-Power全球可计算一般均衡模型进行福利和能源安全评估。
AI.findings: 总体来看，ACC II法规对电动车采用没有显著的平均预期效应；但后期采纳州显示出3.9%的电动车存量增长。可信的电动车政策通过贸易条件渠道减少石油依赖，其传导渠道与主要石油供应冲击方向相反。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政策可信度在能源转型中的关键作用，证明了预期效应可以通过贸易条件渠道影响全球福利分配，丰富了能源转型经济学和气候政策可信度理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为石油进口经济体减少对全球化石燃料供应链的地缘政治依赖提供了能源安全政策启示，表明可信的电动车政策可以提前产生实质性影响。

title: Pakistan's National Jurisprudence: A Strategic Framework for Graduate-Entry Legal Education through Open and Distance Learning
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Pakistan's National Jurisprudence: A Strategic Framework for Graduate-Entry Legal Education through Open and Distance Learning

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a policy proposal based on publicly available data and does not involve human subjects or participants. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. Conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Pakistan's LLB is the only degree in the country's higher education system whose content is inherently, irreversibly national, built entirely from Pakistan's own Constitution, statutes, jurisprudence, and legal framework. Yet Pakistan currently accepts a foreign law degree, specifically the University of London's Graduate Entry LLB teaching English law, for professional legal practice, while offering no equivalent domestic graduate entry pathway for its own most qualified professional graduates. This proposal presents a research-based, data-supported, institutionally grounded case for the introduction of a Graduate Entry LLB through Open and Distance Learning, designed for holders of recognized professional bachelor's degrees, deliverable through existing national infrastructure, and priced at a rate proportionally fair to Pakistan's income level. It requires no new institutions, no new legislation, and no new public expenditure. It requires one policy decision.

AI.tldr: 巴基斯坦目前接受英国伦敦大学的外国法学学位用于执业，却未为本国最优秀的专业毕业生提供同等的研究生入学渠道。本文提出通过开放远程学习方式引入研究生入学法学学士项目，利用现有国家基础设施，按巴基斯坦收入水平公平定价，无需新机构、新立法或新增公共支出，仅需一项政策决策。
AI.research_question: 巴基斯坦为何应引入本国研究生入学法学学士项目，以及如何通过开放远程学习实现该路径？
AI.motivation: 巴基斯坦法学教育存在结构性矛盾：本国法学学士（LLB）内容完全基于国内法律体系，却接受外国法学学位（如伦敦大学英国法LLB）用于执业，同时未为本国最优秀的专业毕业生提供同等研究生入学渠道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法学教育本土化理论、开放远程教育理论、教育公平与准入理论
AI.method: 基于研究、数据支持和制度分析的方法，提出将现有基础设施用于开放远程学习（ODL）的研究生入学法学学士方案。
AI.findings: 引入研究生入学法学学士（通过开放远程学习）无需新机构、新立法或新增公共支出，仅需一项政策决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 为法学教育本土化与开放远程教育的结合提供了制度设计范例，丰富了教育公平理论在专业教育领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为巴基斯坦政策制定者提供了一条低成本、高可行性的法学教育改革路径，解决外国法学学位替代本国路径的不合理现状。

title: Islamic Bankers’ Niyyah Toward Green Sukuk for Attaining Sustainable Finance: Evidence from Bangladesh
affiliations: , United International University and United International University

detail.title: Islamic Bankers’ Niyyah Toward Green Sukuk for Attaining Sustainable Finance: Evidence from Bangladesh

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Conflicts of Interest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Institutional Review Board Statement: Ethical review and approval were waived for this study, since this study involved adult participants only and did not include any clinical procedures, interventions, or vulnerable populations. No personally identifiable information was collected, and all responses were recorded anonymously and used solely for academic research purposes. United International University (UIU), Bangladesh, does not require formal ethical approval from an Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Ethics Committee for anonymous, minimal-risk, questionnaire-based research of this nature. Accordingly, formal ethical approval was waived. All ethical principles regarding confidentiality, anonymity, and the right to withdraw were strictly observed.
declarations.funderStatement: Funding: The article was funded by the Institute for Advanced Research (IAR) Publication Grant of United International University, Ref. No.: IAR-2025-Pub-114.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the factors associated with niyyah (worshipful intention) of Islamic bankers toward issuing green sukuk (G-sukuk) investment instruments. In particular, it analyses how bankers' empathy, moral and ethical responsibilities, and self-efficacy are related with environmental awareness, perceived social support, and green tech innovation, respectively. These factors then predicted bankers' niyyah toward issuing G-sukuk. The present research employed the theory of bounded rational planned behavior as its theoretical foundation. Data were collected from 390 bankers employed in different Islamic banks. Random sampling technique was employed for this cross-sectional study and for analyzing data, this study applied structural equation modeling. Findings indicate that all predictors are statistically significant and positively associated with bankers' niyyah toward G-sukuk for ensuring sustainable finance. Furthermore, G-sukuk initiatives can help to lower the carbon emissions and other harmful substances, which would improve overall environmental sustainability and ecological contexts related to SDG-13. There is limited empirical evidence available on the G-sukuk perspective in Bangladesh. This study will provide practical insights for the bankers and policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于有限理性计划行为理论，调查了伊斯兰银行家发行绿色伊斯兰债券（G-sukuk）的意愿（niyyah）影响因素，发现同理心、道德伦理责任、自我效能感等通过环境意识、社会支持和绿色技术创新等中介变量显著正向影响银行家的意愿，有助于促进可持续金融和减少碳排放。
AI.research_question: 伊斯兰银行家发行绿色伊斯兰债券（G-sukuk）的意愿（niyyah）受哪些因素影响？
AI.motivation: 绿色伊斯兰债券（G-sukuk）在孟加拉国的实证研究有限，本研究旨在填补这一空白，探索银行家发行G-sukuk意愿的驱动因素，以促进可持续金融和实现SDG-13气候目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有限理性计划行为理论（Theory of Bounded Rational Planned Behavior）
AI.method: 横截面问卷调查，采用随机抽样技术，从不同伊斯兰银行收集390名银行家数据，运用结构方程模型（SEM）进行分析。
AI.findings: 所有预测变量（同理心、道德伦理责任、自我效能感分别通过环境意识、社会支持、绿色技术创新）均与银行家发行G-sukuk的意愿显著正相关；G-sukuk有助于降低碳排放和其他有害物质，改善环境可持续性，促进SDG-13目标的实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将有限理性计划行为理论拓展至绿色伊斯兰金融领域，验证了心理、道德和社会因素在银行家绿色投资决策中的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊斯兰银行家制定绿色金融产品发行策略提供依据；为政策制定者推动G-sukuk市场发展、实现可持续发展目标提供实践洞察。

title: When Strong Enforcement Backfires: Breach Inducement and Contractual Governance
affiliations: Tsinghua University - School of Economics & Management, Advanced Institute of Business, Tongji University and Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business

detail.title: When Strong Enforcement Backfires: Breach Inducement and Contractual Governance
detail.abstract: Firms commonly rely on fixed-price, fixed-quantity contracts to coordinate exchange, but uncertainty often renders these ex-ante commitments inefficient and prompts renegotiation. Renegotiation improves adaptability, but it also creates incentives for breach inducement: costly actions by one party that increase the counterparty's performance cost and improve the inducing party's ex-post bargaining position. We develop a buyer-seller model with two opposing ex-ante investments: the seller makes relationship-specific cost-reducing investment that increases trading surplus, while the buyer may undertake breach inducement, an opportunistic investment that distorts renegotiation incentives. We find three key results: (1) Expectation damages (ED), with flexible contract terms (high quantity and low price), align incentives, induce efficient investment, and suppress inducement (i.e., first-best outcome). (2) Specific performance (SP) can fail to achieve the first-best, especially when the seller's cost-reduction technology is sufficiently more scale sensitive than the buyer's inducement technology. In this regime, strong enforcement backfires because the contract point becomes a valuable renegotiation lever that encourages opportunistic inducement. (3) When contract terms are constrained and neither ED nor SP is generally first-best, liquidated damages (LD) serve as a hybrid governance instrument. LD is equivalent to SP when its stipulated fallback 1 is triggered in all states, but away from such extreme branches, its state-dependent fallback can mitigate inducement relative to SP. The comparison between LD and ED further depends on the renegotiation sharing rule: ED performs better when the buyer internalizes more of the surplus-reduction effect of inducement, whereas LD can perform better when the seller's bargaining share is sufficiently large. These findings help reconcile the theoretical appeal of strong enforcement with the practical prevalence of ED and LD, and they provide a remedy-selection framework for contracts that must balance investment protection, adaptation, and opportunism. The paper contributes to contractual governance by showing how breach remedies shape not only ex-post dispute resolution, but also ex-ante incentives in interfirm relationships.

AI.tldr: 本文研究固定价格-固定数量合同在不确定性下的再谈判问题，构建了买方卖方的双边投资模型（卖方成本降低投资 vs 买方违约诱导机会主义投资），分析了预期损害赔偿（ED）、特定履行（SP）和约定损害赔偿（LD）三种违约救济方式对事前投资激励和事后效率的影响，发现ED在灵活条款下可实现最优，SP在特定条件下会适得其反，LD作为混合治理工具可在中间地带发挥作用。
AI.research_question: 不同违约救济方式（预期损害赔偿、特定履行、约定损害赔偿）如何影响合同关系中卖方的事前成本降低投资和买方的事前违约诱导机会主义行为，以及如何实现效率最优？
AI.motivation: 现实中企业普遍采用固定价格-固定数量合同，但不确定性使事前承诺失效而需要再谈判。再谈判虽提高适应性，但也滋生违约诱导（breach inducement）这一机会主义行为，即一方通过增加对方履约成本来改善自身谈判地位。现有文献缺乏对这一双边投资冲突的系统分析，且理论上强力执行（特定履行）的吸引力与实际中预期损害赔偿和约定损害赔偿的广泛使用之间存在张力，需要理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 买方-卖方双边投资模型：卖方进行关系专用性成本降低投资（增加交易剩余），买方可能进行违约诱导投资（机会主义行为，扭曲再谈判激励）。以不完全合同理论和再谈判理论为基础，分析不同违约救济规则（ED、SP、LD）下的投资激励和效率结果。
AI.method: 理论建模（博弈论模型），通过比较不同违约救济规则下的均衡投资水平和效率结果，进行福利分析。
AI.findings: (1) 预期损害赔偿（ED）+灵活合同条款（高数量、低价格）可对齐激励、实现最优投资并抑制违约诱导，达到最优效率；(2) 特定履行（SP）在某些条件下（卖方成本降低技术比买方诱导技术更具规模敏感性）无法实现最优，强力执行反而因合同点成为有价值的再谈判杠杆而鼓励机会主义；(3) 当合同条款受限时，约定损害赔偿（LD）作为混合治理工具，其状态依赖的违约选项可在中间地带缓解违约诱导，与ED的比较取决于再谈判剩余分配规则。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 揭示了违约救济不仅影响事后争议解决，还塑造事前投资激励，将合同法规则与组织间关系治理联系起来；(2) 解释了为何强力执行（SP）理论上吸引人但实践中ED和LD更普遍；(3) 为需要在投资保护、适应性和机会主义防范之间平衡的合同提供了救济方式选择的框架；(4) 引入了违约诱导这一被忽视的机会主义行为，丰富了不完全合同理论。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为企业设计合同条款（特别是违约救济条款）提供了理论指导，帮助在灵活条款与约束条款之间做出权衡；(2) 解释了为何实践中预期损害赔偿和约定损害赔偿被广泛采用，而非理论上更具吸引力的特定履行；(3) 为管理者提供了在不同技术条件（成本降低技术的规模敏感性）下选择合适违约救济的决策框架。

title: When Oil Narratives Become Bank Risk

detail.title: When Oil Narratives Become Bank Risk
detail.abstract: Oil-market news can signal very different risks for banks exposed to oil-producing regions. This paper studies how newspaper-based oil narratives are associated with U.S. bank balance sheets. Supply-disruption narratives predict higher cumulative loan-loss provisions and net charge-offs, lower loan growth, lower deposit growth, and weaker short-run profitability among more oil-exposed banks. Demand-salience narratives move in the opposite direction, predicting stronger lending, deposit growth, and profitability, while provisions and charge-offs decline. These findings show that oil narratives do not have one banking effect: some oil stories become bank risk, while others coincide with expansion in oil-exposed banking markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于新闻的石油叙事如何影响美国银行资产负债表，发现供应中断叙事对石油敞口较大的银行预示着更高的贷款损失准备金、净核销率下降、贷款和存款增长放缓以及短期盈利能力减弱，而需求凸显叙事则呈现相反效应，表明石油叙事并非只有单一的银行效应。
AI.research_question: 石油市场新闻如何通过不同的叙事类型（供应中断叙事 vs. 需求凸显叙事）影响美国银行的资产负债表表现？
AI.motivation: 石油新闻可能向石油产区银行传递非常不同的风险信号，但以往研究未区分石油叙事的异质性效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 石油叙事类型（供应侧 vs. 需求侧）对银行风险的差异化传导机制。
AI.method: 基于报纸叙事分析的实证研究，结合银行资产负债表数据。
AI.findings: 供应中断叙事与石油敞口较大的银行的贷款损失准备金、净核销率上升、贷款和存款增长下降、短期盈利能力减弱相关；需求凸显叙事则与贷款、存款增长和盈利能力增强相关，准备金和核销率下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了石油叙事并非具有单一的银行效应，不同类型的石油叙事（供应侧 vs. 需求侧）对银行产生截然不同的经济后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助银行和监管机构理解石油新闻的异质性风险信号，从而更精准地进行风险管理和政策应对。

title: Capturing The Value of Community Fuel Poverty Alleviation
affiliations: University of Sussex - Science and Technology Policy Research Unit (SPRU), University of Bristol and University of Bristol

detail.title: Capturing The Value of Community Fuel Poverty Alleviation
detail.abstract: This report summarises the findings of the ‘Capturing the value of community energy’ business collaboration project. We pursued a three-pronged approach to the data analysis. Firstly, we tried to establish comparability among the quantitative datasets to compare their approach, outreach and success in tackling fuel poverty. Secondly, we calculated the Social Return on Investment (SROI) using one specific dataset from 2018/19. Thirdly, we analysed the qualitative data to gain a deeper understanding of links between organisational approaches, fuel poverty alleviation interventions, data capture and management, and the funding environment. Due to complicated and highly variable reporting procedures it was only possible to establish comparable datasets on a few metrics which reflect requirements set by funders. The SROI calculation revealed that community fuel poverty alleviation efforts undertaken by the analysed companies has a SROI of 9-10:1 for every £1 invested. The qualitative analysis revealed the systematic underreporting of such value as funders’ targets are narrowly defined around numbers rather than genuinely lifting people out of fuel poverty. This report concludes with some recommendations to improve the operational environment for community fuel poverty alleviation services, especially given their invaluable efforts in reaching out to some of the most  vulnerable members of our communities.

AI.tldr: 本报告通过定量比较、社会投资回报率（SROI）计算和定性分析三种方法，评估社区能源企业在缓解燃料贫困方面的价值。研究发现，尽管报告程序复杂且缺乏可比性，但社区燃料贫困缓解工作的SROI高达9-10:1，且存在系统性价值低估问题。
AI.research_question: 社区能源企业如何创造并量化其在缓解燃料贫困方面的价值？现有的报告和资助体系是否充分捕捉了这一价值？
AI.motivation: 社区能源企业在缓解燃料贫困方面发挥着重要作用，但其价值往往被低估。资助者的目标定义过于狭隘（仅关注数字而非真正帮助人们摆脱燃料贫困），导致这些努力的系统性价值被低估，因此需要全面评估其社会回报。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会投资回报率（SROI）理论；燃料贫困缓解的社会价值评估框架
AI.method: 三管齐下的数据分析方法：1）建立定量数据集的可比性，比较不同企业在缓解燃料贫困方面的策略、覆盖范围和成功程度；2）使用2018/19年的特定数据集计算社会投资回报率（SROI）；3）定性数据分析，深入理解组织方法、干预措施、数据管理与资助环境之间的联系。
AI.findings: 1）由于报告程序复杂且高度可变，仅能在少数反映资助者要求的指标上建立可比数据集；2）社区燃料贫困缓解工作的SROI为9-10:1（每投资1英镑获得9-10英镑的社会价值）；3）定性分析揭示了系统性的价值低估问题，因为资助者的目标狭隘地围绕数字而非真正帮助人们摆脱燃料贫困。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了社区能源企业在缓解燃料贫困方面的社会投资回报率量化证据，并指出当前资助体系导致的价值低估问题，为SROI在社区能源领域的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改善社区燃料贫困缓解服务的运营环境提供了具体建议，强调这些服务在接触最脆弱社区成员方面的宝贵作用，并呼吁资助者重新定义绩效指标以更全面地捕捉社会价值。

title: Common Revisions, Relative Positions, and the Micro–Macro Wedge
affiliations: University of Auckland

detail.title: Common Revisions, Relative Positions, and the Micro–Macro Wedge
detail.abstract: Forecast-error-on-revision regressions have shaped a benchmark view of survey expectations: consensus forecasts appear to underreact to news, while individual forecasts appear to overreact. Using updated and aligned Survey of Professional Forecasters samples, I first show that this benchmark contrast is not stable across variables, horizons, and sample windows. I then show that the standard individual coefficient is a composite object: it places one slope on total individual revisions, which combine movements shared by forecasters with changes in forecasters' positions relative to the consensus. Decomposing these revisions shows that the shared component is the part of the individual regression with the usual consensus-style sign interpretation, varying across samples and macro episodes. The relativeposition component is more stable and negative, but it captures how relative forecast changes map into final relative forecasts, not an identified response to a particular information set. The weight on these components is the share of individual-revision variance accounted for by common movements. The individual coefficient is therefore a useful reduced-form statistic, but not a standalone test of behavioral bias.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，基于预测误差对修正量回归的基准观点（共识预测反应不足、个体预测反应过度）并不稳健，并揭示了标准个体系数实际上是一个复合指标，包含共享成分和相对位置成分，不能单独作为行为偏差的检验。
AI.research_question: 预测误差对修正量回归中，共识预测与个体预测行为（反应不足 vs. 反应过度）的基准对比是否稳健？个体系数的构成及其含义是什么？
AI.motivation: 已有文献基于预测误差对修正量的回归形成了基准观点：共识预测反应不足，个体预测反应过度。但这一对比是否稳定尚不清楚，且个体系数的构成机制未被充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预测误差对修正量的回归框架；共识预测与个体预测的偏差分析；复合系数分解（共享成分与相对位置成分）。
AI.method: 使用更新且对齐的SPF（专业预测者调查）样本数据，进行回归分析，并分解个体系数中的共享成分与相对位置成分。
AI.findings: （1）基准对比在不同变量、预测期限和样本窗口下不稳定；（2）标准个体系数是复合对象：对总体个体修正量有一个斜率，该修正量结合了预测者共有的变动和预测者相对于共识的位置变化；（3）共享成分具有类似共识系数的符号解释，且随样本和宏观时期变化；（4）相对位置成分更稳定且为负，但反映的是相对预测变化如何映射到最终相对预测，而非对特定信息集的识别反应；（5）个体系数的权重取决于共同变动在个体修正方差中的占比。因此，个体系数是有用的简化统计量，但不能单独检验行为偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了个体预测误差对修正量回归系数的复合性质，澄清了该系数不能独立作为行为偏差检验的理论基础，为理解预测行为提供了更细致的分解框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒研究者和政策制定者在使用预测误差对修正量回归结果时需谨慎，不能仅凭个体系数判断行为偏差，应结合成分分解进行更全面的分析。

reference: FRB of Chicago Working Paper No. 2026-11
title: The Inefficient Markets Hypothesis: A Theory of Casino Capitalism
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago

detail.title: The Inefficient Markets Hypothesis: A Theory of Casino Capitalism

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Chicago Working Paper No. 2026-11
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: I develop a general equilibrium model of investment and equity markets in which departures from the Efficient Markets Hypothesis generate "Casino Capitalism": time-inconsistent, short-termist firm decisions, firm-level over-investment coupled with inefficient liquidation of positive-NPV projects, and aggregate under-investment with depressed stock prices and distorted intertemporal savings. These distortions arise even if all agents are fully rational and forward-looking. At the firm level, the wedge between market-implied and fundamental returns on investment causes an endogenous preference reversal that renders the Laissez-faire outcome time-inconsistent and Pareto-inferior. In the aggregate, firm-level attempts to boost stock prices are self-defeating via an aggregate investment wedge as micro distortions translate into macro inefficiency. Restoring firm-level rationality by empowering shareholders can worsen aggregate outcomes and precipitate a complete capital market shutdown.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个一般均衡模型，证明即使在完全理性且前瞻的假设下，金融市场偏离有效市场假说也会导致"赌场资本主义"——企业短视、过度投资与无效清算并存、总量投资不足，且微观扭曲会转化为宏观无效率。
AI.research_question: 当金融市场偏离有效市场假说时，企业投资决策与股票市场均衡会出现何种系统性偏差？这些微观层面的扭曲如何转化为宏观层面的无效率？
AI.motivation: 传统金融理论认为完全理性代理人市场能够实现有效配置，但现实中普遍存在企业短视、过度投资、股价波动等现象。本文试图在一般均衡框架下，用"理性"行为解释这些看似"非理性"的市场现象，揭示市场的内生缺陷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡模型；Efficient Markets Hypothesis（有效市场假说）偏离；时间不一致性（time-inconsistency）；内生偏好逆转（endogenous preference reversal）；投资楔子（investment wedge）
AI.method: 理论建模：构建包含投资和股票市场的一般均衡模型，假设所有代理人完全理性且前瞻，引入市场预期与基本面之间的楔子，分析企业层面的投资决策和总量层面的均衡结果。
AI.findings: （1）市场隐含回报与基本面回报之间的楔子导致企业内生偏好逆转，使自由放任结果时间不一致且帕累托低效；（2）企业层面出现过度投资与正NPV项目无效清算并存；（3）总量层面投资不足、股价低迷、跨期储蓄扭曲；（4）企业提升股价的个体行为通过总量投资楔子自我挫败；（5）赋予股东权力以恢复企业理性反而会恶化总量结果，甚至导致资本市场完全关闭。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）证明了即使所有代理人完全理性，金融市场自身仍会产生系统性无效率，挑战了有效市场假说的理论前提；（2）揭示了微观层面"理性"行为（如迎合市场预期）通过一般均衡反馈机制转化为宏观无效率的内生机制；（3）发现了"赋予股东权力以纠正企业短视"这一传统治理方案可能适得其反的理论悖论。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为理解"赌场资本主义"现象（企业短视、股价泡沫、投资波动）提供了系统性的理论框架；（2）警示政策制定者：强化股东权利等微观治理改革可能加剧而非缓解宏观金融不稳定；（3）为金融监管（如抑制市场过度投机）提供了理论依据——市场失灵不需要非理性假设即可成立。

title: No-Questions-Asked, On-Chain: Deposit Disintermediation as a Moneyness Phase Transition

detail.title: No-Questions-Asked, On-Chain: Deposit Disintermediation as a Moneyness Phase Transition

keywords: Interest-Rate Risk in the Banking Book (IRRBB)

detail.abstract: Bank deposits are money because they are information-insensitive: they pass at par without the holder investigating the issuer, a property insurance and supervision confer. Tokenised money, whether bank-issued tokenised deposits or non-bank stablecoins, pursues the same property through verifiable reserves and at-par on-chain redemption. We place both in a logit (maximum-entropy) deposit-demand system with a salience threshold and a network complementarity in the outside option, and let banks price deposits optimally. The outside share obeys a mean-field self-consistency equation whose susceptibility diverges when responsiveness times coupling reaches βg = 4; beyond that the bare transition is first-order and hysteretic, but optimal defence holds the calibrated bank on a low plateau, so the migration is a latent threat rather than a realised run. The deposit beta is regime-dependent (flat on the rate floor, then full pass-through as banks defend), so defence caps outflow while turning the franchise into a zeroduration claim. Calibrated to Japan, corporate transactional deposits sit above the boundary and retail a sticky core. A core-deposit model fitted to the zero-rate era assigns the franchise a constant low beta and a long duration, so it books a large economic-value gain from rising rates and treats it as a rate hedge; this overstates the franchise's value (about 3.5-fold in the defended case) and credits a duration it lacks, leaving the bank under-hedged. The mis-measurement needs only the salience floor, with the coordination pulling lift-off into the supervisory shock window; where defence is imperfect it can instead turn the overstatement into an outright loss, of a size the historical beta cannot pin since the run-regime pass-through is out of sample. The robust message is that the transactional layer's rate risk is systematically mis-measured.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个带有显著性阈值和网络互补性的logit存款需求系统，分析银行发行的代币化存款与非银行稳定币如何在信息不敏感条件下运行。校准日本数据发现，传统核心存款模型高估了活期存款的特许权价值约3.5倍，并错误赋予了其久期，导致银行利率风险被系统性错估。
AI.research_question: 代币化存款和稳定币如何在信息不敏感条件下运作？传统核心存款模型对存款利率风险的度量是否存在系统性偏差？
AI.motivation: 银行活期存款具有信息不敏感属性（无需调查发行方即可按面值流通），保险与监管赋予这一属性。代币化存款与非银行稳定币通过可验证储备和链上按面值赎回追求同样的属性。传统核心存款模型可能错误度量了存款的利率风险暴露。
AI.theoretical_framework: logit（最大熵）存款需求系统，包含显著性阈值（salience threshold）和外部选项的网络互补性；银行最优化定价；平均场自洽方程；存款贝塔（pass-through）的分体制分析。
AI.method: 理论建模+日本数据校准。构建具有显著性阈值和网络互补性的logit存款需求模型，推导平均场自洽方程，分析相变与滞后现象；将模型校准至日本银行数据，比较传统核心存款模型与本文模型的估值差异。
AI.findings: （1）外部份额的磁化率在响应系数×耦合强度βg=4时发散，越过该点发生一级相变和滞后；（2）最优防御使校准银行处于低平台，存款迁移是潜在威胁而非实际挤兑；（3）存款贝塔具有体制依赖性（利率下限区平坦，银行防御区完全传导）；（4）传统核心存款模型高估捍卫状态下存款特许权价值约3.5倍，错误赋予其长久期；（5）该错估仅需显著性阈值即可产生，协调效应将利率上升推入监管冲击窗口。
AI.theory_contributions: 将统计物理中的平均场自洽方程与相变理论引入银行存款需求分析；提出存款贝塔体制依赖性与显著性阈值机制；揭示传统核心存款模型在利率风险度量上的系统性缺陷。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理层和监管机构提供更准确的存款利率风险度量框架；指出传统模型高估银行利率对冲能力，导致银行实际面临更大的利率风险；为代币化存款和稳定币的监管设计提供理论依据。

reference: Working Paper of the Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance No.2026-06
title: China's Rare Earth Policy: Prosperity Maximization or Great Power Geoeconomics?
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance

detail.title: China's Rare Earth Policy: Prosperity Maximization or Great Power Geoeconomics?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Working Paper of the Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance No.2026-06
publicationDetails.journalName: Max Planck Institute for Tax Law & Public Finance Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: An industrial economics analysis of China’s quasi-monopoly on refined rare earth materials shows: even if China strictly maximizes national prosperity and abstains from geopolitical power play, a significant price differential emerges between the export price and the price for domestic users. The price differential itself is not evidence of geopolitical intentions. However, this equilibrium price gap widens if we assume that China views itself as contesting in a geopolitical, tournament-like situation against the United States. These two results are derived within the framework of a tournament model that imbeds the characteristics of a dominant supplier with a fringe - market, but adds geopolitical goals to the dominant supplier’s objective.

AI.tldr: 本文通过产业经济学模型分析了中国在精炼稀土材料领域的准垄断地位，发现在纯粹追求国家经济繁荣（无地缘政治意图）的情况下，已存在显著的国内外价差；若加入中美地缘政治竞争考量，该价差将进一步扩大。
AI.research_question: 中国对精炼稀土材料的准垄断如何导致出口价格与国内价格之间的差异？地缘政治竞争是否会扩大这一价差？
AI.motivation: 澄清稀土出口价差是否必然反映地缘政治意图，并将地缘政治竞争纳入产业经济学的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 锦标赛模型（tournament model），结合主导供应商+边缘市场的产业结构，并加入地缘政治目标作为主导供应商的额外目标函数。
AI.method: 产业经济学模型分析（锦标赛模型理论推导）。
AI.findings: (1) 即便中国严格追求国家繁荣最大化且不涉及地缘政治博弈，出口与国内价格之间已存在显著价差；(2) 若加入中美地缘政治竞争（锦标赛式竞争）假设，该均衡价差将进一步扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 将地缘政治竞争纳入主导供应商的定价模型，扩展了产业经济学中关于准垄断定价与价格歧视的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国稀土出口政策及国际定价差异提供了非地缘政治意图的解释，同时警示地缘政治竞争会加剧市场扭曲。

reference: Working Paper of the Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance No. 2026-07
title: The Strategic Effect of Weak Team Members in Dynamic Conflicts between Teams
affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance

detail.title: The Strategic Effect of Weak Team Members in Dynamic Conflicts between Teams

publicationDetails.detailsText: Working Paper of the Max Planck Institute for Tax Law and Public Finance No. 2026-07
publicationDetails.journalName: Max Planck Institute for Tax Law & Public Finance Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Why do strong players allow weak players to join their team, even though weak players are notorious for free riding? This paper shows that the dynamic structure of a tug-of-war is suitable for mobilizing efforts by weak players and making the team to become stronger and to succeed. The strategic role of weak players emerges if the dynamics for the team develop unfavorably for the team. If the team falls behind, a discouragement effect sets in for the strong player. The player is inclined to throw the towel. This alarms the weak player. The player hoped to be able to free-ride and gain an expected windfall payoff. This payoff is lost if the strong player gives up. At that point the weak player actively seeks to motivate the strong player to perform at its best.

AI.tldr: 本文通过拔河博弈的动态模型，解释了为什么强手会容忍弱手加入团队——当团队落后时，强手会产生气馁效应并想放弃，此时弱手为保住自己搭便车的预期收益，反而会主动激励强手继续努力，从而增强团队整体竞争力。
AI.research_question: 为什么强手允许弱手加入团队，尽管弱手以"搭便车"著称？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为弱手会搭便车、损害团队效率，但现实中强手常允许弱手加入。作者试图从动态博弈角度解释这一看似矛盾的现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拔河博弈（Tug-of-War）动态结构、气馁效应（Discouragement Effect）、搭便车（Free-Riding）理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与博弈论分析。
AI.findings: 当团队落后时，强手会产生气馁效应，倾向于放弃；弱手原本期望搭便车获得收益，但若强手放弃则预期收益归零，因此弱手会转而主动激励强手继续努力，这一机制使整体团队变得更强并更可能成功。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了弱手在动态博弈中的战略价值，修正了传统上仅将弱手视为负资产的静态观点；提出了"气馁效应触发弱手激励"的新机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为团队组建与资源配置提供新视角：弱手在特定动态条件下可以发挥正向激励作用，管理者不应一味排斥弱手，而应理解其战略价值。

title: Luxury for All: A Macroeconomic Theory of Public Provision
affiliations: and Paris School of Economics (PSE)

detail.title: Luxury for All: A Macroeconomic Theory of Public Provision
detail.abstract: Public in-kind provision of education, healthcare, or cultural amenities accounts for a large share of government spending, even though redistribution can be achieved with cash transfers and externalities addressed with subsidies. We propose a new macroeconomic theory of in-kind provision, grounded in two features: (i) these goods are luxuries, with consumption rising more than proportionally with income; and (ii) they generate externalities that depend not only on the total level of consumption but also on its distribution across households. In a tractable heterogeneous-agent model, we show that these features make direct in-kind provision welfare-improving, even when cash transfers and subsidies are available. Using household- and country-level data, we document that most publicly provided goods exhibit both features. We then apply the framework to the design of fiscal consolidation, showing in a calibrated model that optimal consolidation falls primarily on goods without private substitutes, while preserving in-kind provision of goods with private substitutes. Finally, we develop a welfare-based imputation method for in-kind benefits, to provide a more accurate assessment of the distributional impact of government spending.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的宏观经济学理论，解释为何政府应通过实物提供（而非现金转移或补贴）来提供教育、医疗等奢侈品性质的公共服务。理论基于两个特征：这些商品是奢侈品（消费随收入增长比例更高），且其外部性不仅取决于消费总量，还取决于消费的分布。模型和实证分析表明，即使存在现金转移和补贴工具，实物提供也能提升福利。
AI.research_question: 为什么政府要通过实物提供（in-kind provision）而非现金转移或补贴来提供教育、医疗和文化设施等公共服务？这些实物提供的福利效应如何？
AI.motivation: 尽管理论上再分配可用现金转移实现、外部性可用补贴解决，但现实中政府大量支出仍用于实物提供公共服务。现有理论无法充分解释这一现象，本文试图构建新的宏观经济理论来解释并指导最优政策设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两个核心特征构建异质性代理人模型：（1）这些商品是奢侈品，消费随收入增长的比例更高；（2）这些商品产生的外部性不仅取决于总消费水平，还取决于消费在家庭间的分布。
AI.method: 理论建模（异质性代理人模型）、跨国和家庭层面数据实证分析、校准模型进行财政整顿政策模拟、开发基于福利的实物福利归因方法。
AI.findings: （1）奢侈品特征和分布依赖型外部性使得实物提供比现金转移和补贴更能提升福利；（2）多数公共提供商品确实兼具这两个特征；（3）最优财政整顿应主要削减无私人替代品的公共品，而保留有私人替代品的公共品；（4）开发的福利归因方法能更准确评估政府支出的分配效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将奢侈品行属性和分布依赖型外部性纳入统一的宏观理论框架，解释了实物提供的存在合理性，拓展了最优财政政策和公共经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府财政整顿方案设计提供理论指导（应优先削减无替代品的公共品）；提出更准确的实物福利归因方法，有助于更科学评估政府支出的分配效应和制定再分配政策。

title: Task-Specific Technical Change and Comparative Advantage
affiliations: Stanford University and Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF) - Centre de Recerca en Economia Internacional (CREI)

detail.title: Task-Specific Technical Change and Comparative Advantage
detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence (AI) reshapes workers’ comparative advantage by altering the tasks they perform and the skills those tasks require. We develop a dynamic task-based model to quantify the general-equilibrium effects of task-specific technical change. Workers have multidimensional skills, choose occupations, and accumulate skills on the job; occupations combine tasks, and productivity depends on how workers’ skills match task requirements. We develop a computationally efficient procedure to estimate the model using panel data and a new database of task-level skill requirements. We apply the model to AI, allowing it to augment, automate, and simplify tasks. We find that AI narrows wage inequality and raises average wages across scenarios ranging from slow to rapid AI progress. The key equalizing force is simplification: by lowering tasks’ skill requirements, AI lets lower-skill workers compete for previously inaccessible jobs. Adoption costs, highest for lower-skill workers, dampen but do not eliminate the decline in inequality.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建动态任务模型，利用面板数据和任务级技能需求数据库，量化分析AI对劳动力市场的总体均衡效应，发现AI通过简化任务降低技能门槛，缩小工资不平等并提高平均工资。
AI.research_question: AI如何通过改变任务和技能需求重塑工人的比较优势，进而对工资不平等和平均工资产生总体均衡影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对AI的劳动力市场影响缺乏基于任务层面的动态总体均衡量化分析，尤其是AI同时具备增强、自动化和简化任务的多种功能，其综合效应尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态任务模型：工人具有多维技能，选择职业并在工作中积累技能；职业由多项任务组合而成，生产率取决于工人技能与任务需求的匹配程度。
AI.method: 1）构建动态任务型总体均衡模型；2）利用面板数据和任务级技能需求数据库；3）开发计算高效的估计程序；4）模拟AI增强、自动化、简化任务三种作用机制。
AI.findings: 1）AI缩小了工资不平等并提高了平均工资；2）关键均等化机制是任务简化——降低技能门槛使低技能工人能够竞争此前无法进入的工作；3）采用成本（对低技能工人最高）会削弱但不消除不平等下降效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将多维技能、职业选择、在职技能积累纳入动态任务框架；2）区分AI的增强、自动化和简化三种任务级技术变革机制；3）揭示任务简化是降低不平等的关键渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者理解AI对劳动力市场不平等的影响提供量化依据；2）提示降低AI采用成本、特别是针对低技能工人的培训支持有助于发挥AI的公平化效应。

title: To Combine or Not? Consolidating Horizontal Acquisitions in Multi-sided Market
affiliations: Stevens Institute of Technology

detail.title: To Combine or Not? Consolidating Horizontal Acquisitions in Multi-sided Market
detail.abstract: When a parent company acquires a horizontal competitor on the same side of a multi-sided market, it must decide whether to fully integrate the acquired platform or keep it as a separate brand. We study this in the context of Uber’s acquisition of Postmates, using novel consumer receipt data that tracks food delivery spending. Employing an Age–Period–Cohort (APC) decomposition, we isolate the merger’s effect on consumer spending while controlling for lifecycle and cohort effects. We find that Postmates users sharply reduced their spending on the platform after the merger, but spending shifted not only to UberEats, but also to competitors like DoorDash and Grubhub. Consumers who used multiple platforms and had low pre-merger activity on Postmates were more "sticky", showing little change. Comparing our APC results with a standard Difference-in-Differences (DiD) design, we find the DiD underestimates the merger’s total impact by missing market-wide effects. Our findings suggest that in multi-sided markets, keeping acquired platforms separate can be beneficial; dissolving them may push demand to competitors, and some sticky multihoming users may not shift spending at all.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Uber收购Postmates后，在多方市场中保持被收购平台为独立品牌的效果。利用消费者收据数据，通过APC分解发现：收购后Postmates用户大幅减少在该平台的支出，但消费流向了UberEats、DoorDash和Grubhub等多方竞争对手；多平台使用且收购前活跃度低的用户"粘性"较强；相比APC，传统DID方法低估了并购的总影响。
AI.research_question: 在多方市场中，母公司收购同侧水平竞争对手后，应当完全整合被收购平台还是保持其独立品牌？不同整合策略对消费者支出有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现实中企业在并购后常面临"整合还是保留独立品牌"的战略抉择，而多方市场（如外卖平台）的特殊性使这一问题更加复杂，现有文献对此缺乏实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多方市场理论、用户多归属行为（multihoming）、消费者粘性、并购溢出效应
AI.method: 利用消费者收据数据（追踪外卖支出），采用年龄-时期-队列（APC）分解方法控制生命周期和队列效应，并与双重差分（DID）方法进行比较。
AI.findings: （1）并购后Postmates用户大幅减少在该平台的支出；（2）支出流向了UberEats、DoorDash、Grubhub等多个竞争对手，而非仅转移到母公司平台；（3）多平台使用且收购前Postmates活跃度低的用户"粘性"更强，几乎不改变消费行为；（4）传统DID低估了并购的总影响，因为它无法捕捉市场范围的溢出效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了多方市场中并购后品牌整合策略的消费者行为效应，指出"保持独立品牌"可能优于"完全整合"，并证明了APC方法在并购研究中的优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台企业在并购后制定品牌整合策略提供实证依据；提醒反垄断监管机构关注并购后消费者支出的跨平台转移效应；警示传统DID方法在评估并购影响时可能存在偏误。

title: The Perceived Inflation Wedge
affiliations: University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill

detail.title: The Perceived Inflation Wedge
detail.abstract:
Standard measures of inflation, such as the Consumer Price Index (CPI), are designed to measure changes in the cost of living, not how households perceive price changes under limited attention and imperfect information. This paper introduces Perceived Inflation (PI), an attention-weighted inflation measure derived from a model in which households allocate attention across goods and observe noisy price signals. I construct monthly PI using disaggregated CPI data and attention proxies based on price salience, volatility, media mentions, and search behavior. The resulting PI series is highly correlated with CPI inflation but exhibits greater short-run volatility, especially during the Global Financial Crisis, the COVID-19 recession, and the 2021–22 inflation surge. A state-space version of the index implies a persistent latent attention component and a time-varying PI wedge. Finally, the paper embeds the estimated PI wedge into a heterogeneous-household model to demonstrate how attention-driven distortions in inflation perceptions affect saving and consumption through perceived real returns.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于注意力加权的新通胀衡量指标——感知通胀（Perceived Inflation, PI），该指标考虑了 households 在有限注意力和不完美信息下对价格变化的感知，发现PI与官方CPI高度相关但短期波动更大，并通过异质性家庭模型展示了感知通胀偏差对储蓄和消费的影响。
AI.research_question: 在有限注意力和不完美信息条件下， households 如何感知价格变化？感知通胀（PI）与官方CPI有何差异？感知通胀偏差如何影响家庭储蓄和消费决策？
AI.motivation: 标准通胀指标（如CPI）衡量的是生活成本的变化，但并未反映 households 在注意力有限、信息不完全的情况下对价格变化的主观感知。这一感知偏差可能影响家庭的经济行为，因此需要构建一个能够捕捉注意力分配效应的通胀指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于注意力分配模型：households 在不同商品间分配注意力，并观察带有噪声的价格信号，从而形成价格感知。使用价格显著性、波动性、媒体报道和搜索行为作为注意力代理变量。
AI.method: 利用分解的CPI数据和注意力代理变量（价格显著性、波动性、媒体报道、搜索行为）构建月度感知通胀（PI）指标；采用状态空间模型估计潜在的时变注意力成分和PI楔子；将PI楔子嵌入异质性家庭模型进行宏观效应分析。
AI.findings: PI与CPI通胀高度相关，但短期波动更大，尤其在金融危机、COVID-19衰退和2021-22年通胀飙升期间；存在持续的潜在注意力成分和时变的PI楔子；注意力驱动的感知通胀偏差通过感知实际回报影响家庭的储蓄和消费。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将注意力分配理论系统引入通胀感知的度量，提出"感知通胀"（PI）这一新概念；构建了注意力加权通胀的理论框架，丰富了行为宏观经济学中关于有限注意力和信息摩擦的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一种更贴近家庭真实感受的通胀衡量工具，有助于理解通胀预期形成机制；揭示了感知通胀偏差对消费和储蓄行为的宏观影响，对货币政策传导机制研究具有重要参考价值。

title: To Catch a Thief: Endogenous Policing and Choice of Location by Criminals
affiliations: University of Birmingham - Department of Economics,  and University College London - Department of Economics

detail.title: To Catch a Thief: Endogenous Policing and Choice of Location by Criminals
detail.abstract: This paper develops a tractable model of offender location choice and police resource allocation across multiple areas. Individuals differ in the cost of apprehension and choose whether to commit crime and, if so, where. Each area contains a fixed value of criminal opportunities, so offenders impose congestion on one another, while policing affects expected apprehension. For arbitrary policing levels, equilibrium sorts offenders by apprehension cost across areas ordered by policing per unit of criminal opportunity value. With a fixed police budget, welfare maximization equalizes policing-to-value ratios across all active areas. The model shows when place-based policing should target the value of criminal opportunities rather than observed crime counts alone, since observed crime may already reflect prior police allocation and offender displacement.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个关于犯罪者选址与警务资源分配的易处理模型，发现均衡状态下犯罪者按被捕成本在警务密度不同的区域间分类排序；最优福利最大化要求在所有活跃区域均等化警务与犯罪机会价值的比率，并指出属地警务应针对犯罪机会价值而非仅观察到的犯罪数量。
AI.research_question: 犯罪者如何选择作案地点，以及警务资源如何在多个区域间最优分配？
AI.motivation: 传统的警务资源配置往往依赖于观察到的犯罪率，但观察到的犯罪率已经受到现有警务部署和犯罪者位移效应的影响，导致资源配置可能存在偏误。本文旨在提供一个更精确的理论模型来指导警务资源的最优分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 犯罪者选址理论、警务资源配置理论、均衡排序理论、福利最大化理论。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建一个包含犯罪者异质性（被捕成本差异）、多区域、固定犯罪机会价值、警务资源约束的均衡模型，分析犯罪者的选址均衡和警务资源的最优配置。
AI.findings: （1）在任意警务水平下，均衡时犯罪者按被捕成本在按单位犯罪机会价值的警务密度排序的区域间分类排序；（2）在固定警务预算下，福利最大化要求在所有活跃区域均等化警务与犯罪机会价值的比率；（3）属地警务应针对犯罪机会价值而非仅观察到的犯罪数量，因为观察到的犯罪已经反映了先前的警务分配和犯罪者位移。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个易处理的犯罪者选址与警务资源分配联合模型，揭示了犯罪者按成本排序的均衡机制，修正了仅依赖观察犯罪率进行警务分配的传统理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为警务资源分配提供了理论指导：警务资源配置应关注犯罪机会价值而非仅观察到的犯罪数量，避免因现有警务部署和犯罪者位移导致的偏误；有助于提高警务效率和社会福利。

title: Dynamic Charitable Giving
affiliations: Frankfurt School of Finance & Management, , Frankfurt School of Finance & Management and

detail.title: Dynamic Charitable Giving
detail.abstract: This paper studies the dynamics of charitable giving. We model giving as the accumulation of virtue capital from past giving and test the model using panel data linking 7.6 million donations to 52 fundraising letters over six years. Giving is intertemporally consistent: past giving breeds future giving, past inaction breeds future inaction. This negative consistency quantitatively dominates: fundraising appeals cause negative intertemporal spillovers on subsequent appeals. However, negative consistency fades more quickly than positive consistency. These results contribute to our understanding of dynamic prosocial behavior and inform how fundraising campaigns should time and sequence communications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了慈善捐赠的动态过程，模型将捐赠行为视为过去捐赠积累的"美德资本"，并利用覆盖6年、760万笔捐赠及52封募捐信的面板数据进行了检验。研究发现捐赠具有跨期一致性：过去的捐赠会促进未来捐赠，过去的不作为也会导致未来不作为。然而，消极一致性在数量上占主导地位，即募捐呼吁会对后续呼吁产生消极的跨期溢出效应。但消极一致性比积极一致性消退得更快。这些结果有助于理解动态的亲社会行为，并为募捐活动的时间安排和沟通顺序提供指导。
AI.research_question: 慈善捐赠的动态机制是什么？过去的捐赠行为如何影响未来的捐赠决策？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注单次捐赠决策，缺乏对捐赠行为跨期动态关系的系统研究。理解捐赠的跨期一致性及其相对强度，对于优化募捐策略至关重要。
