AI.theoretical_framework: 美德资本模型（Virtue Capital Model）：将捐赠行为视为积累"美德资本"的过程，过去捐赠形成的心理资本影响未来捐赠决策。
AI.method: 利用面板数据（760万笔捐赠、52封募捐信、6年追踪），对美德资本模型进行实证检验。
AI.findings: （1）捐赠存在正向一致性：过去捐赠促进未来捐赠；（2）捐赠存在负向一致性：过去不作为导致未来不作为；（3）负向一致性在数量上占主导地位，即募捐呼吁会产生负向跨期溢出效应；（4）负向一致性比正向一致性消退得更快。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了美德资本模型解释捐赠的动态一致性，揭示了正向与负向一致性在持续性上的不对称性，丰富了动态亲社会行为的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为募捐活动的时间安排和沟通顺序提供策略指导：需要考虑募捐呼吁之间的负向溢出效应，合理安排募捐频率和间隔时间以最大化捐赠效果。

title: Panel Attrition, Data Imputation and Age Patterns in Subjective Ill-being
affiliations: Dartmouth College - Department of Economics, University College London and Dartmouth College

detail.title: Panel Attrition, Data Imputation and Age Patterns in Subjective Ill-being
detail.abstract:
We examine the implications of panel attrition for the age profile of subjective ill-being in the Global Flourishing Study (GFS). We establish that survey attrition rates are high, and are highest among the young, particularly when interviewed in wave 1 using a computer-assisted web interview (CAWI). We then deploy three methods (inverse probability weighting, multiple imputation chain equations, and last observation carried forward) to estimate the age pattern in subjective ill-being in wave 2 of the survey. All three methods have their strengths and weaknesses, but we demonstrate that such adjustments are merited given the nature of survey attrition in the data. We conclude that subjective ill-being is declining in age in both waves 1 and 2 of the GFS having accounted for sample attrition, something that would not have been apparent if one simply ran wave 2 regressions without accounting for sample attrition.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用全球繁荣调查（GFS）数据，探讨面板流失对主观不幸福感年龄分布的影响。研究发现年轻群体流失率最高（尤其是Wave 1使用CAWI方式受访者），采用三种方法（逆概率加权、多重插补链方程、末次观测值结转）调整后，表明主观不幸福感随年龄下降，这一结论在未调整样本流失时无法显现。
AI.research_question: 面板数据中的样本流失如何影响主观不幸福感的年龄分布？在调整样本流失后，主观不幸福感与年龄的关系呈现何种模式？
AI.motivation: 面板数据普遍存在样本流失问题，而年轻群体往往流失率更高，这可能导致对主观不幸福感年龄分布的估计产生偏误。现有研究较少系统考察这一问题，因此需要通过多种方法校正以得到更可靠的结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 样本选择偏差理论；缺失数据处理机制（MAR/MCAR）；主观幸福感与年龄关系的生命周期理论。
AI.method: 使用全球繁荣调查（GFS）两波面板数据，采用三种方法校正样本流失：逆概率加权（IPW）、多重插补链方程（MICE）和末次观测值结转（LOCF），对比调整前后的年龄-主观不幸福感关系。
AI.findings: （1）面板流失率较高，年轻群体流失最为严重，尤其是Wave 1通过CAWI方式受访者；（2）三种校正方法各有优劣，但均表明调整是必要的；（3）校正样本流失后，主观不幸福感在Wave 1和Wave 2中均随年龄增长而下降，这一模式在不处理流失时无法被观察到。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了样本流失对主观幸福感年龄分布估计的严重偏误，强调了在面板数据分析中处理流失问题的重要性，为幸福感与年龄关系的实证研究提供了方法论启示。
AI.practical_contributions: 为使用全球繁荣调查及其他面板数据的研究者提供了处理样本流失的实用方法比较；提示调查设计者应关注年轻群体的高流失率（尤其是CAWI模式），并采取针对性措施减少流失。

title: Trading Frictions in Dynamic Cap-and-Trade Markets
affiliations: LUISS University - Department of Economics and Finance, University of Rochester, Yale University, Yale University - Cowles Foundation and University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business

detail.title: Trading Frictions in Dynamic Cap-and-Trade Markets
detail.abstract:
We develop a dynamic stochastic model of markets with an externality and multiple trading frictions, and cap-and-trade as the leading application. Slow participation, limited intermediation, and heterogeneous information interact in equilibrium: agents choose costly market access, access determines residual compliance demand, intermediary constraints translate residual demand into a surrender-month premium, and the premium feeds back into access incentives. These interactions shape how effectively the market corrects the externality. We characterize access choices in closed form, prove that the equilibrium premium is unique, and show that endogenous access dampens the response to each friction in isolation, while the interaction of multiple frictions is non-additive and can amplify the price response. We quantify the model using 2.7 million EU ETS registry transactions and compliance records from 2005–2021. About 40% of operators do not trade annually, purchases concentrate in April when returns are systematically high, and operator flow predicts future returns.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含外部性和多种交易摩擦的动态随机市场模型，以碳排放权交易（cap-and-trade）为主要应用场景。研究发现，缓慢参与、有限中介和异质信息在均衡中相互影响，内生性市场准入会抑制单一摩擦的价格反应，但多种摩擦的交互作用具有非加总性且会放大价格反应。基于270万条欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）2005-2021年交易数据的实证分析显示，约40%的运营商不进行年度交易，购买集中在收益系统性较高的4月，运营商流量可预测未来收益。
AI.research_question: 在存在外部性和多重交易摩擦的市场中（以碳交易市场为例），市场参与者的内生准入决策、中介限制和信息摩擦如何相互作用，并影响市场纠正外部性的效率？
AI.motivation: 现实中的碳交易市场存在交易成本、中介限制和信息不对称等摩擦，这些摩擦如何交互影响市场有效性缺乏系统的理论和量化研究。理解这些机制对于政策设计和市场效率评估至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态随机市场均衡模型、内生市场准入理论、有限中介理论、异质信息下的交易行为理论。
AI.method: 理论建模（动态随机市场模型，含内生准入、有限中介和异质信息）+ 实证量化（基于270万条EU ETS 2005-2021年注册交易记录和合规数据）。
AI.findings: （1）约40%的运营商不进行年度交易；（2）购买集中在4月，此时收益系统性地较高；（3）运营商的流量可预测未来收益；（4）内生准入会抑制单一摩擦的价格反应；（5）多种摩擦的交互效应是非加总的，且会放大价格反应；（6）均衡溢价具有唯一性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建模了外部性市场中缓慢参与、有限中介和异质信息三种摩擦的交互作用；证明了内生准入对单一摩擦的缓冲效应以及多摩擦交互的非加总放大效应；在理论上证明了均衡溢价的唯一性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为碳交易市场（如EU ETS）的政策设计提供理论基础，揭示交易摩擦如何影响市场纠正外部性的效率；基于大规模微观数据的实证发现为监管者优化市场准入规则、中介监管和信息披露政策提供依据。

title: Pension Income and Post-Retirement Labor Supply
affiliations: University of Regensburg, , ,  and Karlsruhe Institute of Technology

detail.title: Pension Income and Post-Retirement Labor Supply
detail.abstract: This paper provides causal evidence on how pension income affects labor supply after retirement. We exploit the introduction of the German Earned Income Pension Credit (Grundrente), which permanently increased pension income for retirees with long contribution histories and comparatively low lifetime earnings. The reform generates exogenous variation in non-labor income without creating additional labor supply distortions, allowing us to isolate pure income effects. Using administrative data covering the universe of German retirees and a difference-in-differences design, we find that a 1,200 euro increase in annual pension income reduces unconditional labor earnings by approximately 122 euros, implying a marginal propensity to earn out of unearned income of −0.1. Two thirds of this response reflects extensive margin adjustments, which operate through both increased exit and reduced re-entry, with the remainder driven by intensive margin reductions. Effects are stronger for younger, more labor-market-attached cohorts.

AI.tldr: 本文利用德国《基本养老金》改革作为准自然实验，采用双重差分法发现：每年增加1200欧元养老金收入会使退休后无条件劳动收入减少约122欧元，边际挣钱倾向为-0.1，其中2/3通过退出劳动市场与减少再进入的集约边际实现，效应在年轻、劳动市场依附度高的群体中更强。
AI.research_question: 养老金收入如何影响退休后的劳动供给？
AI.motivation: 退休后劳动供给对养老金收入的因果效应尚缺乏清晰证据，既有研究面临内生性挑战（如养老金与劳动收入同时决定、遗漏变量偏误）。德国《基本养老金》改革提供了外生的非劳动收入冲击，且不产生额外的劳动供给扭曲，为识别纯收入效应提供了独特机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动供给理论中的收入效应与替代效应，本文聚焦于非劳动收入变化（养老金）对劳动供给的纯收入效应。由于改革不改变边际税率或替代率，可排除替代效应干扰，直接估计收入效应的大小。
AI.method: 使用德国全部退休人员的行政数据，采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），比较符合《基本养老金》领取条件的处理组与不符合条件的对照组在改革前后劳动收入的变化。
AI.findings: 每年增加1200欧元养老金收入使退休后无条件劳动收入减少约122欧元，边际挣钱倾向（MPE）约为-0.1。效应中约2/3来自广延边际调整（增加退出、减少再进入），剩余1/3来自集约边际调整（减少工作小时数）。效应在年轻、劳动市场依附度更高的群体中更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为退休后非劳动收入对劳动供给的纯收入效应提供了因果证据，丰富了老年劳动供给理论中收入效应的量化认识；区分了广延边际与集约边际的不同响应机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 对养老金制度改革具有政策启示：养老金收入增加会显著降低退休后劳动供给，可能加剧劳动力短缺；改革设计需权衡老年人的收入保障与劳动参与激励。

title: Mathematical Modelling of Hepatitis B in the Context of Evolutionary Game Theory
affiliations: Akenten Appiah-Menka University of Skills Training and Entrepreneurial Development (AAMUSTED)

detail.title: Mathematical Modelling of Hepatitis B in the Context of Evolutionary Game Theory
detail.abstract: This study examines the relationship between vaccination, disease transmission, and individual be havioral reactions using a fractional order model in conjunction with evolutionary game dynamics. The Atangana Baleanu Caputo (ABC) fractional derivative is used in the hepatitis B model formulation to account for memory effects. We prove the model fundamental mathematical characteristics, such as pos itivity and boundedness of solutions. The basic reproduction number is used to examine the local and global stability of the disease-free and endemic equilibria. Theoretical findings are corroborated using numerical simulations, which also show how fractional memory, vaccination cost, and vaccine efficiency affect behavioral and epidemic dynamics. The findings emphasize how crucial behavioral and memory elements are to successful Hepatitis B control.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用分数阶模型结合演化博弈动力学，探讨疫苗接种、疾病传播与个体行为反应之间的关系，发现记忆效应、接种成本和疫苗效率对乙肝控制具有重要影响。
AI.research_question: 疫苗接种、疾病传播与个体行为反应之间存在怎样的相互作用？记忆效应如何影响乙肝的流行病学动态？
AI.motivation: 传统传染病模型通常忽略个体的行为适应性和记忆效应，而现实中人们会根据感染风险和接种成本动态调整行为，因此需要更贴近现实的建模方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分数阶微积分（ABC分数阶导数）、演化博弈论、基本再生数理论、稳定性分析（局部与全局稳定性）。
AI.method: 构建基于ABC分数阶导数的乙肝分数阶模型，结合演化博弈动力学刻画个体行为选择，通过数学证明（解的正性、有界性、稳定性）与数值模拟验证理论结果。
AI.findings: 分数阶记忆效应、疫苗接种成本和疫苗效率均显著影响乙肝的传播动态和行为演化；记忆效应有助于抑制疾病传播；行为因素与记忆因素对乙肝控制至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 将分数阶微积分与演化博弈动力学相结合，为传染病建模提供了新的理论框架，扩展了对记忆效应在流行病学中作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生政策制定者提供了优化疫苗接种策略的定量依据，强调了降低接种成本、提高疫苗效率以及利用"记忆效应"来强化防控效果的重要性。

title: Information Provision and Demand-Side Barriers to Healthcare Innovation: Experimental Evidence on Shared Medical Appointments in Menopause Care
affiliations: School of Economics, University of Edinburgh, University College London, University of Oxford, University of Virginia - Department of Economics and London Business School - Department of Management Science and Operations

detail.title: Information Provision and Demand-Side Barriers to Healthcare Innovation: Experimental Evidence on Shared Medical Appointments in Menopause Care
detail.abstract:
Alternative care delivery models may offer benefits to patients and providers, but adoption often remains low. We study whether brief narrative testimonials shift willingness to attend virtual shared medical appointments (SMAs), a relatively little-used care format in which 5-15 patients with a shared non-urgent health condition meet simultaneously with a clinician. Using a pre-registered field experiment with over 4,000 women aged 45–60 in the UK, we randomly assigned participants to view only standard descriptive information about menopause appointment options (the control group) or to receive testimonials about SMAs from either previous patients or a clinician (treatment groups). Testimonials more than doubled the share of women choosing an SMA: when appointments were offered with a 6-8 week wait, 11% of the control group chose an SMA compared to 26% in the peer testimonials arm and 24% in the clinician testimonials arm. Shorter waiting times further increase uptake. When the SMA wait was reduced to one week, the share of women ever choosing an SMA rose by 14-19 percentage points across arms, reaching nearly 40% in the testimonial groups. Treatment effects are systematically larger among women with greater information-processing capacity: university education, higher baseline menopause knowledge, and broader information-seeking. Our findings suggest that women’s reluctance to choose SMAs is driven primarily by demand-side barriers, including unfamiliarity and uncertainty about their benefits, rather than deep-seated aversion to group-based care. Testimonials appear sufficient to meaningfully reduce these barriers.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 通过随机实地实验发现，简短的患者或医生推荐视频能使中年女性选择远程共享医疗预约（SMA）的比例翻倍（从11%提升至约25%），短等待时间进一步推动参与率至近40%。效果在高信息处理能力的女性中更显著，表明SMA低采用率主要源于需求侧的认知障碍，而非对群体护理的固有排斥。
AI.research_question: 简短的患者/医生推荐信息能否改变女性对远程共享医疗预约（SMA）的意愿？哪些因素调节这一效应？
AI.motivation: 尽管替代性护理模式（如SMA）可能对患者和提供者都有益，但实际采用率通常很低。本文试图探究这一低采用率背后的原因——是源于患者对群体护理的深层厌恶，还是源于对SMA的不熟悉和不确定性等需求侧障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息加工理论（信息处理能力调节推荐效果）；行为经济学中的"认知障碍"与"默认偏好"框架；社会影响与说服理论（同行推荐vs专家推荐）。
AI.method: 预注册实地实验。样本：英国4000余名45-60岁女性。三组随机对照：仅看标准描述信息（对照组）、看患者推荐视频、看医生推荐视频。因变量：是否选择SMA预约。额外操纵SMA等待时间（6-8周 vs 1周）。
AI.findings: （1）推荐使SMA选择率从11%提升至24-26%，翻了一倍多；（2）缩短等待时间使SMA选择率进一步上升，推荐组接近40%；（3）推荐效果在受过大学教育、更年期知识基线更高、信息搜寻更广泛的女性中更大；（4）同行推荐和医生推荐效果无显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"认知障碍而非偏好厌恶导致低采用"提供了因果证据；揭示了信息处理能力是推荐效应的调节机制；区分了同行影响与专家影响在医疗决策中的相对效力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗机构推广SMA等创新护理模式提供了低成本、高成效的干预方案（简短推荐视频）；为不同等待时间策略与推荐策略的组合提供了决策依据；提示针对不同信息处理能力的患者群体可采取差异化推广策略。

title: Rising Replacement Burden and the Compression of Net Building

detail.title: Rising Replacement Burden and the Compression of Net Building
detail.abstract: The share of output absorbed by replacing depreciating productive structure — the ratio of the consumption of fixed capital to output, 𝛿 = CFC/𝑌 — has risen steadily across every major economy since 1950. We establish three things. First, the rise is a robust and physical fact: it holds across US national accounts (1929–2025), a 180-country Penn World Table panel (1950–2023), and OECD STAN industry data (1970–2023); it survives a purely real construction that removes all nominal prices; and it is invariant to the depreciation-accounting method national agencies use. Second, the rise tightens an accounting constraint. Because the gross investment share is bounded (Kaldor 1961), a rising 𝛿 compresses the residual available for net new building, 𝑛 = 𝐶/𝑌 − 𝛿; in Japan this residual has fallen to 2.5% of GDP, the closest empirical approach to a replacement trap in which replacement absorbs all gross investment and net building reaches zero. Third, the rise decomposes — through the identity 𝛿 = (CFC/𝐾) × (𝐾/𝑌 ) — into a composition channel (faster-depreciating capital) and a scale channel (deeper accumulation); the United States is compositionled and Japan scale-led, with the intermediate cases sensitive to valuation and best read as qualitative. We stop at the net building rate. Whether the compressed 𝑛 slows productivity growth runs through a transmission coefficient whose magnitude is debated in the growth-accounting literature and which we do not identify; we establish the measurement and the identity, and leave the causal step to subsequent work.

AI.tldr: 自1950年以来，全球主要经济体的固定资本消耗占产出比重（δ）持续上升，压缩了净资本形成空间，日本已逼近“替代陷阱”（净投资占GDP仅2.5%）。该上升可分解为资本结构变化（更快折旧）和资本深化（更大资本存量）两个渠道，美日分别以不同渠道为主导。
AI.research_question: 为什么自1950年以来全球主要经济体的固定资本消耗占产出比重（δ）持续上升？这一上升对净资本形成有何约束？其背后机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 观察到固定资本消耗（折旧）占GDP比重在所有主要经济体中持续上升，这一“稳健且物理性的事实”尚未被充分研究。作者希望建立这一事实的测量基础，并揭示其对净投资空间的会计约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国民收入核算恒等式：总投资份额 = 净投资份额 + 折旧份额。引用Kaldor（1961）关于总投资份额有界的经典发现，推导出折旧上升会压缩净投资空间。进一步利用δ = (CFC/K) × (K/Y) 将折旧率分解为“成分渠道”（资本结构向更快折旧倾斜）和“规模渠道”（资本深化）。
AI.method: 多源数据实证分析：美国国民账户（1929-2025）、180国Penn World Table面板（1950-2023）、OECD STAN产业数据（1970-2023）。进行纯实物量（去除名义价格）的稳健性检验，并检验不同折旧会计方法下的不变性。
AI.findings: （1）δ上升在所有主要经济体、不同数据源、纯实物量计算和不同折旧方法下均成立；（2）δ上升压缩了净投资空间，日本净投资率降至GDP的2.5%，逼近“替代陷阱”；（3）δ上升可分解为成分渠道和规模渠道，美国以成分渠道（资本结构变化）为主，日本以规模渠道（资本深化）为主。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立并确认了折旧率持续上升这一宏观事实，将其与Kaldor增长事实联系起来，揭示了总投资份额有界条件下折旧上升对净投资空间的会计约束机制，提出了“替代陷阱”的概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了净投资空间被压缩的量化证据，尤其警示日本等经济体可能面临的“替代陷阱”风险；区分了成分渠道和规模渠道，有助于针对性地制定资本结构调整或资本深化管理政策。

title: Assessing Growth and Inflationary Implications of India's Carbon Credit Trading System: A Social Cost of Carbon Approach
affiliations: Independent and Power Management Institute India

detail.title: Assessing Growth and Inflationary Implications of India's Carbon Credit Trading System: A Social Cost of Carbon Approach
detail.abstract: This study evaluates the impact of proposed emission trading system in India on growth and inflation using the social cost of carbon approach. We use a novel measure the latent carbon price which we shows is similar to social cost of carbon due to adverse impact of global warming on total factor productivity. Our three-step procedure to evaluate the India’s proposed emission trading system consists of estimating the latent carbon price using KELMS data and robust regression methods. The estimated average latent carbon price as per the current sectoral coverage is $101.43 per tonne and $59.24 per tonne when sectoral coverage is hypothetically expanded to include electricity and iron & steel. Using Leontief price and demand equation the average impact on inflation and output is not high for current sectoral coverage of and is estimated at 0.05 per cent and 0.13 per cent respectively with green sacrifice ratio of $568.98 per tonne of emission reduction. However, inclusion of electricity and iron & steel in expected to be inflationary. The inflation is expected to rise to 0.15 per cent and output negatively impacted by 0.35 per cent. The green sacrifice ratio is lower at and $310.16 per tonne of emission reduction. Sectors that are impacted most outside the emission trading system sectors include financial intermediation, construction, air transport and mining and quarrying. Study highlights that rise of competitive imports in sectors not covered under emission trading system can further negatively impact these sectors and needs more closer examination from policy point of view to minimize the cost of transition.

AI.tldr: 本文利用社会碳成本方法，评估印度拟议的碳排放交易体系对经济增长和通胀的影响。研究发现，当前行业覆盖下对通胀和产出的影响较小（通胀0.05%，产出-0.13%），但若将电力和钢铁纳入覆盖，通胀将升至0.15%，产出下降0.35%。绿色牺牲比率在扩大覆盖后更低（$310.16/吨），但金融、建筑、航空等未被覆盖的行业面临更大的竞争进口冲击风险。
AI.research_question: 印度拟议的碳排放交易体系对经济增长和通货膨胀会产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 印度拟推行碳排放交易体系，但其对宏观经济（增长与通胀）的影响尚不明确，需量化评估以指导政策设计，平衡减排目标与经济稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会碳成本（Social Cost of Carbon）方法；潜在碳价格（Latent Carbon Price）概念，其与全球变暖对全要素生产率的负面效应相关；Leontief价格与需求方程。
AI.method: 三步法：（1）利用KELMS数据和稳健回归方法估算潜在碳价格；（2）基于Leontief投入产出模型计算价格与产出影响；（3）计算绿色牺牲比率（每吨减排的通胀/产出成本）。
AI.findings: 当前行业覆盖下平均潜在碳价$101.43/吨，通胀影响0.05%，产出影响-0.13%，绿色牺牲比率$568.98/吨；若扩大覆盖至电力和钢铁，碳价降至$59.24/吨，通胀升至0.15%，产出降至-0.35%，绿色牺牲比率降至$310.16/吨；受影响最大的非覆盖行业包括金融中介、建筑、航空运输和采矿业。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了潜在碳价格与社会碳成本的相似性，将全球变暖对全要素生产率的影响纳入碳定价分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度碳排放交易体系的行业覆盖范围设计提供了量化依据，揭示了扩大覆盖可降低减排成本但需关注非覆盖行业的竞争进口风险，为政策制定者最小化转型成本提供参考。

title: Foreign Involvement in Preventing and Countering Violent Extremism
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Foreign Involvement in Preventing and Countering Violent Extremism
detail.abstract: Africa is inundated with Western actors seeking to counter and prevent violent extremism (Ismael & Skons 2014). Interest in Africa has revived for various reasons. Some actors are in Africa to access its natural resources, while others are concerned about the transnational threats that originate from Africa. Some, such as Brazil, China, and Russia, are emerging powers, some are former colonial masters, and others are non-state actors (Ebo 2007). Each of these are developing different types of relations with the AU, individual African countries, RECs, and local organisations. In spite of all African countries attaining independence several decades ago, a myriad of foreign actors continue to influence its security landscape. Some provide technical support, capacity-building, joint military operations, and intelligence-gathering (ibid). There are a number of scholarly works on the role of Western actors in broad area of peace and security (Brosig 2010; Ebo 2007; Van Genugten 2008), but less so on foreign involvement in PCVE in Africa. This chapter is an attempt to help fill this gap. It provides an overview of international action in countering and preventing VE in Africa. It examines the origins and nature of international actors in PCVE in Africa, and asks whose interests they really serve. Partnerships with local actors and the overall impact of the involvements are also addressed. The chapter argues that Africa’s own attempt to curb VE with the assistance of foreign actors has failed, largely due to the assumption that Africa is homogeneous and that one policy approach will therefore fit all countries. In reality, African countries are shaped by seemingly similar yet different historical and structural factors and actors. The lack of agreement on the standards for evaluating PVE and CVE programmes in Africa has further made it difficult to register meaningful success in countering and preventing VE. RECs such as SADC need to play a leading role in ensuring that monitoring and evaluation take account of local realities. We need to note that involvement in CVE/PVE is not apolitical in the sense that foreign actors influence local politics as they strive to achieve their own interests. Similarly, foreign actors are shaped by the politics of the state in cases where African states engage in rent-seeking behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了外国行为体在非洲预防和打击暴力极端主义（PCVE）中的参与，指出由于将非洲视为同质化整体并采取“一刀切”政策，加上缺乏统一的评估标准，非洲在外国援助下的反恐努力未能取得显著成效。文章呼吁区域经济共同体（如南部非洲发展共同体SADC）应主导基于当地现实的监测与评估。
AI.research_question: 外国行为体在非洲预防和打击暴力极端主义（PCVE）中的参与，其起源、性质如何？这些参与真正服务于谁的利益？对当地伙伴关系及整体影响如何？
AI.motivation: 现有学术文献多关注西方行为体在非洲和平与安全领域的广泛作用，但对外国行为体在非洲PCVE中的具体参与研究较少。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 批判性国际关系视角（强调外国干预并非政治中立）；2. 地方政治与行为体互动理论（外国行为体受非洲国家内部政治影响）；3. 政策同质化批判（非洲并非同质化整体）。
AI.method: 文献综述与定性分析，概述国际行为体在非洲PCVE中的行动，分析其起源、性质、利益动机及影响。
AI.findings: 1. 非洲在外国援助下遏制暴力极端主义的努力基本失败；2. 失败主因：将非洲视为同质化整体，采取“一刀切”政策；3. 缺乏统一的评估标准，难以衡量成功；4. 外国参与并非政治中立，外国行为体追求自身利益，同时受非洲国家内部寻租行为等政治因素影响；5. 建议区域经济共同体（如SADC）主导符合当地现实的监测与评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了外部干预在PCVE领域中的政治性本质，批判了将非洲视为同质化整体的政策假设，丰富了关于非洲安全治理中外部行为体作用的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供建议：PCVE项目应因地制宜，避免“一刀切”；区域经济共同体应在监测评估中发挥主导作用；需正视外国干预的政治属性及地方政治的复杂互动。

title: Pay for Dirt or for Green? The Moderating Role of Institutional Quality in Transitioning Economies
affiliations: University of North Georgia

detail.title: Pay for Dirt or for Green? The Moderating Role of Institutional Quality in Transitioning Economies
detail.abstract: To date, most of the existing literature has examined how bribery and innovation affect firm productivity, while paying limited attention to the reverse causal relationship. This paper addresses this gap by studying firms in transitioning economies during the 2010s, with a particular focus on green research and development (R&D). We empirically investigate how firm productivity influences bribery behavior and two distinct green R&D strategies: independent innovation and dependent imitation. Our results show that more productive firms are more likely to engage in bribery and less likely to invest in green R&D overall. Conditional on undertaking green R&D, however, higher productivity increases the likelihood of innovation while reducing reliance on imitation. Additionally, the impact of productivity is significantly moderated by institutional quality. Under poor institutional quality characterized by substantial infrastructural and bureaucratic obstacles, the positive effect of productivity on bribery and its negative effect on green R&D-particularly green innovation-are significantly amplified.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2010年代转型经济体中企业生产率如何影响贿赂行为及两种绿色研发策略（独立创新与依赖模仿），并发现制度质量在其中的调节作用。
AI.research_question: 转型经济体中，企业生产率如何影响贿赂行为和绿色研发策略（独立创新 vs. 依赖模仿）？制度质量如何调节这些关系？
AI.motivation: 现有文献大多关注贿赂和创新如何影响企业生产率，而对反向因果关系（生产率如何影响贿赂和绿色研发）关注不足，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度经济学和企业行为理论，探讨生产率对贿赂与绿色研发策略的影响，并引入制度质量作为调节变量。
AI.method: 采用实证研究方法，对2010年代转型经济体的企业数据进行分析，检验生产率对贿赂行为及两种绿色研发策略（独立创新与依赖模仿）的影响。
AI.findings: （1）生产率越高的企业越可能参与贿赂，且整体上更少投资绿色研发；（2）但在进行绿色研发的企业中，高生产率更倾向于独立创新而非模仿；（3）制度质量显著调节上述关系：在制度质量差（基础设施和官僚障碍严重）的环境中，生产率对贿赂的正向影响及对绿色研发（尤其是绿色创新）的负向影响被显著放大。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生产率对贿赂和绿色研发的反向因果机制，丰富了制度经济学与绿色创新理论，并区分了绿色研发中的创新与模仿两种策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为转型经济体的政策制定者提供启示：改善制度质量（减少基础设施和官僚障碍）有助于抑制高生产率企业的贿赂行为，并促进绿色研发投入与创新。

title: Shares in Students: A New Model for University Funding
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Shares in Students: A New Model for University Funding
detail.abstract:
UK higher education faces an acute funding crisis. The government's marginal increase in tuition fees, rising from £9,250 to £9,535 in 2025, generates only £330 million, falling short of the £370 million burden created by its own budget, leaving many institutions on the brink of financial failure and threatening the UK's standing as a world-class higher education provider.

At the root of this crisis lies an outdated, centralised funding model, a legacy of the post-1918 Haldane Report, which has progressively eroded universities' financial independence. Crucially, because the government issues student loans and absorbs repayment risk, universities face incentives to prioritise recruitment over graduate employability. The result is growing enrolments but poor outcomes, with one in five graduates earning less than they would have without a degree.

This paper proposes a fundamental restructuring of university finance. The cap on tuition fees would be abolished, and the government loan amount would be frozen. Universities would set fees according to market demand, financing any amount above the government loan through income-contingent agreements issued by the institution itself rather than the state. Drawing on the master-apprentice tradition, this arrangement ensures that universities prosper financially only if their graduates do, incentivising institutions to recruit students ready for serious study and to design courses that lead to genuine workplace success.

Recognising the public benefit of university assets, the paper further proposes that the state become owner and shareholder, with universities listed on the London Stock Exchange, potentially raising in the order of £100 billion for the Exchequer. Taken together, these reforms would realign incentives across the sector, improve student outcomes, restore fiscal sustainability, and position the UK as the global leader in higher education.

AI.tldr: 英国高等教育面临资金危机，本文提出废除学费上限、冻结政府贷款、引入大学自主的基于收入的协议，并将大学国有化上市，以重塑激励机制、改善学生成果并恢复财政可持续性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过重构大学融资机制解决英国高等教育资金危机，同时改善学生就业成果？
AI.motivation: 英国高等教育面临严峻的资金危机——政府小幅增加学费（从£9,250升至£9,535）仅能筹集£3.3亿，却无法弥补政府预算本身带来的£3.7亿缺口。现有中央集权的资助模式（源于1918年Haldane报告）削弱了大学财务独立性，且政府承担学生贷款风险导致大学重招生轻就业，造成五分之一的毕业生收入低于无学位者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托代理理论（政府发放贷款并承担风险→大学激励扭曲）、市场定价理论（废除学费上限，由市场供需决定）、收入或有协议（income-contingent agreements）与师徒传统（master-apprentice tradition）——大学只有毕业生成功才能获利。
AI.method: 政策分析与制度设计，提出三项核心改革方案：废除学费上限、冻结政府贷款并引入大学自主的收入或有协议、大学国有化并在伦敦证券交易所上市。
AI.findings: 现有模式导致大学激励扭曲（重数量轻质量），学生成果恶化（20%毕业生收入低于无学位者）。提出的改革方案可重塑激励：大学只有在培养学生真实就业能力时才能获得财务成功；大学上市可筹集约£1000亿资金。
AI.theory_contributions: 将委托代理理论应用于高等教育融资，揭示了政府承担贷款风险导致大学激励机制扭曲的机制，并提出了"师徒传统"式的新型融资契约设计原理。
AI.practical_contributions: 为英国高等教育资金危机提供了具体的系统性解决方案：废除学费上限、引入大学自主的收入或有协议、大学国有化上市。这些改革有望改善学生成果、恢复财政可持续性，并提升英国高等教育的全球竞争力。

title: Private Equity and Venture Capital : Understanding the Investment Spectrum
affiliations: Multimedia University (MMU)

detail.title: Private Equity and Venture Capital : Understanding the Investment Spectrum
detail.abstract: In The Key Takeaways : Private Equity and Venture Capital (2025), the learned author distilled the key distinctions, similarities and the fundamental mechanics governing the deployment of capital in Private Equity (PE) and Venture Capital (VC) within the modern investment system. This article explores further in relation to the managerial process that drives investment decisions, and the deal-making frameworks that determine price and return. Understanding these concepts is essential for appreciating how private capital investors identify opportunities, manage risk, and create value throughout the investment lifecycle.

AI.tldr: 本文系统阐述了私募股权（PE）与风险投资（VC）在管理决策流程和交易框架上的核心差异与运作机制，揭示了私人资本投资者如何识别机会、管理风险并创造价值。
AI.research_question: 私募股权（PE）与风险投资（VC）在投资决策的管理流程和交易框架上有何关键区别？这些区别如何影响投资定价、回报和价值创造？
AI.motivation: 在PE与VC日益成为现代投资体系重要组成部分的背景下，深入理解两者在管理流程和交易框架上的运作机理，有助于投资者更好地识别机会、管理风险并实现价值创造。
AI.theoretical_framework: 私人资本投资管理流程理论；交易框架与定价机制理论；风险-回报权衡理论；价值创造生命周期理论。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论梳理，基于已有文献和实践经验对PE与VC的管理流程和交易框架进行比较研究。
AI.findings: PE与VC在投资决策流程、交易结构设计、定价机制和回报驱动因素上存在显著的差异，这些差异根植于两者不同的投资阶段、风险特征和增值方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地厘清了PE与VC在管理流程和交易框架层面的理论区别，为私人资本投资决策提供了更精细的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资从业者提供了理解PE与VC运作机理的实用指南，帮助其在实践中更有效地识别机会、设计交易结构并管理投资风险。

title: Natural Disasters, Government Safety Nets, and Household Portfolio Choice
affiliations: Zicklin School of Business, Baruch College - The City University of New York, City University of New York, Baruch College - Zicklin School of Business - Department of Economics and Finance and

detail.title: Natural Disasters, Government Safety Nets, and Household Portfolio Choice
detail.abstract: Using a nationwide survey spanning 2011 to 2019, we find that natural disasters reduce household stock market participation and risky asset allocation. These effects are substantially mitigated, by 58 to 75%, following the introduction of two government insurance programs that improve healthcare access and disaster risk sharing. For identification, we exploit the staggered provincial rollout of the healthcare program and use peer province disaster experience as a plausibly exogenous shock, along with household fixed effects and falsification tests. We further document heterogeneous effects: the adverse impacts of disasters are more pronounced among poorer, uninsured, and less financially sophisticated households. Our evidence suggests that effective policies can buffer the adverse financial impacts of disasters, thereby improving household financial resilience. Households also express a preference for public over private insurance programs in response to disaster losses.

AI.tldr: 利用2011-2019年全国调查数据，发现自然灾害会降低家庭股市参与和风险资产配置，但两项政府保险计划（改善医疗可及性和灾害风险分担）可缓解58%-75%的负面效应。研究利用医保计划在不同省份的分阶段推行和同侪省份灾害经历作为外生冲击进行因果识别。
AI.research_question: 自然灾害如何影响家庭金融市场参与和资产配置？政府保险计划能否缓解这些影响？
AI.motivation: 气候变化导致自然灾害日益频繁，其对家庭金融决策的影响以及公共政策在增强家庭财务韧性中的作用值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灾害风险与家庭金融决策理论、政府保险与风险分担机制、医疗可及性与预防性储蓄理论
AI.method: 全国调查数据（2011-2019）+ 交错DID（医保计划分省逐步推行）+ 同侪省份灾害经历作为外生冲击 + 家庭固定效应 + 安慰剂检验
AI.findings: （1）自然灾害降低家庭股市参与和风险资产配置；（2）政府保险计划（改善医疗可及性+灾害风险分担）缓解58%-75%的负面效应；（3）负面影响对更贫困、无保险、金融素养低的家庭更显著；（4）家庭更偏好公共保险而非私人保险。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了自然灾害影响家庭金融决策的机制，证明政府保险计划能有效增强家庭财务韧性，为公共政策在金融市场参与中的作用提供了理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者应对气候风险提供了实证依据：改善医疗可及性和建立灾害风险分担机制可显著提升家庭财务韧性，减少灾害对金融市场的负面冲击。

title: Tainted Debt Is Not Enforceable Debt — Policy Brief: Why the USD 150–170 Billion Reference Stock Is a Legally Illegitimate Figure and the Indispensable Role of the Egmont Group in Venezuela's Restructuring

detail.title: Tainted Debt Is Not Enforceable Debt — Policy Brief: Why the USD 150–170 Billion Reference Stock Is a Legally Illegitimate Figure and the Indispensable Role of the Egmont Group in Venezuela's Restructuring

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a policy analysis paper involving no human participants or patient data.

detail.abstract: This policy brief presents the principal findings and policy recommendations of the technical research paper "Tainted Debt Is Not Enforceable Debt" (CESV Spain Chapter / Riskoff, June 2026) [SSRN No. pending]. It argues that the USD 150–170 billion reference stock used in Venezuela's sovereign debt restructuring is not fully enforceable debt, introduces a tripartite legal classification of the bond inventory under New York law, identifies three cumulative legal consequences for holders of tainted debt, and advances five technical recommendations centred on the formal activation of the Egmont Group's 176 financial intelligence units as the indispensable mechanism for a legally valid exchange offer.

AI.tldr: 本文论证委内瑞拉主权债务重组中1500-1700亿美元参考存量并非全部可执行债务，提出纽约法律下的三分法分类，识别"受污染债务"持有者的三项累积法律后果，并建议正式激活艾格蒙特集团176个金融情报单元作为合法交换要约的关键机制。
AI.research_question: 委内瑞拉主权债务重组中，哪些债务应被视为不可执行的"受污染债务"？其法律分类标准及后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 委内瑞拉主权债务重组中大量债务存量的法律效力存在争议，需厘清不可执行债务的范围以推动合法有效的重组方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 纽约法律下的债务可执行性理论、主权债务重组中的法律分类框架、金融情报共享机制（艾格蒙特集团）的制度理论。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例研究、制度分析（针对艾格蒙特集团金融情报单元的运作机制）。
AI.findings: 1) 1500-1700亿美元参考存量中部分为不可执行的"受污染债务"；2) 提出三分法法律分类；3) 识别了持有受污染债务的三项累积法律后果；4) 激活艾格蒙特集团176个金融情报单元是合法交换要约的必备机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了主权债务不可执行性的法律分类框架，将金融情报共享机制纳入债务重组合法性的理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为委内瑞拉债务重组提供五项技术建议，特别是通过艾格蒙特集团机制提升交换要约的法律可信度，为政策制定者和债权人提供操作路径。

title: The Disposition Effect under Uncertainty: An Information Processing Perspective
affiliations: and University College London

detail.title: The Disposition Effect under Uncertainty: An Information Processing Perspective

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study was approved by the University College London Research Ethics Committee (Ethical Approval Number: EP/2023/012), and informed consent was obtained from all participants prior to the experiment.

detail.abstract: The disposition effect—the tendency to sell assets at a gain more readily than those at a loss—is among the most stable behavioural biases in financial decision-making. Although typically attributed to Prospect Theory, this explanation faces two significant challenges: (1) Prospect Theory does not adequately account for investment decisions under uncertainty (as opposed to risk), and (2) empirical evidence linking Prospect Theory to the disposition effect remains inconsistent. In this study, we propose an alternative explanation based on an information processing perspective. Across two controlled experiments (N = 125), we observed a significant disposition effect that was more pronounced under uncertainty than under known risk, and further exacerbated by higher volatility. By applying a cognitive model that treats decision-making as evidence accumulation toward a threshold (the shifted Wald model), we found that participants exhibited higher information processing efficiency in the gain domain compared to the loss domain. Furthermore, participants adopted higher decision thresholds in the gain domain than in the loss domain under risk only, but behaved in largely opposite patterns under uncertainty. These findings underscore the importance of investigating the cognitive foundations of investor behaviour in realistic scenarios and offer new insights into the mechanisms underlying the disposition effect.

AI.tldr: 本文从信息加工视角替代前景理论解释处置效应，通过两个实验（N=125）发现：不确定性比已知风险下处置效应更显著，高波动性加剧该效应；基于移位沃尔德模型的认知建模显示，盈利域信息加工效率更高，但决策阈值在风险与不确定条件下呈现相反模式。
AI.research_question: 处置效应的认知机制是什么？前景理论能否充分解释？不确定性与风险条件下的处置效应有何不同？
AI.motivation: 尽管处置效应是金融决策中最稳定的行为偏差之一，但前景理论面临两个挑战：（1）不能充分解释不确定性（而非风险）下的投资决策；（2）前景理论与处置效应的实证证据不一致。因此需要探索替代解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息加工视角；移位沃尔德模型（shifted Wald model）——将决策视为证据累积至阈值的过程。
AI.method: 两个受控实验（N=125），比较不确定性vs.已知风险条件，及不同波动水平；应用移位沃尔德模型进行认知建模。
AI.findings: （1）不确定性下处置效应比已知风险更显著；（2）高波动加剧处置效应；（3）盈利域信息加工效率高于损失域；（4）风险条件下盈利域决策阈值更高，而不确定性条件下模式相反。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并验证了处置效应的信息加工替代解释，超越了传统前景理论框架；揭示了风险与不确定性条件下认知机制的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解真实情境下投资者行为的认知基础提供新见解，有助于开发更有效的投资决策干预策略。

title: Financial Constraints, Export Dynamics, and R&D Strategies: Firm-Level Evidence from Global Emerging Economies
affiliations: University of North Georgia

detail.title: Financial Constraints, Export Dynamics, and R&D Strategies: Firm-Level Evidence from Global Emerging Economies
detail.abstract: This paper empirically examines how financial constraints affect firms' dynamic exporting behavior and how R&D strategies serve as an important transmission channel. Using panel data constructed from the World Bank Enterprise Surveys during 2013-2023 across multiple emerging economies, we employ a twostage estimation to address endogeneity and simultaneity error. We reveal that financial constraint is associated with significantly lower likelihood of both export entry and export persistence, reaffirming the importance of financial flexibility in sustaining international activities. Notably, we identify R&D as the key mechanism. Successful R&D substantially attenuates the negative association between financial constraints and export entry, and partially attenuates this relationship for continuing exporters. Further distinguishing between two R&D strategies, we find that innovation is more sensitive to financial factors than imitation. Moreover, imitation facilitates export entry, whereas innovation supports export persistence. These findings provide new insights into the R&D-export nexus and highlight that easing financing frictions is critical for enabling firms to convert R&D investment into export capability and long-term international competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文实证研究了融资约束如何通过R&D策略影响企业的动态出口行为，发现融资约束降低了出口进入和持续出口的概率，而成功的R&D能够缓解这一负面效应，且不同的R&D策略（创新 vs. 模仿）对出口的不同阶段有差异化作用。
AI.research_question: 融资约束如何影响企业的动态出口行为？R&D策略在其中扮演怎样的传导渠道角色？
AI.motivation: 现有文献较少关注融资约束通过R&D策略影响企业出口动态的微观机制，且对创新与模仿两类R&D策略在出口不同阶段（进入 vs. 持续）的差异化作用缺乏深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融资约束理论、企业出口动态理论、R&D策略（创新 vs. 模仿）与出口行为的关系。
AI.method: 基于2013-2023年世界银行企业调查面板数据，采用两阶段估计方法处理内生性和联立性误差。
AI.findings: （1）融资约束显著降低了企业出口进入和持续出口的概率；（2）成功的R&D显著缓解了融资约束对出口进入的负面作用，部分缓解了对持续出口的负面影响；（3）创新比模仿对融资因素更敏感；（4）模仿有助于出口进入，而创新支持出口持续。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了R&D策略是融资约束影响企业出口动态的关键传导机制，区分了创新与模仿两种R&D策略对出口进入和出口持续的差异化作用，丰富了R&D-出口关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者缓解企业融资摩擦、支持企业将R&D投入转化为出口能力和长期国际竞争力提供了实证依据和启示。

title: Morals and the Political Economy of Corrective Taxes
affiliations: University of Cologne - Center for Macroeconomic Research (CMR), Vanderbilt University - College of Arts and Science - Department of Economics,  and Humboldt University Berlin

detail.title: Morals and the Political Economy of Corrective Taxes
detail.abstract: We study the political economy of carbon taxes when neoclassical consumers take all other agents' emissions as given and socially responsible consumers internalize damages in a group-rule-utilitarian way, taking neoclassical consumers' behavior as given. We characterize political equilibrium taxes with a focus on deviations from first-best Pigouvian taxation. Welfare falls further if arguments on moral obligations to reduce carbon footprints polarize the debate in society. Finally, we present survey evidence that supports our theory: social responsibility correlates with lower consumption of brown goods, higher preferred carbon taxes, and support for moral arguments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在存在新古典消费者（视他人排放为既定）和社会责任消费者（以群体规则功利主义方式内部化损害）的社会中，碳税的政治经济学。重点分析了政治均衡税收对最优庇古税的偏离，并发现道德义务争论的极化会进一步降低社会福利。调查证据支持理论：社会责任感与更少的棕色商品消费、更高的碳税偏好及对道德论点的支持相关。
AI.research_question: 当社会中同时存在新古典消费者（无视他人排放外部性）和社会责任消费者（以群体规则功利主义方式内部化损害）时，碳税的政治均衡如何形成？政治均衡税收如何偏离第一最优庇古税？
AI.motivation: 传统碳税理论基于同质消费者假设，但现实中消费者对碳排放的道德认知存在异质性。本文旨在解释为何实际碳税往往偏离庇古税最优水平，并探讨道德义务争论的极化如何影响福利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 群体规则功利主义（group-rule-utilitarianism）；政治经济均衡分析；庇古税理论
AI.method: 理论建模（政治经济均衡模型） + 调查数据验证
AI.findings: （1）政治均衡碳税偏离第一最优庇古税；（2）关于碳减排道德义务的争论极化会进一步降低社会福利；（3）社会责任感与棕色商品消费负相关，与偏好的碳税水平正相关，且更支持道德论点。
AI.theory_contributions: 将消费者道德异质性（社会责任型 vs. 新古典型）引入碳税政治经济学分析，解释了现实碳税偏离庇古税的原因，并揭示了道德争论极化对福利的负面影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计碳税时考虑消费者道德异质性提供理论依据；提示应避免碳减排道德争论的极化，以减轻福利损失；为基于社会责任的环保行为干预提供实证支持。

title:
From balance sheet arithmetic to cognitive capture: a neurodigital theory of uncontrolled consumption and insolvency 
Induction

detail.title:
From balance sheet arithmetic to cognitive capture: a neurodigital theory of uncontrolled consumption and insolvency 
Induction
detail.abstract: This article proposes a radical rereading of insolvency in the algorithmic era, where financial decisions no longer emerge from a rational subject, but from a heuristic debtor shaped by digital architectures that exploit cognitive and affective vulnerabilities. The convergence between consumer, investment and betting platforms has transformed indebtedness into an emotionally induced and technologically directed process. In this environment, algorithmic opacity, gamification, and the elimination of transactional frictions erode the economic autonomy of the individual. Thus, insolvency ceases to be a mere equity imbalance to become the foreseeable outcome of an ecosystem that manufactures "winners who lose" and digitizes assets, subjecting them to tokenization and conditional liquidity logics. The article argues that classic bankruptcy law is insufficient to address this reality, so it proposes to integrate neuroscience, behavioral economics and algorithmic studies as pillars of a new regulatory design capable of confronting the structural manipulation of financial behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文重新解读算法时代的破产问题，认为破产并非个体理性失误的结果，而是由算法架构、游戏化机制和数字平台共同制造的"可预见结局"。传统破产法无法应对这种结构性金融行为操纵，需要整合神经科学、行为经济学和算法研究来重建监管框架。
AI.research_question: 在算法驱动的金融环境中，个人破产的本质是什么？传统破产法为何不足以应对数字平台对金融行为的结构性操纵？
AI.motivation: 消费、投资和博彩平台的融合以及算法的介入，使得负债从理性经济决策转变为被技术架构诱导和情感操控的过程，个体经济自主性被侵蚀，破产成为系统性产物而非个体失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法主体性理论（heuristic debtor）、行为经济学、神经科学、金融平台化理论、债务与情绪诱导理论、资产代币化与流动性逻辑。
AI.method: 跨学科概念性分析，融合法学、神经科学、行为经济学和算法研究的多维理论建构。
AI.findings: 算法透明度缺失、游戏化机制和交易摩擦消除共同侵蚀个体经济自主权；破产不再是资本抵债，而是"赢家输家"制造生态系统的可预见结果；传统破产法无法回应数字时代的结构性金融操纵。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"算法时代的破产"新概念框架，将破产从个体理性失误重新定义为算法生态系统的结构性产物；将神经科学和行为经济学引入破产法理论，拓展了法律研究的跨学科边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议将神经科学、行为经济学和算法研究作为新型监管设计的基础支柱，为应对数字平台对金融行为的结构性操纵提供制度设计思路。

title: Online Data Processing Under GATS Section 2.C.n

detail.title: Online Data Processing Under GATS Section 2.C.n
detail.abstract:
Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Lei 13.709/2018) and the Marco Civil da Internet Article 11 (Lei 12.965/2014) impose conditions on cross-border transfers of personal data that restrict the ability of foreign service suppliers to deliver online data processing services from outside Brazilian territory. This paper examines whether these measures raise questions of tension with Brazil's specific commitments under the General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS), as inscribed in GATS/SC/13/Suppl.2 — Brazil's schedule of specific commitments under the Fourth Protocol on Basic Telecommunications (1997). Under Section 2.C.n of the W/120 services classification framework, Brazil consolidated full market access ("None") for Modes 1, 2, and 3 in online data processing and value-added telecommunications services. This commitment predates the LGPD by twenty-one years and the Marco Civil by seventeen years.

Three independent lines of analysis are examined: (i) Article XVI:2(c) GATS, which prohibits numerical limitations on service supply where "None" has been committed; (ii) Article VI:5 GATS, which addresses measures enacted after a commitment that nullify its benefit without constituting an Article XVI restriction; and (iii) Article II GATS (Most-Favoured-Nation), a line of inquiry prompted by ANPD Resolution CD/ANPD No. 32/2026 (January 26, 2026), which granted adequacy status exclusively to the European Union without extending equivalent treatment to other WTO Members. The paper further examines the GATS Annex on Telecommunications, Paragraph 5(c), which guarantees the movement of information and access to data in machine-readable form across borders — a provision directly applicable to cross-border data processing services.

Brazil's Article XIV(c) privacy exception defense is examined against the necessity test established in US-Gambling (WT/DS285/AB/R, 2005), and against the chapeau's prohibition on arbitrary or unjustifiable discrimination — though, as discussed in Section 5.2, resolving the chapeau question would require a separate factual determination of whether EU and US service suppliers operate under "like conditions," which this paper does not undertake. The EU's GDPR framework — which appears to achieve equivalent data protection objectives without data localization — is identified as a documented, potentially less-restrictive alternative. The USTR's Section 301 determination of June 1, 2026 explicitly declined to reach conclusions on the actionability of Brazil's data transfer restrictions, leaving open a distinct analytical pathway under the GATS framework that this paper examines. This paper does not purport to resolve whether Brazil's measures are in fact inconsistent with its WTO obligations; it identifies a previously underexplored analytical question warranting further examination (see Scope and Legal Position, below).

AI.tldr: 本文分析巴西《通用数据保护法》（LGPD）和《互联网民法》第11条对跨境数据转移的限制，是否与巴西在GATS下对在线数据处理和增值电信服务的市场准入承诺（"None"）相冲突。通过三条独立分析路径（GATS第XVI:2(c)条、第VI:5条、第II条最惠国待遇）以及电信附件第5(c)条展开探讨，并评估巴西以第XIV(c)条隐私例外作为抗辩的可行性。
AI.research_question: 巴西LGPD和Marco Civil第11条对跨境数据转移的限制，是否与巴西在GATS第四议定书中对在线数据处理和增值电信服务（W/120第2.C.n节）承诺的完全市场准入（None）产生张力？
AI.motivation: 巴西的数据本地化措施（LGPD和Marco Civil）可能限制外国服务供应商从境外提供在线数据处理服务，而巴西在1997年GATS承诺中已开放此类服务的市场准入。这一潜在的规则冲突此前未得到充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: GATS框架：第XVI:2(c)条（数量限制禁令）、第VI:5条（承诺后措施的合理期待保护）、第II条（最惠国待遇）；GATS电信附件第5(c)条（跨境信息传输权利）；第XIV(c)条隐私例外及必要性测试（US-Gambling案）；巴西ANPD第32/2026号决议对欧盟的充分性认定引发的MFN问题。
AI.method: 法律文本分析：对比巴西GATS承诺表与LGPD、Marco Civil及ANPD决议的措辞和适用范围；WTO判例适用：以US-Gambling案必要性测试为分析框架；替代方案比较：将欧盟GDPR框架（实现同等隐私保护但无数据本地化要求）作为潜在更少限制的替代措施。
AI.findings: (1) 巴西对在线数据处理和增值电信服务在Mode 1和Mode 2下承诺"None"，而LGPD等限制措施可能构成事实上的数量限制（XVI:2(c)）或削弱承诺价值（VI:5）；(2) ANPD第32/2026号决议仅给予欧盟充分性认定，可能违反最惠国待遇（第II条）；(3) 电信附件5(c)条直接保障跨境数据流动，与巴西措施形成冲突；(4) 巴西援引第XIV(c)条隐私例外面临严格必要性测试，欧盟GDPR的存在表明可能存在更少限制的替代方案；(5) 初稿问题（chapeau）的认定取决于美欧供应商是否处于"相似条件"，本文未作定论。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数据本地化措施与GATS早期电信承诺之间的结构性冲突，拓展了WTO法在数字贸易领域的适用分析框架；将欧盟GDPR作为必要性测试中的"替代方案"基准，丰富了隐私例外抗辩的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为WTO成员方评估数据本地化措施的合规性提供了分析样板；对巴西政策制定者具有风险预警意义，提示可能需要调整LGPD实施方式以避免WTO争端；对美国USTR 301调查的未决问题提供了GATS路径下的补充分析。

title: Oil fairness, Subsistence demand, and Optimal Policy

detail.title: Oil fairness, Subsistence demand, and Optimal Policy
detail.abstract: Oil prices are easy to observe and hard to interpret. The household sees the posted price, not the firm's marginal cost, and must decide how much of any increase reflects cost pressure and how much reflects a higher markup. This inference matters especially for oil because part of consumption is non-discretionary: a household may judge a posted price unfair and still buy what it needs for commuting or heating. I study this interaction in a two-sector model with a sticky-price non-oil sector and a flexible-price oil sector. Households infer perceived marginal costs from observed prices and past perceived costs, and perceived markups determine the fairness assigned to each posted price. Oil demand has a Stone-Geary-type structure, so only the discretionary part responds to perceived unfairness. Fairness and subsistence enter through the elasticity faced by oil firms, but they pull in opposite directions. Fairness raises the elasticity of discretionary demand because a price increase is partly read as an unfair-pricing signal. Subsistence lowers the share of total demand that can respond. The elasticity of total oil demand is therefore the product of the fairness-amplified discretionary elasticity and the discretionary demand share. Fairness alone lowers the oil markup below the standard New Keynesian benchmark. Subsistence can pull it back to the benchmark or push it above, depending on the discretionary share. The same logic governs Ramsey policy. At moderate fairness, the optimal labor instrument is a smaller subsidy than in the benchmark. When fairness is strong and oil is sufficiently essential, the labor subsidy turns into a tax.

AI.tldr: 本文研究家庭如何从可观察的油价中推断企业成本与加成，以及公平感知和生存性消费需求如何共同影响油企定价、宏观经济和最优政策。研究发现，公平感知会放大需求弹性从而压低油企加成，而生存性需求则会降低弹性，两者共同决定了油品加成率与最优劳动补贴的方向。
AI.research_question: 家庭在观察到油价时如何推断企业边际成本与加成？公平感知与生存性消费需求如何相互作用，影响油企定价、宏观经济均衡及最优政策？
AI.motivation: 油价易观察但难解释：家庭只能看到标价而非企业边际成本，需判断涨价是成本推动还是加成提高。由于部分石油消费（如通勤、取暖）是非自主性的，即使认为价格不公平仍不得不购买，这使得公平感知与生存性需求之间的互动对宏观经济具有重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两部门模型：黏性价格非油部门 + 灵活价格石油部门。家庭通过观测价格和过去感知成本推断边际成本，感知加成决定消费者对价格公平性的判断。石油需求采用Stone-Geary结构，仅自主性消费部分对感知不公平做出反应。
AI.method: 理论建模与解析推导。构建包含公平感知和生存性消费需求的两部门新凯恩斯模型，分析油企定价、加成率和最优Ramsey政策。
AI.findings: （1）公平感知提高自主性需求弹性（涨价被部分解读为不公平定价信号），生存性消费降低可调整需求份额，总需求弹性=公平放大的自主弹性×自主需求份额。（2）仅公平感会降低油企加成至标准新凯恩斯基准以下；生存性消费可将加成拉回基准甚至推高。（3）在适度公平感知下，最优劳动工具为比基准更小的补贴；当公平感强且石油足够必需时，劳动补贴变为税收。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将公平感知与生存性消费需求纳入统一框架，揭示了二者对需求弹性的相反作用机制，拓展了新凯恩斯框架下对大宗商品定价与最优政策的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计油价波动时期的劳动补贴/税收政策提供了理论依据：当公平感知较强且石油消费具有高度生存性时，传统补贴政策可能适得其反，需转向税收工具。

title: Banking Deregulation and Consumption Insurance. E Case of Italy in the Early 1990s

detail.title: Banking Deregulation and Consumption Insurance. E Case of Italy in the Early 1990s

contentType.other: revised chapter from a doctoral dissertation/thesis

detail.abstract: This paper evaluates whether Italian banking deregulation in the early 1990s affected households’ consumption insurance. Using the Bank of Italy’s Survey of Household Income and Wealth (SHIW), the analysis exploits the substantial heterogeneity across households to examine whether structural banking reforms — including the privatisation of the banking sector, the removal of branching restrictions, and the reintroduction of universal banking — altered households’ ability to smooth consumption in response to unanticipated income shocks within a partial insurance framework. The results suggest that banking deregulation significantly improved households’ ability to insure against unanticipated permanent income shocks, while no statistically significant effects are found for transitory shocks. The paper also contributes to identifying the main transmission channels through which banking deregulation influenced household consumption insurance.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了1990年代初意大利银行业放松管制是否影响了家庭消费保险。研究发现，放松管制显著提高了家庭抵御永久性收入冲击的能力，但对暂时性冲击无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 意大利1990年代初的银行业放松管制（包括银行私有化、取消分支限制、重新引入全能银行）是否以及如何影响家庭的消费保险能力？
AI.motivation: 银行业改革可能通过影响信贷供给和金融摩擦，改变家庭应对收入冲击的能力，但相关实证证据不足。本文利用意大利银行业改革的准自然实验，探讨金融自由化的微观经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 部分保险框架（Partial Insurance Framework），区分永久性收入冲击与暂时性收入冲击对消费的影响。
AI.method: 使用意大利央行家庭收入与财富调查（SHIW）数据，利用家庭层面的异质性，在部分保险框架下进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 银行业放松管制显著改善了家庭抵御未预期永久性收入冲击的能力；对暂时性收入冲击则无统计上显著的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了金融发展与消费保险关系的理论理解，揭示了银行业结构改革对家庭风险分担能力的异质性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行业放松管制的福利效应提供了微观证据，提示政策制定者关注金融自由化对家庭经济安全的影响。

title: “Nash Equilibria and Dilemmas of Accountability: A Study of Diplomatic and Criminal Survival Strategies from the Presidency to the Post-Presidency in the DRC”

detail.title: “Nash Equilibria and Dilemmas of Accountability: A Study of Diplomatic and Criminal Survival Strategies from the Presidency to the Post-Presidency in the DRC”

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This study was conducted independently and is purely academic, with no partisan or institutional alignment with any political or judicial actors in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study, as it did not involve human participants, patients, clinical trials, or the collection of personal data. The research is strictly based on the conceptual analysis of publicly available legal texts, historical documentation, and mathematical modeling.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was conducted entirely using the author's own institutional or personal resources.

detail.abstract: This study analyzes the mechanisms of criminal, political, and diplomatic accountability of Joseph Kabila through an innovative, interdisciplinary approach that combines international law, political science, and mathematical modeling. The core of the analysis rests on the concept of the "rebellion pattern," viewed not as a past historical state, but as a latent power structure and an active technology of deterrence. By leveraging game theory, this study demonstrates that the political transition in the Democratic Republic of the Congo produced a stable Nash equilibrium. In this state, the successor government waives judicial prosecution to guarantee institutional stability, while the former leader limits his disruptive capacity as long as his de facto immunity is respected. The application of jurimetrics, via the accountability function Res, confirms that the actor's deterrent power ($Pd$) neutralizes the effectiveness of the legal norm. The findings corroborate Zartman's theory on conflict ripeness: in hybrid states, legality is structurally subordinate to stability. Impunity does not emerge as a systemic failure, but rather as a mathematically calculated cost for maintaining a fragile peace in the Great Lakes region. Ultimately, diplomatic accountability remains a geopolitical adjustment variable, fluctuating according to the imperatives of regional security rather than the principles of universal justice.

AI.tldr: 本文通过国际法、政治学与数学建模的跨学科方法，分析了约瑟夫·卡比拉的刑事、政治和外交问责机制。研究发现，刚果（金）的政治转型形成了稳定的纳什均衡：继任政府放弃司法起诉以换取制度稳定，前领导人则限制其破坏能力以保全事实豁免。通过问责函数Res的司法计量学应用，证实行为体的威慑力量（Pd）能够中和法律规范的有效性。研究支持扎特曼的冲突成熟理论：在混合政体中，合法性在结构上从属于稳定性。有罪不罚并非系统失灵，而是维持大湖区脆弱和平的数学计算成本。
AI.research_question: 在混合政体政治转型中，前领导人的刑事、政治和外交问责机制如何运作？威慑力量如何在法律规范与政治稳定之间发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 探讨刚果（金）等混合政体中，为何前领导人约瑟夫·卡比拉在转型后未被追究责任，揭示有罪不罚现象背后的结构性逻辑和数学机理。
AI.theoretical_framework: "叛乱模式"（作为潜在权力结构与威慑技术）、博弈论（纳什均衡）、扎特曼冲突成熟理论、司法计量学（问责函数Res）。
AI.method: 跨学科方法：结合国际法、政治学与数学建模（博弈论与司法计量学），通过问责函数Res量化分析行为体的威慑力量（Pd）对法律规范有效性的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 政治转型产生了稳定的纳什均衡——继任政府放弃司法起诉以换取稳定，前领导人限制破坏能力以保全豁免。2. 行为体的威慑力量(Pd)能够中和法律规范的有效性。3. 在混合政体中，合法性从属于稳定性。4. 有罪不罚是维持脆弱和平的数学计算成本，而非系统失灵。5. 外交问责是地缘政治调整变量，受区域安全需求驱动而非普遍正义原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 将扎特曼冲突成熟理论扩展至问责机制分析，引入司法计量学量化威慑力量对法律规范的抑制作用，提出"有罪不罚作为稳定成本"的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解混合政体中的问责困境提供分析框架，提示国际社会在推动转型正义时需考虑威慑力量与政治稳定的结构性约束。

title: The Sen Liberal Paradox at Family Scale: A Kernel-Checked Proof-Layer Lift, Its Witness/Audit Boundary, and a Transfer Contract

detail.title: The Sen Liberal Paradox at Family Scale: A Kernel-Checked Proof-Layer Lift, Its Witness/Audit Boundary, and a Transfer Contract
detail.abstract: Finite impossibility witnesses in social choice theory are increasingly delivered as proofcarrying artifacts: a kernel-checked Lean theorem at a base case, plus a CNF certificate audited at the same base case. When such a witness is generalised to a case family, "the witness transferred" is not one claim but two-a Proof-layer transfer of the semantic argument, and a Witness/Audit-layer transfer of the CNF encoding that backed the original certificate-and the two come apart. We demonstrate this layer split for Sen's Liberal Paradox by pairing a kernel-checked positive answer at the Lean Proof layer with an explicit scope wall against the CNF Witness/Audit layer. Concretely, we formalise and verify sen_impossibility_lifts: for any finite case with at least two voters and at least four alternatives, any social welfare function satisfying semantic unanimity (UN) and minimal liberalism (MINLIB) fails SocialAcyclic. The proof ports the Sen24 base-case case-split (two-overlap, one-overlap, disjoint) at the semantic axiom level; its overlap case analysis avoids any universal four-point completion in Fin m, so the hypothesis 4 ≤ m is not consumed. On the negative side, the Lean lift does not automatically upgrade the sen24 CNF certificate into a family-level one: the Witness/Audit layer certifies only the sen24-audited short-cycle encoding no_cycle3 ∧ no_cycle4, whose equivalence to full acyclicity was audited only at four alternatives, and for m ≥ 5 that equivalence does not transfer automatically. The contribution is therefore a Transfer Contract: proof-level transfer is kernel-checked and reaches full acyclicity, while witness-level transfer requires a separately audited encoding contract.

AI.tldr: 本文在Sen的自由主义悖论研究中，将"证明传递"拆分为两个独立层次：Lean内核检查的证明层传递（语义论证）和CNF证书的见证/审计层传递（编码等价性）。作者在证明层实现了完整的传递（对所有有限情形证明Sen悖论成立），但明确指出见证层的传递需要独立审计，不能自动升级。
AI.research_question: 在有限不可能性定理的证明传递中，语义层面的证明传递与CNF编码层面的证书传递是否可以自动统一？
AI.motivation: 现有研究中，有限不可能性定理的证明常常以"带证书的证明工件"形式呈现，但当从一个基础情形推广到一族情形时，"证明被传递"这一说法实际上模糊了语义论证传递与编码认证传递之间的关键区别，二者可能脱节。
AI.theoretical_framework: Sen的不可行性（自由主义悖论）、证明层与见证/审计层的分离（Proof layer vs. Witness/Audit layer）、传递契约（Transfer Contract）
AI.method: 形式化验证：在Lean定理证明器中形式化并验证 sen_impossibility_lifts 定理，将Sen24基础情形的三分支情形分析（双重叠、单重叠、不重叠）提升到语义公理层面，避免使用通用的四点完全性构造。
AI.findings: （1）证明层成功传递：对于任意至少2个投票者、至少4个备选方案的有限情形，满足语义一致性和最小自由主义的任何社会福利函数都违反社会无环性（SocialAcyclic）；（2）见证层不能自动传递：Sen24的CNF证书仅审计了短环编码no_cycle3∧no_cycle4，该编码与完全无环性的等价性仅在4个备选方案下被审计，对m≥5无法自动传递。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次明确区分了有限不可能性定理"证明传递"中的两个独立层次——证明层传递与见证/审计层传递，提出了"传递契约"概念，揭示了语义论证与编码等价性之间的脱节风险。
AI.practical_contributions: 为形式化验证社交选择理论中的不可能性定理提供了方法论指导：需要使用带明确范围墙（scope wall）的传递契约，确保证明层与见证层的责任边界清晰，避免对证书自动升级产生错误信心。

title: The Evolution of Luxury Signaling

detail.title: The Evolution of Luxury Signaling
detail.abstract: Luxury consumption has long been synonymous with social status, distinction, and prestige. This literature review examines how the meaning and mechanisms of luxury signaling have changed over time. Beginning with Thorstein Veblen's theory of conspicuous consumption, the paper explains how visible indicators of wealth historically functioned as symbols of prestige. It then analyzes the contributions of Bagwell and Bernheim, whose work demonstrates that luxury goods derive value not only from their function but also from their ability to signal status through price. The review further investigates the rise of quiet luxury, drawing on the work of Han, Nunes, and Drèze to explain why many affluent consumers increasingly prefer quiet forms of luxury over huge displays of wealth. Finally, connecting with the digital era ,the paper examines how digital technologies, social media, and virtual assets have transformed contemporary status signaling by creating new forms of visibility, attention, and symbolic value. The review finds that while the methods of signaling have shifted from conspicuous logos to more knowledge-based forms of distinction, the underlying hunger for social status remains largely unchanged. Luxury consumption continues to function as a powerful means of communicating status, although the signals themselves have become increasingly abstruse in this era.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于奢侈品消费与地位信号变化的文献综述，从凡勃伦的炫耀性消费理论出发，梳理到数字时代的低调奢华与虚拟资产，指出信号形式虽变，但人们对社会地位的渴望未变。
AI.research_question: 奢侈品消费作为地位信号的含义和机制如何随时间演变？
AI.motivation: 奢侈品消费长期以来被视为社会地位、区分和声望的象征，但其信号机制在数字时代发生了深刻变化，有必要从理论脉络上进行系统梳理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 凡勃伦的炫耀性消费理论、Bagwell和Bernheim的价格信号模型、Han, Nunes和Drèze的安静奢华理论，以及数字时代的虚拟资产与社交媒体地位信号理论。
AI.method: 文献综述（Literature Review），对经典与前沿理论进行梳理与整合。
AI.findings: 地位信号的表达方式从显性的品牌标识转向基于知识的隐性信号（安静奢华），信号本身变得更加晦涩难懂，但人们对社会地位的追求本质上并未改变。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了从古典炫耀性消费到数字时代虚拟地位信号的理论演进脉络，揭示了信号形式变化背后不变的驱动力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为奢侈品品牌在数字时代的营销策略提供理论指导，提示品牌关注信号形式从显性到隐性的转变，以及社交媒体和虚拟资产等新渠道的重要性。

title: Equilibrium Self-Selection in Pass-Fail Tests
affiliations: University of Turin - Department of Economics

detail.title: Equilibrium Self-Selection in Pass-Fail Tests
detail.abstract: Whether taking an optional pass-fail test is optimal depends on pass probabilities, which increase in productivity and are each individual's private information, and on the wages earned when passing or failing the test, which are conditional expectations formed about productivity by employers who know its distribution in the population subset that chooses to take the test. This paper models the relevant rational-expectations equilibrium and shows that plausible pass-probability functions imply that as a difficult test becomes more difficult, taking it becomes more appealing for low-productivity individuals who are likely to fail. Along with other features of real-life tests, this rationalizes the very low success rates of some optional admission and publication processes.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个理性预期均衡模型，研究在可选通过-失败测试中，个体是否参加测试的最优决策。当测试变得更难时，低生产率个体反而更有动力参加测试，这解释了现实中一些可选性录取和发表过程极低成功率的现象。
AI.research_question: 个体在可选通过-失败测试中，是否参加测试的最优决策机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现实中，一些可选的录取测试（如资格考试）或发表过程（如期刊审稿）的成功率极低，传统理论难以解释为何低能力个体明知通过概率很低却仍然选择参加测试。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性预期均衡理论；信号理论；贝叶斯信念更新
AI.method: 理论建模与数学推导
AI.findings: 当测试难度增加时，通过概率会降低，但低生产率个体参加测试反而变得更有吸引力。这是因为测试难度提高后，雇主（或审核者）对通过者的预期生产率会更高（正向选择），但与此同时，对未通过者的预期生产率会大幅下降，这使得低生产率个体为了避免被归入"未参加测试者"群体（即被默认为低能力），宁愿选择参加测试博取一线机会，即使通过概率很低。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"可选测试"中的逆向选择悖论：测试越难，低能力者越有动力参加，导致通过率进一步降低。完善了信号博弈中关于测试参与决策的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了为何有些资格考试通过率极低（如律师资格、注册会计师等），以及顶级期刊为何面临大量低质量投稿；为设计更合理的筛选机制提供了理论依据。

title: Political Ideology, Environmental Policy Adaptation, and Greenhouse Gas Emissions
affiliations: , Thompson Rivers University and Thompson Rivers University

detail.title: Political Ideology, Environmental Policy Adaptation, and Greenhouse Gas Emissions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no financial or non‐financial conflicts of interest related to this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: We acknowledge financial support from the Sustainability Research Cluster, Bob Gaglardi School of Business and Economics, Thompson Rivers University, which funded the hiring of a research assistant for this project.

detail.abstract: It is widely believed that the willingness to adopt stringent environmental and energy policies, as well as to participate in global climate agreements, is influenced by the political ideology of the party in power. This paper examines how political ideology affects both the adoption and effectiveness of environmental policies, including energy policies, in reducing greenhouse gas emissions (GHGE) across OECD countries. Specifically, we investigate whether the political ideology of ruling parties influences a country's decision to join the global climate action agenda, pursue domestic climate initiatives, and how these choices translate into measurable emission reductions. Using panel data for 31 OECD countries from 1995 to 2021, we employ contemporaneous, lag, and threshold models within the STIRPAT framework. We find no significant evidence that political ideology alone determines the adoption of global environmental policies. However, when coupled with strong domestic and global environmental policy adaptation and implementation, political ideology contributes significantly to reductions in GHGE. These results are robust across models and alternative estimation techniques. Our findings highlight the economic and policy importance of moving beyond symbolic participation toward genuine climate action, aligning national energy policies with international commitments, and integrating political economy considerations into climate policy design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究政治意识形态如何影响OECD国家环境政策的采纳与效力，发现政治意识形态本身不决定全球环境政策采纳，但与强力的国内外政策执行结合时能显著降低温室气体排放。
AI.research_question: 政治意识形态如何影响OECD国家环境政策的采纳及其在减少温室气体排放方面的有效性？
AI.motivation: 普遍认为执政党的政治意识形态影响国家采纳严格环境与能源政策及参与全球气候协议的意愿，但缺乏系统的实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: STIRPAT框架（随机环境影响评估模型），结合同时期模型、滞后模型和阈值模型。
AI.method: 使用1995-2021年31个OECD国家的面板数据，采用同时期、滞后和阈值模型，并进行多种替代估计技术的稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 政治意识形态单独并不显著决定全球环境政策的采纳；但当与强有力的国内外环境政策制定与执行相结合时，政治意识形态对减少温室气体排放有显著贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政治意识形态与环境政策效力之间的条件性关系，即意识形态的作用依赖于政策的实际执行力度，为政治经济学与环境治理交叉研究提供新见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调超越象征性参与、切实采取气候行动的重要性，建议将国家能源政策与国际承诺对齐，并在气候政策设计中整合政治经济学考量。

title: To what Extent has the Single-use Plastic (SUP) ban Implemented by Karnataka State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB), in 2022 Helped Reduce the Overconsumption of Single-use Plastic?

detail.title: To what Extent has the Single-use Plastic (SUP) ban Implemented by Karnataka State Pollution Control Board (KSPCB), in 2022 Helped Reduce the Overconsumption of Single-use Plastic?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Survey data was collected voluntarily and anonymously via Google Forms. No formal ethics approval was required.

detail.abstract:
Bengaluru generates over 600 tonnes of plastic waste every single day. Despite this, the Karnataka State Pollution Control Board's 2022 ban on single-use plastics has received surprisingly little academic attention. This paper attempts to fill that gap by asking a simple question: has the ban actually worked?

Drawing on a survey of 104 Bengaluru residents alongside government reports and newspaper data, this paper finds that the answer is complicated. Plastic waste did fall after the ban came into effect, larger retailers have largely complied. But in local markets and among lower-income vendors, little has changed. Alternatives are too expensive, enforcement is inconsistent, and awareness of what is actually banned remains patchy. The result is a ban that works well for some and barely at all for others.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了卡纳塔克邦2022年一次性塑料禁令在班加罗尔的实际执行效果。通过对104位居民的调查及政府报告、报纸数据的分析发现，禁令效果复杂：大型零售商基本遵守，塑料垃圾有所减少；但在本地市场及低收入商贩中几乎无变化，原因是替代品昂贵、执法不一致、民众对禁令内容认知模糊。
AI.research_question: 卡纳塔克邦2022年一次性塑料禁令在班加罗尔是否真正奏效？
AI.motivation: 班加罗尔每日产生超过600吨塑料垃圾，但该禁令几乎没有获得学术关注，存在研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境政策执行理论、环境规制合规性理论
AI.method: 对104名班加罗尔居民的问卷调查，辅以政府报告和报纸数据分析。
AI.findings: 禁令实施后塑料垃圾总量有所下降，大型零售商合规程度高；但本地市场和低收入商贩几乎未受影响，替代品成本高、执法不一致、公众对禁令内容的认知不足是主要原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了环境政策在不同社会经济群体间执行效果的差异性，丰富了对发展中国家塑料禁令"表面合规"现象的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改进塑料禁令执行的具体建议：需降低替代品成本、加强执法一致性、提高公众认知度，并关注政策对不同群体的差异化影响。

title: Labor Market Power over the Business Cycle

detail.title: Labor Market Power over the Business Cycle
detail.abstract: I study the cyclicality of labor market concentration and wage markdowns. Using linked employer-employee data from Portugal, I document novel facts that existing models cannot explain: (a) local labor market concentration is countercyclical; (b) wages move closer to marginal revenue products of labor during booms; and (c) markdown dispersion across producers rises in recessions. Using an IV strategy, I show that cyclical concentration accounts for 7 percent of procyclical firm pay. To explain these patterns, I develop an oligopsony model with differentiated jobs, strategic hiring, and endogenous business entry. The model links cyclical concentration to earning dynamics and labor misallocation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了劳动力市场集中度和工资加成的周期性变化，发现集中度呈反周期、工资在繁荣期更接近边际产出、加成离散度在衰退期上升，并提出寡头垄断模型解释这些现象。
AI.research_question: 劳动力市场集中度和工资加成的周期性特征是什么？企业薪酬的顺周期性能否由周期性集中度解释？
AI.motivation: 现有模型无法解释劳动力市场集中度反周期、工资在繁荣期更接近边际产出、加成离散度在衰退期上升等现象，需建立新理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 寡头垄断模型（Oligopsony model），包含差异化职位、战略性招聘和内生企业进入。
AI.method: 使用葡萄牙雇主-雇员匹配数据，采用工具变量（IV）策略进行因果推断。
AI.findings: (a) 劳动力市场集中度呈反周期；(b) 繁荣期工资更接近劳动的边际产出；(c) 衰退期加成离散度上升；(d) 周期性集中度解释了企业薪酬顺周期变化的7%。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了将劳动力市场集中度周期性与工资动态、劳动力错配联系起来的寡头垄断理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了劳动力市场结构周期性变化对企业薪酬和资源配置效率的影响，为宏观经济政策提供参考。

title: Can Financial News Sentiment Predict Next-Day Price Movement Direction For NSE-Listed Large-Cap Stocks?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Can Financial News Sentiment Predict Next-Day Price Movement Direction For NSE-Listed Large-Cap Stocks?
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether financial news sentiment can predict the next-day price direction of largecap stocks listed on the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE). Using a five-year historical window from January 1, 2021, to December 31, 2025, we built an advanced natural language processing (NLP) pipeline to clean and analyze headlines from Business Standard. Headlines were normalized using Python's NLTK package under the Loughran-McDonald financial dictionary guidelines to preserve critical directional words. Sentiment scores were generated using FinBERT, a deep-learning AI transformer fine-tuned for corporate finance text. To eliminate forward-looking data leakage, any news published after the 03:30 PM IST NSE closing bell was algorithmically rolled into the next trading day, resulting in a clean dataset of 4,205 active daily records. Stationarity was confirmed across all 13 equities using the Augmented Dickey-Fuller (ADF) test (𝑝 < 0.05). Bivariate Granger Causality tests revealed that news sentiment does not cause a global, uniform forecasting edge across all large-cap stocks, confirming the Semi-Strong Form of the Efficient Market Hypothesis for heavily traded assets like RELIANCE and HDFCBANK. However, a significant localized exception was discovered for SUNPHARMA (𝑝 = 0.01109), proving that technical sectors face an informational diffusion delay with an optimal lookback lag of 2 trading days. Finally, an out-of-sample Random Forest Classifier was trained using a chronological 80/20 train/test split. The machine learning model demonstrated strong predictive power on unseen 2025 data, peaking at a 60.00% directional accuracy for both HINDUNILVR and ULTRACEMCO, and a 55.56% accuracy with a 60.00% Precision Score for INFY. These findings provide clear evidence that text-driven trading signals can capture high-precision arbitrage windows in select sectors of emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了金融新闻情绪是否能预测印度NSE大盘股的次日价格方向。利用FinBERT进行情感分析，结合格兰杰因果检验和随机森林分类器，发现新闻情绪对大多数大盘股无全局预测能力（支持半强有效市场假说），但在SUNPHARMA等特定行业股票中存在显著的信息扩散延迟，且机器学习模型在部分股票上达到了60%的方向预测准确率。
AI.research_question: 金融新闻情绪能否预测印度NSE大盘股的次日价格方向？
AI.motivation: 检验新兴市场中新闻情绪对股票价格的预测能力，验证半强有效市场假说在印度大盘股市场中的适用性，并探索是否存在因信息扩散延迟而产生的套利机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半强有效市场假说（Semi-Strong Form EMH）、信息扩散延迟理论、金融市场情绪与资产定价理论。
AI.method: 使用FinBERT（基于BERT的金融领域微调Transformer模型）进行新闻情感打分；Python NLTK + Loughran-McDonald金融词典进行文本清洗；增强迪基-福勒（ADF）检验验证平稳性；双变量格兰杰因果检验（Granger Causality Test）检验情感与价格方向的因果关系；随机森林分类器（Random Forest Classifier）进行样本外预测（80/20时间序列划分）。
AI.findings: （1）新闻情绪对大多数大盘股（如RELIANCE、HDFCBANK）无全局预测能力，支持半强有效市场假说；（2）SUNPHARMA存在显著的信息扩散延迟（p=0.01109），最优滞后窗口为2个交易日；（3）样本外随机森林模型在HINDUNILVR和ULTRACEMCO上达到60.00%的方向预测准确率，在INFY上达到55.56%准确率及60.00%的精确率。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了半强有效市场假说在印度大型新兴市场的适用性，同时发现了该假说的局部例外——特定技术板块存在信息扩散延迟，为市场微观结构理论和信息传播异质性提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量化交易策略提供了可操作的文本驱动交易信号框架，证明基于FinBERT情感分析的机器学习模型能够在特定板块（如制药、消费品）捕获高精度套利窗口，对新兴市场的算法交易实践具有直接指导意义。

title: Information and Preferences in Shareholder Voting
affiliations: Rice University, Duke University- Fuqua School of Business and Duke University, Fuqua School of Business

detail.title: Information and Preferences in Shareholder Voting
detail.abstract: We develop a structural model of shareholder voting with incomplete information about proposal quality. We show that preferences and information are not separately identified from individual voting patterns alone: correlated information and strategic voting jointly determine the mapping from preferences to votes. Identification arises through cross-shareholder voting correlations and differential exposure to public information across investor types. Estimating the model on mutual fund voting, we recover institution-level information precision and information-corrected preference parameters. Despite higher support for management, blockholders' preferences are close to those of dispersed shareholders. Equalizing information across investor types has a larger effect on voting than equalizing preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个股东投票的结构模型，解决了偏好与信息无法从个人投票模式中单独识别的问题。通过对共同基金投票数据的估计，发现信息差异对投票行为的影响大于偏好的差异。
AI.research_question: 如何从股东投票中分离出信息与偏好对投票行为的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统的投票分析无法区分股东投票是源于真实偏好差异还是信息不对称，这阻碍了对公司治理机制的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全信息下的股东投票结构模型，结合相关信息和策略投票理论。
AI.method: 构建结构模型，利用共同基金投票数据进行估计，通过跨股东投票相关性和不同投资者类型对公共信息的暴露差异来实现识别。
AI.findings: 1）大股东的偏好与分散股东接近；2）信息差异对投票行为的影响大于偏好差异；3）大股东对管理层支持度更高是由于其信息更精准。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从理论和实证上分离了股东投票中信息与偏好的作用，建立了不完全信息投票的识别框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和公司治理实践提供了启示：改善信息不对称（如平等化信息获取）对投票结果的影响可能比改变股东偏好更有效。

title: Using Option Contracts to Stabilize Markets and Reduce Drought-Induced Risks for Pastoralist Households
affiliations: Universidad Politécnica de Madrid, College of Agriculture & Natural Resources and Universidad Politécnica de Madrid

detail.title: Using Option Contracts to Stabilize Markets and Reduce Drought-Induced Risks for Pastoralist Households

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None of the co-authors have a material or financial interest in the subject of the research.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was conducted as part of the PRISMA Project (Research and Innovation for Productive, Resilient and Healthy Agro-Pastoral Systems in West Africa Project), funded by the European Union’s DeSIRA Initiative (Grant Agreement No. FOOD/2021/425-850) and co-funded by the Spanish Agency for International Development Cooperation (AECID).

detail.abstract: Drought is a major threat for pastoralists in developing countries who depend on grazingbased livestock rearing. In the absence of adequate financial risk management tools, extreme dry spells expose livestock-dependent households to the risk of falling into a poverty trap. Option contracts that create the right to purchase livestock feed at a predetermined price could serve to both mitigate that risk and smooth volatility in feed and livestock markets that are destabilized when drought occurs. We present a theoretical framework for valuing such option contracts on both the individual buyer (pastoralist) and individual seller (feed provider) sides. We use a numerical simulation model based on data from the Sahelian region of West Africa to assess the potential viability of such option contracts and examine their impact on feed and livestock price volatility. That numerical analysis indicates that establishing option contracts is feasible in principle, that option contracts could increase pastoralists' drought-year incomes by as much as 17% at a cost of a 5% reduction in normalyear incomes, and that option contracts help stabilize feed and livestock markets. We discuss practical considerations affecting implementation of these contracts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对发展中国家牧民的饲料期权合约设计，该合约允许牧民在干旱时以预定价格购买饲料，理论上可同时降低牧民贫困风险和稳定饲料与牲畜市场价格。基于西非萨赫勒地区数据的数值模拟显示，该合约原则可行，可使牧民干旱年收入提升17%，正常年收入仅下降5%，并有助于稳定市场价格。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种期权合约（饲料购买权）来帮助发展中国家的牧民应对干旱风险，同时稳定饲料和牲畜市场的价格波动？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家牧民缺乏有效的金融风险管理工具，极端干旱可能导致其陷入贫困陷阱；同时干旱引发的饲料短缺会进一步加剧饲料和牲畜市场的价格不稳定，亟需一种机制来同时缓解个体风险和市场波动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期权定价理论、买方（牧民）与卖方（饲料供应商）双边的期权合约价值评估框架、贫困陷阱理论。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建双边视角下的饲料期权合约价值评估框架；数值模拟：基于西非萨赫勒地区数据进行参数校准和情景分析。
AI.findings: 1) 饲料期权合约在原则上是可行的；2) 该合约可使牧民干旱年收入提高17%，正常年收入仅减少5%；3) 合约有助于稳定饲料和牲畜市场的价格波动。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了针对发展中国家牧民干旱风险管理的饲料期权合约的理论定价框架，并从买方和卖方双边角度进行价值评估，拓展了期权理论在农业风险管理领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家牧民提供了一种创新的金融风险管理工具，可缓解干旱导致的贫困陷阱问题；同时通过稳定饲料和牲畜市场价格，对农业市场政策和金融产品设计具有实践指导意义。

title: Women’s Work-Life Balance in India
affiliations: The University of Burdwan, University of Burdwan - Department of Economics and University of Burdwan

detail.title: Women’s Work-Life Balance in India

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that there are no conflicts of interest regarding the publication of this study. The authors have no financial or personal relationships with other people or organizations that could inappropriately influence the content of the manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, biological materials, or data. Therefore, ethical approval and consent to participate are not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: No financial support or funding was received for conducting this study. The research was self-initiated and carried out without any sponsorship from institutions, organizations, or individuals.

detail.abstract: Women across the globe are always trying to balance their work and personal life. Whether engaged in domestic chores alone or saddled with the 'double burden' of productive work and household work, they frequently suffer from time poverty and are permanently engaged in a futile effort to balance 'work' and life. In this paper we explore the issue of work life balance among females in India using Time Use Survey data. We devise a Work/Life Balance index and estimate the incidence and magnitude of work life (im)balance using this index. We also try to identify drivers of work life balance from binary and multinomial logistic regressions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用印度时间使用调查数据，构建了工作/生活平衡指数，分析了印度女性工作与生活失衡的普遍程度、严重程度及其驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 印度女性的工作与生活平衡状况如何？哪些因素驱动了这种平衡或不平衡？
AI.motivation: 全球女性普遍面临工作与家庭生活的双重负担，尤其是印度女性，经常陷入时间贫困和工作生活失衡的困境，但相关实证研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作-生活平衡理论、时间贫困理论、双重负担理论
AI.method: 使用印度时间使用调查数据，构建工作/生活平衡指数，通过二元和多项逻辑回归识别驱动因素。
AI.findings: 揭示了印度女性工作生活失衡的发生率和严重程度，并识别了影响平衡状态的关键社会经济驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了衡量工作生活平衡的量化指数，丰富了发展中国家女性工作-生活平衡的理论框架和实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改善印度女性工作生活平衡的实证依据，有助于制定针对性的支持政策。

title: Against the Duplicity Thesis: Pakistan Army as Ideological Defender in the American War on Terror

detail.title: Against the Duplicity Thesis: Pakistan Army as Ideological Defender in the American War on Terror
detail.abstract:
The dominant academic consensus characterizes Pakistan's conduct during the American War on Terror as institutionalized duplicity — simultaneously fighting and sheltering the Taliban while extracting American funding. This paper argues that the "duplicity thesis" fundamentally misreads the institutional logic of the Pakistan Army.

Drawing on declassified U.S. government records, GAO audit data, IMF documentation, and published military doctrine studies, the paper advances three arguments. First, Pakistan's ideological deformation was externally produced: the Treaty of Darin (1915) created the Saudi state, whose petrodollar revenues subsequently funded Deobandi-Wahhabi madrassa expansion across Pakistan — a British imperial act, not a Pakistani civilizational choice. Second, the Army's institutional identity is rooted in Iqbal's Persian-Sufi synthesis and is demonstrably Barelvi-compatible; Zia ul-Haq's Deobandization was a Cold War patronage rupture, not the institutional norm. Third, Pervez Musharraf extracted $23 billion in economic relief — including $5.56 billion in Coalition Support Funds (81% of the global program), $12.5 billion in Paris Club debt restructuring, and nuclear sanctions lifted within 36 days of 9/11 — while simultaneously dismantling Deobandi extremist organizations and culminating in the Lal Masjid operation of July 2007. The actual vector of Saudi ideological capture in Pakistan has been civilian politicians, most notably Nawaz Sharif, whose Saudi nexus is documented in the Panama Papers. Reframing the Army as a civilizational defender restores analytical clarity to a debate paralyzed by the duplicity thesis.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了关于巴基斯坦在"美国反恐战争"中行为的"双重性论调"，认为该论调误读了巴基斯坦军队的制度逻辑。通过解密的美国政府文件、GAO审计数据、IMF文件等，论文提出三个核心论点：巴基斯坦的意识形态变形是外部（英国殖民和沙特）造成的；军队的制度身份根植于伊克巴尔的波斯-苏菲传统而非德奥班德主义；穆沙拉夫时期在获取230亿美元经济援助的同时实际打击了极端组织。文章主张将巴基斯坦军队重新定位为"文明捍卫者"。
AI.research_question: 如何重新理解巴基斯坦军队在反恐战争中的行为逻辑？"双重性论调"（即巴基斯坦同时打击和庇护塔利班）是否准确描述了巴基斯坦的制度现实？
AI.motivation: 挑战学术界将巴基斯坦行为描述为"制度化的双重性"的主流共识，认为这种解读从根本上误读了巴基斯坦军队的制度逻辑，导致分析陷入僵局。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度逻辑理论；外部嵌入的意识形态变形理论；军队制度身份与文明认同的关系理论。
AI.method: 多来源档案分析，利用解密的美国政府记录、政府问责局（GAO）审计数据、IMF文件以及已发表的军事条令研究。
AI.findings: 1. 巴基斯坦的意识形态变形是外部产生的：1915年《达林条约》造就沙特政权，其石油美元资助了巴基斯坦境内的德奥班德-瓦哈比宗教学校扩张，这是英国帝国行为的结果而非巴基斯坦的文明选择。2. 军队的制度身份根植于伊克巴尔的波斯-苏菲综合传统，明显与巴雷尔维派兼容；齐亚·哈克的德奥班德化是冷战时期赞助关系的中断，而非制度常态。3. 穆沙拉夫在获得约230亿美元经济援助的同时拆解了德奥班德极端组织，并最终实施了2007年7月的红色清真寺行动。沙特意识形态在巴基斯坦的真正载体是文职政客，尤其是纳瓦兹·谢里夫。
AI.theory_contributions: 对"双重性论调"进行系统性反驳，提出理解巴基斯坦军队行为的替代性制度逻辑框架，将地缘政治与文明/意识形态维度结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者重新理解巴基斯坦在反恐和安全事务中的行为提供新视角，有助于避免基于"双重性论调"的无效互动策略。

title: AI-powered Educational Technologies and Student Learning Outcomes in Universities
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: AI-powered Educational Technologies and Student Learning Outcomes in Universities
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-powered educational technologies have increasingly transformed university education by improving instructional delivery, learning personalization, academic assessment, and student engagement. Universities worldwide are adopting intelligent educational systems such as adaptive learning platforms, intelligent tutoring systems, predictive learning analytics, automated assessment tools, and generative AI applications to strengthen teaching effectiveness and improve student learning outcomes.
