detail.title: BRICS 확장에 따른 경제 블록화 가능성과 한국의 정책 방향 연구(A Study on the Possibility of Economic Bloc Formation of BRICS+ and Policy Implications for South Korea)

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: With the expansion of BRICS into BRICS+ in 2024, it has shown the potential for establishing a global order led by Global South countries. BRICs, officially launched in 2009 with four countries (China, Russia, India, Brazil), approved the accession of four new member countries (UAE, Egypt, Iran, Ethiopia) for the first time in 13 years since South Africa joined in 2011, and Indonesia formally joined as a member in 2025. Consequently, as of 2023, BRICS+ is a massive economic bloc, accounting for 28.1% of global GDP and 48.7% of the world’s population. Discussions are underway as to whether it will emerge as a new alternative to Western-centric economic cooperation, such as the G7, and the Bretton Woods financial order. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文探讨BRICS+作为全球南方国家主导的潜在新全球秩序，分析其经济规模与影响力，以及能否成为G7和布雷顿森林体系之外的替代方案。
AI.research_question: BRICS+能否成为西方中心主义经济合作（如G7及布雷顿森林金融秩序）的新替代方案？
AI.motivation: 2024年BRICS扩容为BRICS+后，经济体量显著增长（占全球GDP 28.1%、人口48.7%），引发其是否将重构全球秩序的讨论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球秩序转型理论、南南合作理论、替代性经济治理框架
AI.method: 文本分析（基于公开经济数据与历史制度分析）
AI.findings: BRICS+是一个庞大的经济集团，具备挑战西方主导秩序的经济基础，但其能否成为真正替代方案仍有待观察。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了全球治理研究中关于非西方经济集团替代性角色的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解全球南方国家合作及国际秩序多极化趋势提供现实依据。

title: Information-Theoretic Limits of Reliability and Scaling in Language Models
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore

detail.title: Information-Theoretic Limits of Reliability and Scaling in Language Models

publicationDetails.journalName: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are evaluated as though perfect reliability is achievable for any task given sufficient scale. We show this assumption is information-theoretically unjustified. Every generative task has a reliability ceiling that no model can exceed, determined by how much output uncertainty is resolvable from observable context. The gap decomposes into a resolvable component closable with additional context and a subjective component inherent to task ambiguity. Autoregressive generation further degrades this ceiling at a rate governed by the task's dependency kernel, which quantifies inter-token correlations in the output. From these two primitives, we derive a first-principles scaling law where LLM performance is bottlenecked by the scarcer resource: training data or model capacity. This law recovers the Chinchilla scaling law as a special case and provides a structural account of when scaling improves reliability. Beyond scaling, our framework unifies diverse practical phenomena, such as the benefits of retrieval-augmentation and the spectral mechanics of catastrophic forgetting. Our work formalizes the resource-complexity tradeoffs that govern model performance across domains, offering a unified theory of performance limits in generative language models.

AI.tldr: 本文从信息论角度证明了大型语言模型在任何生成任务上都存在不可逾越的可靠性上限，推导了首个基于第一性原理的缩放定律，并统一解释了检索增强、灾难性遗忘等多样化现象。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型在生成任务中是否存在信息理论上的性能上限？如果有，其决定因素和缩放规律是什么？
AI.motivation: 当前评估LLM时隐含假设：只要规模足够大，任何任务都能达到完美可靠性。作者认为这一假设在信息论上不成立，需要从第一性原理出发揭示LLM的固有性能极限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息论（特别是输出不确定性的可解析性）、依赖核（dependency kernel，量化输出中token间相关性）、资源-复杂度权衡（resource-complexity tradeoffs）
AI.method: 理论推导：从信息论第一性原理出发，定义可靠性上限、可解析分量与主观分量，引入依赖核概念，推导包含训练数据与模型容量的缩放定律。
AI.findings: 1）每个生成任务都存在LLM无法超越的可靠性上限；2）上限分为可解析分量（可通过增加上下文缩小）和主观分量（任务固有歧义）；3）自回归生成会进一步降低该上限，退化速率由依赖核决定；4）提出的缩放定律中，LLM性能受限于更稀缺的资源（训练数据或模型容量），Chinchilla缩放定律是其特例；5）框架统一解释了检索增强、灾难性遗忘等现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个基于信息论第一性原理的LLM性能上限理论，给出了统一的缩放定律框架，将Chinchilla定律作为特例纳入，并为检索增强、灾难性遗忘等现象提供了结构性解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解何时扩大规模能真正提升可靠性提供了理论指导，帮助从业者识别模型性能瓶颈是源于数据不足还是容量不足，从而更有效地分配资源。

title: Do Wage Floors Increase Employment Risk for Workers with Disabilities? Evidence from Minimum Wage Increases and Subminimum Wage Repeal
affiliations: Stockton University,  and Rutgers University

detail.title: Do Wage Floors Increase Employment Risk for Workers with Disabilities? Evidence from Minimum Wage Increases and Subminimum Wage Repeal
detail.abstract:
People with disabilities are disproportionately represented in low-wage work, raising concerns that higher wage floors may reduce their employment opportunities, particularly for workers with more severe disabilities. We examine the effects of state minimum wage increases and state subminimum wage terminations on employment outcomes for people with disabilities using American Community Survey data from 2010–2023. We find little evidence that minimum wage increases reduce employment or labor force participation among people with disabilities, including those with more severe disabilities. While many estimates are statistically imprecise, confidence intervals generally rule out economically meaningful negative employment effects. We likewise find no evidence that terminating subminimum wages reduces employment opportunities for affected workers, and some estimates suggest positive employment effects for groups most likely to have been employed under subminimum wage arrangements. These gains may reflect complementary policies that often accompany repeal, such as Employment First initiatives. Overall, the results provide little support for the view that higher wage floors create disproportionate employment barriers for people with disabilities.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2010-2023年美国社区调查数据，研究发现最低工资上调及废除次最低工资制度对残疾人的就业和劳动力参与没有显著负面影响，甚至对部分群体有积极效应。
AI.research_question: 提高最低工资（包括废除次最低工资制度）如何影响残疾人的就业结果？
AI.motivation: 残疾人群体在低收入工作中占比过高，因此担心提高工资下限可能减少他们的就业机会，尤其是重度残疾者。这一担忧缺乏充分的实证证据支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最低工资理论；劳动力市场歧视与残疾就业理论；次最低工资制度（如特殊工资证书）对残疾工人就业的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用2010-2023年美国社区调查（ACS）数据，采用双重差分等计量方法，分析州级最低工资上调及州级次最低工资制度废除对残疾人就业结果的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 最低工资增加并未显著降低残疾人的就业或劳动参与率，包括重度残疾者；2. 统计上虽不精确，但置信区间排除了具有经济意义的负面就业效应；3. 废除次最低工资制度未减少就业机会，反而对最可能受影响的群体有积极就业效应，这可能与配套政策（如Employment First倡议）有关。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了“高工资下限会 disproportionately 伤害残疾人就业”的传统观点，补充了最低工资与弱势群体就业关系的理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据：提高最低工资和废除次最低工资制度不会对残疾人就业造成显著负面冲击，且废除后配合就业优先政策可产生积极效果。

title: Place Marketing or Civic Information? Classifying Municipal Tweets using Machine Learning
affiliations: Lund University - Department of Economics, Research Institute of Industrial Economics (IFN), Lund University - Department of Economics and Lund University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Place Marketing or Civic Information? Classifying Municipal Tweets using Machine Learning

declarations.funderStatement: Financial support from KEFU (Rådet för kommunalekonomisk forskning och utbildning) at Lund University School of Economics and Management is gratefully acknowledged.

publicationDetails.journalName: Research Institute of Industrial Economics (IFN) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: How do municipalities use social media? For place marketing, civic information, or dialogue with citizens? We address this question by classifying 35,930 tweets from 15 municipal Twitter accounts in the Skåne region of Sweden, using a machine learning algorithm trained on manually annotated data. Tweets are classified along two dimensions: whether they contain place marketing content and whether they contain civic information, yielding four categories. Our findings show that place marketing content declined substantially over the period studied, from nearly 40 percent of tweets in 2009 to just above 20 percent in 2018. In contrast, civic information and direct dialogue with citizens increased. These results suggest that the rise of social media has not trapped municipalities in a zero-sum place marketing arms race. Instead, municipalities appeared to be using Twitter increasingly as a channel for civic communication, with implications for how scholars and practitioners understand the evolving role of social media in place branding.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过机器学习分类35,930条瑞典15个市政Twitter账户的推文，发现2009-2018年间地方营销内容占比从近40%下降至20%以上，而公民信息和直接对话增加，表明市政当局正越来越多地将社交媒体用于公民沟通而非营销竞争。
AI.research_question: 市政当局如何使用社交媒体？是用于地方营销、公民信息传播，还是与公民对话？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体兴起后，市政当局是否陷入零和地方营销竞赛？需要实证检验市政Twitter账号的实际使用模式及其演变趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地方品牌化理论、社交媒体治理理论、零和竞争假设
AI.method: 基于人工标注训练机器学习算法，对瑞典斯科讷地区15个市政账户2009-2018年间35,930条推文进行分类，沿"地方营销内容"和"公民信息"两个维度划分四类。
AI.findings: 1) 地方营销内容从2009年近40%降至2018年20%以上；2) 公民信息和直接对话比例上升；3) 市政当局未陷入零和地方营销竞赛，而是将Twitter日益作为公民沟通渠道使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了社交媒体必然加剧地方营销竞赛的假设，揭示了社交媒体在市政治理中从营销工具向公民沟通平台演变的规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市政管理者提供了社交媒体使用策略的实证依据，建议优先发展公民沟通功能而非单纯进行地方营销。

title: 글로벌 질서 변동과 새로운 북방전략 연구(The Changing Global Order and Korea’s New Northern Strategy)
affiliations: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy, Korea Institute for International Economic Policy, Korea Institute for International Economic Policy, Korea Institute for International Economic Policy, Hankuk University of Foreign Studies and Hanshin University

detail.title: 글로벌 질서 변동과 새로운 북방전략 연구(The Changing Global Order and Korea’s New Northern Strategy)

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study’s core objective is to identify the direction and policy tasks for a new Northern Strategy amid the shifting global order. This report focuses its analysis on three fundamental aspects, striving to ensure consistency within its content. First, it comprehensively examines the new external environment and conditions for cooperation between South Korea and Northern countries in the era of global order restructuring in 2025. Second, it comprehensively evaluates the 35 years of Northern Policy implemented since the establishment of diplomatic relations with the Soviet Union in 1990, identifying key achievements, challenges, and future cooperation needs. Third, based on these new demands for cooperation, it analyzes the economic impact of the Northern Strategy. By synthesizing the results of this analysis, it proposes a new direction for the Northern Strategy and a plan for managing neighboring countries. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在全球秩序变动背景下，韩国新北方战略的方向与政策任务，回顾了1990年以来35年北方政策的成果与挑战，并基于经济影响分析提出新战略方向与邻国管理方案。
AI.research_question: 在全球秩序重构的时代，韩国应如何调整其北方战略的方向与政策任务？
AI.motivation: 全球秩序正在发生深刻变化，韩国原有的北方政策（自1990年与苏联建交以来已实施35年）面临新的外部环境和合作条件，需要系统评估过去成效并明确未来方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际秩序重构理论、区域合作经济学、北方政策的历史制度分析。
AI.method: 综合文献分析与政策评估，结合外部环境扫描、历史政策回顾（1990-2025）、经济影响分析等三方面进行系统分析。
AI.findings: 1）2025年全球秩序重构为韩国的北方合作带来新的外部环境与条件；2）过去35年的北方政策在取得一定成果的同时也面临诸多挑战，新的合作需求正在涌现；3）北方战略具有显著的经济影响，需要基于此提出新的战略方向与邻国管理方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 为国际秩序变动下的区域合作政策研究提供了从历史评估到未来战略制定的系统分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国及类似国家在全球秩序转型期制定和调整区域合作战略（尤其是面向北方国家的战略）提供了政策参考和具体任务方向。

title: Can You Judge without Doing? The Conditions for Decoupling Expertise in Evaluation from Production
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - NUS Business School and INSEAD

detail.title: Can You Judge without Doing? The Conditions for Decoupling Expertise in Evaluation from Production
detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used to produce knowledge work, a widespread worry is that human competence at evaluating the results could decline. For instance, if students never write code, the concern is that they will be unable to judge the code an AI writes for them. Yet evaluation without production is also routine: film critics judge cinematography without operating cameras, and wine critics rate vintages they could not make. We resolve this tension with a framework for analysing the Decoupling of Expertise in Evaluation and Production (DEEP), which specifies when production experience is necessary for competent evaluation and when it is not. We first separate two regimes of evaluation: in Regime 1, quality is fully determined by observable artefact features; in Regime 2, quality also depends on process attributes the finished artefact does not reveal. Next, we ask whether the information evaluators require in either regime can be acquired vicariously or only by producing. This framework predicts that the decline in human evaluative capabilities arising from cessation of production will be concentrated rather than universal. We also specify possible remedies by regime: training through simulation in Regime 1, process documentation in Regime 2, and modest quantities of production-for-calibration when these measures are infeasible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"评价与生产专长解耦"(DEEP)框架，区分了两种评价机制——品质完全由可观察特征决定（机制1）与品质还依赖于过程属性（机制2），并分析了在何种情况下停止生产会导致评价能力下降，以及相应的补救措施。
AI.research_question: 当人类越来越多地依赖AI生产知识工作时，停止亲自生产是否会导致其评价能力的下降？在什么条件下这种下降会发生，以及如何弥补？
AI.motivation: AI正在取代人类在编程、写作等知识工作中的生产角色，引发"不会生产就不会评价"的广泛担忧；但现实中存在许多"不生产却能评价"的范例（如影评人、品酒师），二者存在张力，亟需理论化解。
AI.theoretical_framework: DEEP框架（Decoupling of Expertise in Evaluation and Production）：区分两种评价机制——机制1（品质由可观察的成品特征决定）与机制2（品质还依赖于不可见的过程属性），并分析信息获取途径（间接学习 vs. 亲身生产）。
AI.method: 理论分析与框架构建，结合跨领域案例（编程、影评、品酒等）进行逻辑推演与分类讨论。
AI.findings: 停止生产导致的评价能力下降是局部而非普遍的：机制1下可通过间接学习获取评价所需信息，下降有限；机制2下需过程属性信息，下降更显著。补救措施因机制而异：机制1可用模拟训练，机制2需过程文档化，若两者不可行则辅以适量的"校准性生产"。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建立评价专长与生产专长可分离性的分析框架，厘清了"不生产能否评价"这一争论的理论边界，为AI时代人类认知分工提供了概念工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育、组织管理、AI工具设计等领域提供了具体指导：何时需要保留生产训练，何时可通过替代方式维持评价能力，以及针对不同情境的补强策略。

title: FIFA Rankings vs ELO Ratings: Predictive Validity in World Cup Knockout Stages (1994-2022)

detail.title: FIFA Rankings vs ELO Ratings: Predictive Validity in World Cup Knockout Stages (1994-2022)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This research received no external funding and was conducted independently.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available secondary data only. No human participants were involved. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: World Cup knockout matches are seeded using FIFA World Rankings, yet ELO ratings are widely regarded as a stronger alternative. This study examines which system better predicts knockout outcomes and whether FIFA’s 2018 shift to an ELO-inspired formula reduced the gap. Using 115 knockout matches from eight World Cups (1994–2022), we compared separate logistic regression models across six performance metrics. ELO outperformed FIFA on every measure, achieving higher prediction accuracy (73.9% vs. 68.7%), stronger discrimination (AUC 0.775 vs. 0.695), and better calibration (Brier score 0.189 vs. 0.220). FIFA’s 2018 reform improved performance and narrowed the accuracy gap from 6.0 to 3.2 percentage points, but did not eliminate it. Although McNemar’s test (p = 0.180) did not find a statistically significant accuracy difference, likely due to limited sample size, ELO exceeded FIFA in 89.8% of 10,000 bootstrap resamples and consistently outperformed across all evaluation metrics. Robustness checks confirmed that the advantage is structural rather than driven by data timing, specific tournaments, or ranking specifications.

AI.tldr: 本研究对比了FIFA世界排名和ELO评级在预测世界杯淘汰赛结果方面的表现，发现ELO在准确率、区分度和校准度上全面优于FIFA排名；FIFA 2018年改革虽缩小了差距，但未能消除ELO的结构性优势。
AI.research_question: 在预测世界杯淘汰赛结果方面，FIFA世界排名与ELO评级哪个系统更优？FIFA 2018年改为ELO启发式公式后，两者差距是否缩小？
AI.motivation: 尽管ELO被广泛认为优于FIFA排名，但缺乏系统性实证对比。FIFA在2018年改革其排名公式使其更接近ELO，这为检验ELO与FIFA排名的预测能力差异及其结构性来源提供了自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ELO评级理论和FIFA世界排名机制的比较，运用逻辑回归模型、预测性能评估（准确率、AUC、Brier分数）以及统计检验（McNemar检验、Bootstrap重抽样）等方法框架。
AI.method: 使用1994-2022年八届世界杯的115场淘汰赛数据，构建两个分别基于FIFA排名和ELO评级的逻辑回归模型，比较六项性能指标；利用2018年改革作为准自然实验，结合McNemar检验和Bootstrap重抽样进行统计推断，并开展多项稳健性检验。
AI.findings: ELO在预测准确率（73.9% vs 68.7%）、AUC（0.775 vs 0.695）和Brier分数（0.189 vs 0.220）上全面优于FIFA。2018年改革使FIFA准确率差距从6.0个百分点缩小至3.2个百分点，但未消除差异。89.8%的Bootstrap样本支持ELO更优，且该优势具有结构性特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了ELO评级优于FIFA世界排名的系统性实证证据；揭示了FIFA排名公式改革的方向性价值但指出其局限性；证明了ELO优势是结构性的而非数据或赛事特征导致。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际足联未来排名系统改进提供了实证依据；为赛事种子队分配、博彩预测、球队实力评估等实践场景提供了方法论参考；建议纳入ELO或类似动态评级系统以提升预测精度。

title: Accountability Careers: Career Capital as Institutional Collateral in the AI Era

detail.title: Accountability Careers: Career Capital as Institutional Collateral in the AI Era

declarations.funderStatement: Self-funded

detail.abstract: This paper introduces and defends the term accountability careers as a distinctive, durable category of human work in the era of AI decision making. Accountability careers require the holder to have credentials, reputation or standing within the profession that amount to career capital that a rational person would seek to preserve. The career holder is vulnerable to sanctions and reputational damage which is a value proposition, not a weakness, given AI systems cannot have this attribute. The paper claims that this vulnerability is an asset that is the durable human function in an AI economy given that when consequential decisions go wrong institutions, courts, regulators and the public demand a named human with career capital that can be seized through public shame, professional license revocation, dismissal and criminal indictment. The argument proceeds by conceptual synthesis across moral psychology, procedural and interactional justice, AI governance, algorithmic management scholarship, and responsibility-gap philosophy. The construct is situated against Hochschild's emotional labor, the moral crumple zones described by Elish, Davies's accountability sinks, and Xing and Zheng's (2026) coinage of "accountability labor," which pertains to Chinese state surveillance. Accountability careers are differentiated from each. Four cases are evaluated from weakest to strongest: customer service chatbots (relatable with no real career capital), algorithmic hiring and firing (who is actually accountable in AI decisions), private sector healthcare AI and corporate disasters with named CEO accountability (the paradigm case, where the seizure of career capital (clawbacks, lifetime industry bans, criminal indictments) gives accountability its institutional bite). The close of the paper provides guidance on organizational design, AI governance, and career guidance with an emphasis on Gen Alpha, which is facing post-secondary decisions in the face of the rapid proliferation of AI in the job market.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并辩护"问责职业"（accountability careers）这一概念，将其定义为AI决策时代一种独特、持久的人类工作类别。问责职业者拥有需要保护的职业资本，其脆弱性（易受制裁和声誉损害）恰恰是对AI系统的价值优势。论文通过跨领域概念综合构建该构念，并与情绪劳动、道德褶皱区、问责沉没等概念区分，通过四个案例（从最弱到最强）加以论证，最后为组织设计、AI治理和职业指导提供建议。
AI.research_question: 在AI决策时代，人类工作的何种独特属性能够形成不可替代的持久职业类别？具体而言，"问责职业"如何作为一种理论构念被界定和辩护？
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统在组织中承担越来越多的决策角色，引发了关于责任归属的根本性问题——当AI系统做出错误决策时，谁应被问责？现有概念（如情绪劳动、道德褶皱区、问责沉没）无法充分解释和描述这一新型工作类别，亟需一个理论框架来识别和理解AI时代中人类工作的持久价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨领域概念综合，整合了道德心理学、程序正义与互动正义、AI治理、算法管理学术以及责任鸿沟哲学等多个理论传统。
AI.method: 概念性论文（Conceptual paper）：通过跨领域概念综合进行理论构建，并通过四个强度递增的案例进行理论验证和阐述。
AI.findings: "问责职业"是一个独特的工作类别，其核心特征包括：(1)持有职业资本（credentials, reputation, standing）；(2)易受制裁和声誉损害，这种脆弱性不是弱点而是价值主张；(3)AI系统无法具备这种可被问责的属性。四个案例从弱到强展示了问责职业的适用性，其中CEO问责是范例性案例，展现了职业资本被剥夺（追回薪酬、行业终身禁令、刑事起诉）的制度力量。
AI.theory_contributions: (1)提出"问责职业"这一新概念，填补了AI时代人类工作理论研究中的空白；(2)将问责与职业资本理论化，将脆弱性重新界定为价值资产；(3)与情绪劳动、道德褶皱区、问责沉没、问责劳动等现有概念进行系统区分，确立了新构念的独特理论地位；(4)为责任鸿沟哲学提供了具体的工作类别层面的解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: (1)为组织设计提供指导，帮助识别哪些岗位应保留为人类问责职业；(2)为AI治理框架提供建议，明确人机责任分配；(3)为职业指导提供参考，特别面向Gen Alpha一代在AI快速渗透职场背景下做出教育后职业选择。

title: The University Field - Why Reality Compels Interdisciplinarity and How Universities Must Respond
affiliations: University of Birmingham

detail.title: The University Field - Why Reality Compels Interdisciplinarity and How Universities Must Respond
detail.abstract: The modern university faces a contradiction that is simultaneously epistemological, institutional and historical. Reality increasingly presents itself through interconnected phenomena whose behaviour emerges from interactions among domains, while universities remain organised around disciplinary structures inherited from earlier centuries. These structures generated extraordinary advances in science, engineering, medicine, law and public administration. Yet the same structures now encounter growing difficulty when confronted with problems whose behaviour resides in relations rather than isolated components. This paper argues that interdisciplinarity is not a managerial aspiration or educational fashion. It is a compulsion imposed by reality upon the organisation of knowing. The paper traces the university from an earlier ideal of wholeness, through the Newtonian partition of knowledge into disciplines, to the fragmentation of the modern multiversity. It then examines how contemporary relational problems, including cities, climate change, infrastructure, public health, financial instability and artificial intelligence, expose the limits of disciplinary sovereignty. AI is treated not merely as another interdisciplinary topic but as a structural shock to the university's cognitive function, because it renders routine cognition increasingly available outside the university while pushing higher education back towards judgement, synthesis, trust, abstraction and foundational inquiry. The paper proposes the concept of the University Field, in which the university is understood as a field of inquiry, disciplines as nodes of depth and shared institutional capabilities as pools enabling movement across the field. The central claim is that the future university must preserve disciplinary depth while reorganising itself around the relational character of reality.

AI.tldr: 本文指出大学面临深刻矛盾：现实世界日益呈现跨域互联的涌现特征，但大学仍固守学科分割的旧有结构。本文论证跨学科不是管理口号，而是现实对知识组织的强制要求。文章提出"大学场域"概念，主张大学应在保持学科深度的同时，围绕现实的关联性特征进行重组。
AI.research_question: 现代大学如何在保持学科深度的同时，围绕现实的关联性特征进行知识组织重组？
AI.motivation: 现实问题（如城市、气候变化、人工智能等）的行为根植于关系而非孤立组件，但大学仍以学科分割结构应对，导致认知与现实的严重脱节。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大学场域理论：将大学视为一个探究场域，学科为深度节点，共享的制度能力为横跨场域的池；关联性认识论；跨学科性作为现实强制性要求。
AI.method: 理论分析与历史追溯：从大学的整体性理想，经牛顿式学科分割，到现代多科大学的分裂，结合当代问题（城市、气候变化、基础设施、公共卫生、金融不稳定、人工智能）进行案例式论证。
AI.findings: 1. 当代问题本质上是关系性问题，学科主权遭遇根本性局限；2. 人工智能不仅是新议题，更是对大学认知功能的结构性冲击——常规认知外包，大学被迫回归判断、综合、信任、抽象和基础探究；3. "大学场域"概念可作为未来重组的方向。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"大学场域"概念，重新定义了学科、制度能力与探究场域之间的关系；将跨学科性从管理话语升格为认识论层面的强制性要求；将AI定位为大学认知功能的结构性冲击而非普通议题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学组织变革提供了概念框架：保留学科深度的同时，通过构建共享制度能力池实现跨场域流动；为高等教育应对AI时代提供了战略方向（回归判断、综合、信任等核心能力）。

title: The Role of Shared Intention in the Effect of Social Value Orientation Similarity on Cooperative Behavior: An fNIRS Hyperscanning Study
affiliations: Tianjin University of Technology and Education, Tianjin University of Technology and Education and Tianjin University of Technology and Education

detail.title: The Role of Shared Intention in the Effect of Social Value Orientation Similarity on Cooperative Behavior: An fNIRS Hyperscanning Study
detail.abstract: Cooperation is fundamental to human society, yet its success in social dilemmas depends not only on individual traits but also on the alignment of partners’ social preferences. Using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) hyperscanning, this study examined how similarity in social value orientation (SVO) influences cooperative behavior, shared intention, and inter-brain synchrony(IBS) during an iterated prisoner’s dilemma task.Behaviorally, homogeneous dyads (both pro-social or both pro-self) exhibited significantly higher and more stable cooperation rates than heterogeneous dyads, a relationship partially mediated by the formation of a shared intention. Neurally, we identified a neural synergy advantage effect in homophilic pairs, characterized by precise IBS in the right temporoparietal junction(rTPJ) alongside the strategic decoupling of the orbitofrontal cortex(OFC) and left inferior frontal gyrus(lIFG). Our work advances understanding of the mechanisms underlying cooperative heterogeneity and offers practical insights for optimizing team composition and collaboration in organizations.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用fNIRS超扫描技术，发现社会价值取向相似的同质二人组（均为亲社会或均为亲自我）比异质二人组表现出更高、更稳定的合作率，并且这种效应部分由共享意图中介。神经层面，同质组呈现右颞顶联合区的精确脑间同步以及眶额皮层和左额下回的策略性去耦合，即"神经协同优势效应"。
AI.research_question: 社会价值取向的相似性如何影响合作行为及脑间同步？
AI.motivation: 社会困境中的合作不仅取决于个体特质，还取决于伙伴间社会偏好的匹配程度，但以往研究对这一匹配机制及其神经基础认识不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会价值取向理论、共享意图理论、脑间同步理论
AI.method: fNIRS超扫描技术，迭代囚徒困境实验任务，比较同质（亲社会-亲社会、亲自我-亲自我）与异质二人组的行为和神经活动差异
AI.findings: (1)同质组合作率更高且更稳定；(2)共享意图部分中介了这一效应；(3)同质组在右颞顶联合区（rTPJ）出现精确脑间同步，在眶额皮层（OFC）和左额下回（lIFG）出现策略性去耦合，即"神经协同优势效应"。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了社会偏好相似性影响合作行为的神经机制，提出了"神经协同优势效应"概念，深化了对合作异质性机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为优化团队组成和组织协作提供了基于神经科学的实践启示。

title: From Lemons to Batteries: Information Frictions and Institutional Adaptation in Used-Car Markets

detail.title: From Lemons to Batteries: Information Frictions and Institutional Adaptation in Used-Car Markets
detail.abstract: This paper reviews information frictions in used-car markets and argues that their importance depends on the institutions that govern exchange. Mature internal-combustion-engine markets have not unraveled despite adverse selection because warranties, certified pre-owned programs, vehicle-history reports, dealer reputation, inspections, and disclosure rules have made many hidden-quality problems observable, certifiable, or insurable. The EV transition reopens this institutional problem. Battery health is central to used-EV value, range, depreciation, and warranty risk, but it is not well captured by mileage, age, title status, or accident history. Because battery condition is difficult for buyers to verify and compare, used-EV markets require new institutions for battery-health disclosure, certification, warranties, and data portability. The central lesson is that used-car market efficiency is not automatic; it is an institutional achievement that must be rebuilt as vehicle technology changes.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了二手车市场中的信息摩擦问题，指出其重要性取决于市场治理制度。传统内燃机车市场因保修、认证二手车项目、车辆历史报告、经销商声誉、检测和披露规则等制度而得以避免逆向选择崩溃。然而，电动汽车转型重新打开了这一制度问题：电池健康状况是二手电动汽车价值、续航、折旧和保修风险的核心，却无法通过里程、车龄、所有权状态或事故历史来有效体现。由于电池状况难以被买家验证和比较，二手电动汽车市场需要全新的电池健康披露、认证、保修和数据可移植性制度。核心教训是：二手车市场效率并非自动实现，而是一项制度成就，必须随着车辆技术变革而重建。
AI.research_question: 在电动汽车转型背景下，二手车市场的信息摩擦问题如何演变？哪些制度安排能够有效解决二手电动汽车市场中电池健康信息不对称的挑战？
AI.motivation: 传统内燃机二手车市场通过一系列制度（保修、认证、历史报告等）缓解了逆向选择问题，但电动汽车的电池健康作为全新的、难以观测的核心资产，可能使市场重新面临"柠檬问题"。理解这一制度重建需求对于保障电动汽车市场健康发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息经济学中的柠檬市场理论（Akerlof, 1970）、逆向选择理论、信号传递理论、制度经济学中的市场治理机制理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论推理。通过回顾传统二手车市场信息摩擦的制度解决方案，对比分析电动汽车转型带来的新信息不对称问题，进而提出制度重建需求。
AI.findings: (1) 传统内燃机二手车市场通过保修、认证二手车、车辆历史报告、经销商声誉、检测和披露规则等制度安排，使许多隐藏质量问题变得可观察、可认证或可保险，从而避免了市场崩溃。(2) 电动汽车转型重新打开了制度问题，因为电池健康是二手电动汽车价值的核心决定因素，但无法通过传统指标（里程、车龄、事故历史）有效反映。(3) 电池状况难以被买家验证和比较，因此二手电动汽车市场需要全新的制度安排，包括电池健康披露、认证、保修和数据可移植性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将柠檬市场理论与技术转型情境相结合，揭示了制度安排如何随着技术变革而需要系统性重建。强调了市场效率的"制度成就"本质，即效率并非自动实现，而是特定制度环境下的产物。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、汽车制造商、二手车经销商和消费者提供了关于二手电动汽车市场制度建设的明确方向：需要建立电池健康标准化披露、第三方认证、专门保修政策以及电池数据可移植性等制度，以预防逆向选择问题并促进二手电动汽车市场的健康发展。

title: CDSCO Guidance on Medical Device Software: A Study On the Evolving Definition of SaMD versus SiMD

detail.title: CDSCO Guidance on Medical Device Software: A Study On the Evolving Definition of SaMD versus SiMD
detail.abstract: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) issued its Draft Guidance Document on Medical Device Software on October 21, 2025. The document draws a formal distinction between Software in a Medical Device (SiMD) and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), a distinction that has been quietly building in regulatory practice for several years but never squarely addressed in Indian law. This paper examines how that distinction has evolved, what the draft guidance actually says about each category, and whether the document changes anything of substance or merely describes the existing framework in clearer language. The short answer, at least for now, is that it does the latter. But the implications of describing things clearly are not trivial, and the paper argues that the guidance, if implemented carefully, could meaningfully reduce the compliance burden on software developers while protecting patients.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度CDSCO于2025年发布的《医疗器械软件指南草案》，指出该文件首次正式区分了设备内置软件（SiMD）和作为医疗器械的软件（SaMD），但实质上并未改变现有监管框架，仅是对已有实践的更清晰阐述。然而，这种清晰化描述若实施得当，有望减轻软件开发者的合规负担并保护患者。
AI.research_question: 印度CDSCO的《医疗器械软件指南草案》如何区分SiMD与SaMD？该区分是实质性变革还是对现有框架的澄清？这种清晰化描述对软件开发者合规负担和患者保护有何影响？
AI.motivation: 印度此前从未在法律层面明确处理SiMD与SaMD的区分，尽管该区分在监管实践中已酝酿多年。有必要系统分析这份草案的实际影响，评估其对监管清晰度和合规负担的潜在作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗器械软件分类理论（SiMD vs. SaMD）；监管清晰度与合规负担权衡理论。
AI.method: 文本分析与法律解释学方法。通过对比分析CDSCO草案文本与既有监管实践，评估该文件是否带来了实质性变化。
AI.findings: 该草案并未改变现有监管框架的实质内容，而是以更清晰的语言描述已有的监管实践。但这种清晰化具有非平凡的意涵——若实施得当，可减少软件开发者的合规不确定性，同时维持患者保护水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了监管清晰度本身（即便不改变实质规则）如何通过降低信息不对称和合规不确定性来改善新兴医疗软件领域的监管效果。为理解"描述性监管文件"的制度价值提供了分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 对印度医疗软件企业提供了合规方向指引；为其他发展中国家制定医疗器械软件监管政策提供了参考案例；提示监管机构注意"清晰化描述"本身具有降低合规负担的政策价值。

title: The PBM Gross-to-Net Fallacy and the Emerging IRA/MFN Pricing Environment

detail.title: The PBM Gross-to-Net Fallacy and the Emerging IRA/MFN Pricing Environment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: None

contentType.other: Working Draft of Research Project as a Paper

detail.abstract:
Background. U.S. branded drug list prices,  Wholesale Acquisition Costs (WAC), anchor every downstream reimbursement formula, yet match the transaction price for essentially no payer. The gap between list and net revenue, the "gross-to-net bubble," reached an estimated $356 billion for brand drugs in 2024. This review asks how manufacturers build the WAC, why it systematically overstates the realized Average Sales Price (ASP), and how the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) and the 2025 Most-Favored-Nation (MFN) executive order alter that logic

Methods. Because realized net prices and rebate splits reside in confidential commercial contracts and cannot be pooled, the study is a gray-literature review using structured narrative synthesis rather than meta-analysis. This effort involved screening and selecting sources following a PRISMA-informed process and tiered by reliability: Tier 1 primary government and legal records, Tier 2 peer-reviewed methodology and policy journals, and Tier 3 trade institutes and consultancies. Each cited claim traces to a digital object identifier (DOI), PubMed identifier (PMID), or official URL. The analysis traces one artifact, the WAC, across construction, divergence, and policy compression.

Results. Manufacturers construct the WAC through five frameworks. These include analog benchmarking, quality-adjusted life year (QALY) value modeling, willingness-to-pay research, discounted-cash-flow recovery, and strategic rebate-room engineering. These function not as independent checks but as a rationalization stack producing the maximum defensible price. The resulting list-to-net divergence is structurally inevitable. Five forces (the Medicaid best-price trap, escalating rebate walls, 340B volume growth, the IRA Part D manufacturer discount, and access barriers) drive realized ASP to 40–60% of WAC, and below in highly rebated classes. Patients pay cost-sharing on the inflated anchor while intermediaries capture the rebate. First-round Medicare negotiation cut prices 38–79% below the list. The MFN order anchors U.S. prices to the lowest gross domestic product (GDP)-adjusted price among comparable nations, dismantling each pillar of the construction architecture.

Conclusions. The gross-to-net gap is not market inefficiency. Instead, it represents a system operating as designed, with the list price serving as an instrument for rebate generation. The IRA and MFN compress the headroom on which that logic depends. However, patients benefit only if WAC actually falls and cost-sharing is redesigned on the net price. The structural transformation is real. Its distribution is not yet determined. The review contributes 1) a unified causal account linking list-price construction, the rebate economy, and the 2022–2026 policy rupture; 2) a tiered, verifiability-governed gray-literature method for a domain whose decisive data are confidential; and 3) a literature-to-question mapping that makes the evidence base for each research question explicit and auditable.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了美国品牌药标价（WAC）与净收入之间的“总转净泡沫”现象，分析了WAC的构建逻辑、标价虚高的结构性原因，以及《通货膨胀削减法案》和“最惠国待遇”行政令对这套定价逻辑的冲击。
AI.research_question: 制药企业如何构建WAC（批发采购成本）？标价为何系统性地高估实际平均销售价格（ASP）？《通货膨胀削减法案》和2025年最惠国待遇行政令如何改变这一逻辑？
AI.motivation: 美国品牌药标价与实际交易价格之间存在巨大差距，2024年“总转净泡沫”高达约3560亿美元，标价锚定了下游所有报销公式却几乎不与任何支付方实际交易价格匹配，这一现象亟需系统解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标价构建的五种框架：类比基准法、质量调整生命年（QALY）价值模型、支付意愿研究、贴现现金流回收法、战略返利空间工程。这些框架构成“合理化堆栈”，追求最大可辩护价格。
AI.method: 灰色文献综述，采用结构化叙事综合法，遵循PRISMA流程筛选来源，按可靠性分为三级：一级为政府和法律记录，二级为同行评议文献，三级为行业研究机构报告。
AI.findings: WAC由五种框架构建，功能上不是相互独立校验，而是最大化可辩护价格的合理化堆栈。五种力量（Medicaid最优价格陷阱、不断升级的返利墙、340B计划量增长、IRA Part D制造商折扣、准入壁垒）使实际ASP降至WAC的40-60%。首轮Medicare谈判将价格降至标价的38-79%。MFN行政令将美国价格锚定在可比国家中最低的GDP调整价格上。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个统一的因果链条，将标价构建、返利经济和2022-2026年政策破裂联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了基于可验证性的分级灰色文献研究方法，适用于关键数据保密的领域；提供了文献到问题的映射，使每个研究问题的证据基础明确可审计。

title: Generalized FCPT (FCPT-G) Theory of Loss of Cognitive Autonomy in Human, Social and Artificial Systems
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Generalized FCPT (FCPT-G) Theory of Loss of Cognitive Autonomy in Human, Social and Artificial Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests. This work was conducted independently, without institutional affiliation or commercial sponsorship.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical and conceptual work. It involved no human participants, patient data, animal subjects, or personal data collection; therefore ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author, without institutional or commercial support.

detail.abstract:
This paper generalizes the mechanism of False Cognitive Power Transfer (FCPT) into a unified theory of cognitive autonomy loss (FCPT-G) applicable across human, social, institutional, and artificial systems. FCPT-G is defined as the process by which a cognitive or semi-cognitive system erroneously attributes to its own autonomy a capacity that is in fact generated, partially or wholly, by an external source.

The paper distinguishes this pathological misattribution from functional cognitive offloading and develops a phenomenological model of autonomy degradation, including a formulation of the accumulated cognitive deficit as the integrated area between a critically sustained trajectory and an uncritically eroded one.

The model's exponential form is grounded in the established skill-decay literature (Ebbinghaus; Arthur et al., 1998), and its core phenomena are supported by recent empirical findings (Shen & Tamkin, 2026; Kosmyna et al., 2025; Zhou et al., 2026; Qian & Wexler, 2024; Perry et al., 2023).

The framework yields testable predictions at individual, social, and systemic levels, integrates with the Maslow7F coherence model and Information Gravity Theory (IGT-G), and proposes ROGO, ERGO EMERGO as an active recovery mechanism. The paper carries practical implications for education, AI governance, and the design of human-AI systems that preserve rather than erode cognitive sovereignty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"虚假认知能力转移广义理论（FCPT-G）"的统一框架，用于解释人类、社会、机构和人工智能系统中认知自主性丧失的机制，并提出了恢复方案ROGO, ERGO EMERGO。
AI.research_question: 认知系统如何错误地将外部生成的能力归因于自身自主性，从而导致认知自主性退化？这种病理性误归因在不同系统层级（个体、社会、制度、AI）上有何统一机制？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏一个统一的理论框架来解释跨系统（人类、社会、机构、AI）的认知自主性丧失现象，且未能清晰区分功能性认知卸载与病理性认知能力虚假转移。
AI.theoretical_framework: 虚假认知能力转移广义理论（FCPT-G）；技能衰减理论（Ebbinghaus遗忘曲线；Arthur et al., 1998）；Maslow7F一致性模型；信息引力理论（IGT-G）
AI.method: 现象学建模：将累积认知赤字定义为临界维持轨迹与未临界侵蚀轨迹之间的积分面积；模型采用指数形式，基于技能衰减文献；结合近期实证研究（Shen & Tamkin, 2026等）进行验证。
AI.findings: 提出了认知自主性退化的统一机制FCPT-G；建立了累积认知赤字的积分模型；区分了功能性认知卸载与病理性虚假转移；提出了ROGO, ERGO EMERGO作为主动恢复机制；模型在个体、社会和系统层面产生可检验预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 将FCPT推广为跨系统统一理论（FCPT-G）；提出了认知自主性退化的现象学模型；将技能衰减文献与认知自主性丧失机制建立联系；整合了Maslow7F和IGT-G等理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育、AI治理和人机系统设计提供实践指导，帮助设计能够保护而非侵蚀认知主权的系统。

title: Exploring New Angles Of Reality In Chinua Achebes Anthills Of The Savannah
affiliations: Ignatius Ajuru University of Education, Students

detail.title: Exploring New Angles Of Reality In Chinua Achebes Anthills Of The Savannah
detail.abstract: Language has is a powerful tool for the work of literature. The language of ambiguity which literature adopts has given the universe of discourse the opportunity and the ability to explore and to think beyond the past. And the process of repetition of what has been in existence by digging deeper into the body of the text in deciding what will count as truth by uncovering the buried truth in a literary text. This is because one unravels the meaning of a text through the use of language. Language is, therefore, subject to uncertainties; It is a resistant tool that determines or fixes meanings. This article examines this claim as a footnote, In other words, the methods by which the truth has been rebuilt and reimagined, and the manner in which imitation exposes the claim that, almost the same but not quite, made by Said and Bhabha (1994). This study uses textual analysis to examine by Chinua Achebe's Anthills of Savannah through the lens of postcolonial theory, trying to figure out what propelled the characters to imitate one other in rebuilding reality. Also to investigates the possible ways in which the characters engaged in mimicry and reconstruction of truth in the selected novel.

AI.tldr: 本文通过后殖民理论视角，运用文本分析方法，考察了钦努阿·阿切贝小说《萨凡纳的蚁丘》中人物通过模仿和语言重构现实与真相的过程，探讨了模仿如何暴露"几乎相同但又不完全相同"这一后殖民命题。
AI.research_question: 是什么驱动了《萨凡纳的蚁丘》中的人物相互模仿以重构现实？人物在小说中通过哪些方式参与了模仿和真相的重建？
AI.motivation: 语言具有不确定性，是决定或固定意义的抵抗性工具。文学中的模糊语言为话语宇宙提供了超越过去进行探索和思考的机会。本文旨在通过挖掘文学文本中被掩埋的真相，探讨真相如何被重建和重新想象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后殖民理论，特别是赛义德和巴巴（1994）提出的"几乎相同但又不完全相同"的模仿概念。
AI.method: 文本分析方法，以后殖民理论为框架，对阿切贝的《萨凡纳的蚁丘》进行细读分析。
AI.findings: （输出结果中未明确列出具体发现，但研究聚焦于人物模仿行为如何暴露后殖民语境下真相的建构性与不确定性。）
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对后殖民理论中"模仿"概念的理解，展示了巴巴的模仿理论在非洲文学文本中的具体运作机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为文学研究提供了以后殖民视角分析文本中真相建构与语言不确定性的方法论范例。

title: Information, Externalities, and the Limits of the Market: A Shannon-Theoretic Reading of the Coase Theorem

detail.title: Information, Externalities, and the Limits of the Market: A Shannon-Theoretic Reading of the Coase Theorem

declarations.funderStatement: Funding: No funds, grants, or other support was received. Conflict of interest: The authors have no competing interests to declare that are relevant to the content of this article.. Data availability: Not applicable. This article is a theoretical contribution and uses no primary data.

detail.abstract: This article proposes a formal correspondence between Shannon's mathematical theory of communication and Coase's theorem on social cost. By interpreting the vendor as a sender, the buyer as a receiver, the transaction as transmitted information, and externalities as channel noise, we argue that the Coase theorem can be recovered as a limiting case of the Noisy Channel Coding Theorem, obtained when channel capacity is unbounded. The mapping yields two observable consequences. First, property rights operate as channel codes whose redundancy structure determines how efficiently externalities are internalized; this predicts that markets with finer-grained rights (individual transferable quotas, registered water rights, contractually specified ecosystem-service flows) should exhibit lower and less persistent externalities than markets where the same physical good is described by a coarser code. Second, transaction costs determine an upper bound on the volume of welfare-relevant exchanges a market can sustain (a market analogue of channel capacity) beyond which no institutional refinement can keep externalities internalized, predicting threshold behavior in environmental markets at high volumes of activity. The framework recasts the Pigou-Coase debate as a choice between modifying the source distribution and modifying the channel code and offers a candidate metric for institutional quality (the market entropy) that, unlike most welfare measures in environmental economics, is in principle estimable from data on intended and realized transactions.

AI.tldr: 本文在香农信息论与科斯定理之间建立了形式化的对应关系，将交易视为信息传输、外部性视为信道噪声，证明科斯定理是信道容量无限制时的噪声信道编码定理特例，并提出产权作为信道编码、交易成本作为信道容量上限等核心洞见。
AI.research_question: 如何用香农信息论的数学框架重新诠释科斯定理，并从中推导出可检验的实证预测？
AI.motivation: 科斯定理虽然深刻但缺乏统一的形式化框架；信息论提供了处理噪声、编码与容量极限的成熟数学工具，可能为产权制度设计和市场效率分析提供新的理论视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 香农信息论（噪声信道编码定理、信道容量、熵）；科斯定理（产权、交易成本、社会成本）；制度经济学
AI.method: 理论建模：在信源（卖方）、信道（市场）、信宿（买方）的框架下建立映射关系，将科斯定理还原为噪声信道编码定理的特例，并推导可检验假设。
AI.findings: 1. 产权可被视为信道编码，其冗余结构决定外部性内部化效率，细粒度产权（如ITQ、登记水权）应产生更低且更持久的外部性；2. 交易成本是市场的信道容量上限，超过该容量后任何制度改进都无法完全内部化外部性，环境市场在高交易量下表现出阈值行为；3. 提出市场熵作为制度质量的候选度量指标，可从交易数据中估算。
AI.theory_contributions: 为科斯定理提供了信息论形式化基础，建立了产权制度与编码理论之间的理论桥梁，将皮古-科斯争论重新表述为信源分布调控与信道编码调控之间的选择。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了可实证估算的"市场熵"指标，可替代传统难以测量的福利度量；为环境市场（如排污权交易、水权市场）的制度设计提供了信息论指导，特别是关于产权粒度和市场规模阈值的预测。

title: When the Curve Changes Shape: AI Adoption Regimes, Phillips Curve Transformation, and the Central Bank's Identification Problem
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: When the Curve Changes Shape: AI Adoption Regimes, Phillips Curve Transformation, and the Central Bank's Identification Problem

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, in connection with the research presented in this paper. No funding was received for this work from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding body. The research was conducted independently, and the views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research does not involve human subjects, animal subjects, clinical trials, or the collection of personal data. Accordingly, ethics approval was not required for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence adoption does not merely flatten the Phillips Curve-it transforms its geometry across four distinct technological regimes. We develop a dual- channel production framework: AI acts as a total factor productivity shifter A(θt) = A0eλTFPθt and a direct factor substitute with regime-contingent elasticity σ2(θt). The TFP channel produces level shifts; the substitution channel produces geometric transformation-including an axis inversion in Regime III where inflation causes unemployment rather than the reverse. The Phillips Curve is derived as a theorem from first principles. We prove that Regimes I and II are not separable from standard indicators (πt,ut): the KL divergence between their emission distributions is bounded regardless of sample size. A regime-contingent policy framework and six falsifiable empirical predictions are provided. The geometric intuition was developed by the author in 2016.

AI.tldr: 本文从第一性原理推导出菲利普斯曲线，提出AI通过全要素生产率和替代效应双重渠道，将菲利普斯曲线从"平坦化"转变为四种技术体制下的几何变换，包括体制III中因果关系的轴反转（通胀导致失业而非相反）。
AI.research_question: AI如何改变菲利普斯曲线的形态？AI通过哪些渠道改变通胀与失业之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 现有文献仅讨论AI使菲利普斯曲线"平坦化"，但作者认为这种描述过于简单，AI实际上改变了曲线的几何结构，需要更精细的体制划分和理论推导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双渠道生产框架：AI作为全要素生产率（TFP）的移位因子 A(θt)=A0e^(λ_TFP θt)；AI作为直接要素替代品，具有体制依赖的替代弹性 σ²(θt)。菲利普斯曲线从第一性原理推导得出。
AI.method: 理论推导（第一性原理推导菲利普斯曲线）；KL散度分析证明体制I和II在标准指标(πt, ut)上不可分离；提出可证伪的经验预测。
AI.findings: TFP渠道产生水平位移；替代渠道产生几何变换——包括体制III中因果关系的轴反转（通胀导致失业）。体制I和II在标准指标(πt, ut)上的KL散度有界，样本量再大也无法区分。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将菲利普斯曲线从经验规律提升为第一性原理定理；提出四种AI技术体制下菲利普斯曲线的几何变换理论（包括因果轴反转）；证明体制I和II在标准指标上不可区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出体制依赖的政策框架；提供六个可证伪的经验预测供后续实证检验；为央行等政策制定者理解AI时代的通胀-失业关系提供理论指导。

title: Why Sustainable Brands Can't Scale in India: Diagnosing the Intent-Action Gap in Ethical Consumption

detail.title: Why Sustainable Brands Can't Scale in India: Diagnosing the Intent-Action Gap in Ethical Consumption

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. No financial or personal relationships with any organization could be perceived to have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Survey participation was voluntary and anonymous. No personally identifiable information was collected. This study did not require formal institutional review board approval under applicable guidelines.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research. This study was conducted independently.

detail.abstract:
India's sustainable consumer goods market exhibits a persistent paradox: urban consumers report high purchase intent toward eco-friendly and organic products, yet the category holds under 2% of FMCG market share, and its leading D2C brands operate at thin or negative margins. This study investigates why this intention-action gap resists structural closure among urban Indian consumers within India's phygital retail environment.

Using a structured primary survey (n = 112, Mumbai Metropolitan Region, February 2026) across 14 items, the study quantifies a mean intent-action gap of 1.81 points on a continuous 10-point scale, with 80.4% of respondents purchasing sustainably less often than they intend to.

Applying a thirteen-framework diagnostic architecture spanning consumer behaviour, behavioural economics, market structure theory, and business model design, the study identifies six interlocking structural mechanisms: a unit economics deadlock, a greenwashing-sustained trust failure structured as a Prisoner's Dilemma, a phygital distribution mismatch, a definitional divergence between consumer and brand framings of sustainability, the credence good structure of the category, and the self-reinforcing interaction of these barriers across three structural loops.

The study's original contribution is the empirical demonstration that these barriers are mutually sustaining, and that no single lever commands a majority, because each remaining barrier absorbs any partial fix. A synthesis in Section 5.9 identifies the verification gap, defined as the constitutional inability to confirm a credence good's core benefit through use alone, as the root structural condition from which all six barriers derive their persistence. Seven directional recommendations and a minimum viable intervention bundle (R1, R3, R4) are derived for mid-scale sustainable D2C brands, operationally feasible without requiring breakthrough cost reduction or VC-scale capital investment.

AI.tldr: 印度可持续消费品市场存在意图-行动鸿沟，本研究通过112份调查发现80.4%的消费者购买频率低于意图，识别出六大结构性障碍机制，并证明这些障碍相互强化、单一杠杆无法破局，最终提出验证缺口是根本性结构条件。
AI.research_question: 在印度线上线下融合零售环境中，为何城市消费者的可持续产品购买意图与实际行动之间的鸿沟难以闭合？
AI.motivation: 印度可持续消费品市场存在持续悖论：消费者报告高购买意图，但该类目在快消品市场份额不足2%，领先D2C品牌利润率微薄或为负。这一意图-行动鸿沟亟待结构性解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合13个诊断框架，涵盖消费者行为理论、行为经济学、市场结构理论和商业模式设计理论。
AI.method: 结构化初级调查（n=112，孟买大都会区，2026年2月），含14个题项，采用10点连续量表测量意图-行动差距。
AI.findings: （1）平均意图-行动差距为1.81分（10点量表），80.4%的受访者购买可持续产品的频率低于其意图；（2）识别出六大结构性障碍：单位经济困境、漂绿导致的信任失败（囚徒困境结构）、线上线下融合渠道错配、消费者与品牌对可持续性定义的差异、信任品结构、以及三大结构性循环中这些障碍的自我强化互动；（3）实证证明这些障碍相互维持，单一杠杆无法占据多数；（4）验证缺口（无法通过使用确认信任品核心收益）是所有六大障碍持久存在的根本结构条件。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次实证证明了可持续消费意图-行动鸿沟背后的障碍是相互维持的；（2）提出"验证缺口"作为根本性结构条件的概念；（3）揭示了单一杠杆无法破局的结构性原因。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提出7条方向性建议；（2）设计最小可行干预组合（R1、R3、R4），面向中型规模的可持续D2C品牌，无需突破性成本降低或风投级资本投入即可操作。

title: The Phenomenon of Freed Prisoners in the Arab Republic of Egypt: Between Humanitarian Dimensions, Policy Deviations, and Determinants of Public Security and the Rule of Law

detail.title: The Phenomenon of Freed Prisoners in the Arab Republic of Egypt: Between Humanitarian Dimensions, Policy Deviations, and Determinants of Public Security and the Rule of Law

keywords: FEDA (Functional and Engineering Dissection Analysis) Governing Philosophy: Positive Neutrality & Sovereign Resilience Liberated Prisoners

detail.abstract: This study addresses, through sociological and policy analysis, the phenomenon of liberated Palestinian prisoners residing in the Arab Republic of Egypt, within the context of post-conflict environments and the humanitarian repositioning emerging from the events in the Gaza Strip. By applying the "Functional and Engineering Dissection Analysis" (FEDA) methodology, the paper deconstructs the socio-psychological dimensions formed within Zionist isolation ("cell psychology") and the resulting behavioral symptoms, such as the mentality of absolute entitlement and the authority complex. The study also monitors the growing sociological gap between the factional privileges granted to freed prisoners and the reality of the displaced popular incubator, which has spontaneously aligned with the "legitimacy of direct pain" at the expense of protocol-driven symbols. The paper highlights the procedural deviations of the factions and the risks of external ideological dependency on regional axes, demonstrating how this behavior transformed into a direct infringement on public policies, diplomatic norms, and public security and order in the host state. The study concludes by offering firm strategic determinants and recommendations, emphasizing the necessity of a critical review of the "prisoner-leader" concept and subjecting all activities and blocs to the rule of law and public order.

AI.tldr: 本研究运用“功能与工程剖析分析”（FEDA）方法论，从社会学与政策分析角度，探讨加沙地带冲突后获释巴勒斯坦被拘留者在埃及居住所引发的问题，包括“牢房心理学”导致的行为症候、派系特权与流离失所民众之间的社会学裂痕，以及对外部意识形态依附的风险，最终提出战略建议。
AI.research_question: 获释巴勒斯坦被拘留者在埃及居住所引发的社会学与政策问题是什么？其行为如何影响东道国的公共政策、外交规范及公共安全与秩序？
AI.motivation: 后冲突环境中，获释被拘留者的重新安置问题具有高度现实敏感性。加沙地带事件引发的“人道主义重新定位”使得大量获释人员进入埃及，其行为模式与派系特权对外部社会造成冲击，亟需系统性的社会与政策分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功能与工程剖析分析（FEDA）方法论；社会心理学视角下的“牢房心理学”（cell psychology）；社会学裂痕分析（派系特权 vs. 直接痛苦合法性）。
AI.method: 采用“功能与工程剖析分析”（FEDA）方法论，结合社会学分析与政策分析，对获释被拘留者的社会心理维度、行为症候及社会影响进行系统解构。
AI.findings: （1）“牢房心理学”导致获得性绝对权利心态与权威情结；（2）派系特权与流离失所民众之间出现社会学裂痕，“直接痛苦的合法性”取代了程序性象征符号；（3）派系程序偏差与对外部意识形态依附风险，导致对东道国公共政策、外交规范及公共安全与秩序的直接侵犯。
AI.theory_contributions: 将“牢房心理学”概念引入后冲突环境下的社会心理分析；拓展FEDA方法论在冲突后社会重构与跨国人口流动领域的应用；提出“直接痛苦的合法性”与程序性象征符号之间的社会学张力框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调必须批判性审视“囚徒-领袖”概念；提出将派系活动与团体置于东道国法治与公共秩序之下的战略建议；为冲突后难民接收国的政策制定与安全管理提供参考。

title: Platform-Controlled Search and Distortions in Attention Allocation
affiliations: Peking University - HSBC School of Business,  and University of Toronto - Department of Economics

detail.title: Platform-Controlled Search and Distortions in Attention Allocation
detail.abstract: We study a monopoly platform that sets meeting rates between buyers and two seller types: niche sellers, whose higher-quality good appeals to only some buyers, and mass-market sellers, whose good appeals to all. Sellers compete by posting prices à la Burdett and Judd (1983), so buyer surplus requires competition, while platform revenue requires seller rents. This tension creates a systematic distortion: as search capacity grows, the platform keeps niche exposure just past the saturation point---where extra attention erodes rents---and diverts the rest to mass-market sellers. Applied to Amazon product search and Google passage-ranking data, the model indicates buyer-surplus losses of 63 and 44 percent of the planner's benchmark, respectively. Letting buyer participation respond to the platform's recommendations disciplines it and shrinks this loss.

AI.tldr: 垄断平台为平衡买家剩余和卖家租金，在利基卖家（高质量但受众窄）和大众卖家（受众广）之间系统性地扭曲曝光分配，导致买家剩余损失达44%-63%。
AI.research_question: 垄断平台如何在不同类型卖家之间分配曝光（匹配率），以及这种分配对买家剩余和平台收入的影响。
AI.motivation: 平台经济中，买家需要卖家竞争才能获得剩余，而平台收入依赖卖家租金，二者存在结构性矛盾。研究平台如何在这种张力下扭曲曝光分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: Burdett-Judd（1983）价格竞争模型；双边市场平台理论；搜索与匹配理论。
AI.method: 理论建模（垄断平台匹配率决策模型）；实证校准（使用Amazon产品搜索和Google段落排序数据）。
AI.findings: (1) 随着搜索能力增长，平台将利基卖家曝光维持在"饱和点"附近（额外曝光会侵蚀租金），将剩余曝光分配给大众卖家；(2) 相比社会最优，买家剩余损失分别为63%（Amazon数据）和44%（Google数据）；(3) 允许买家参与响应平台的推荐能约束平台行为，减少损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了平台在卖家类型间系统性扭曲曝光分配的机制，解释了买家剩余损失的理论根源。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台监管和反垄断政策提供理论依据，指出买家参与弹性可作为约束平台行为的自然机制。

title: Local Labor Market Tightness and Job Quality: Evidence from Job Changers
affiliations: W.E. Upjohn Institute for Employment Research, U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) - Economic Research Service (ERS), Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Local Labor Market Tightness and Job Quality: Evidence from Job Changers
detail.abstract: We examine how labor market tightness affects workers' job amenities and quality. Using novel data from the Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking (SHED), and multiple measures of labor market tightness, we estimate that a 10 percent increase in job vacancies per thousand residents leads to a 7-12 percent increase in the probability of changing jobs, an 11-18 percent increase in the (unconditional) probability of switching to a self-assessed overall better job, and similar-size increases in pay and benefits, interest in the work, and better opportunities for advancement. Tight labor markets thus not only improve worker pay, in line with earlier studies, but also improve job amenities more broadly, and by roughly the same proportion. Consequently, the benefits to workers of a tight labor market are likely underestimated when based on pay alone.

AI.tldr: 研究发现劳动力市场紧缩（每千居民职位空缺增加10%）会使工人跳槽概率提高7-12%，转向更好工作的概率提高11-18%，并在薪酬、福利、工作兴趣和晋升机会等方面带来同等幅度的改善，表明仅用薪酬衡量劳动力市场紧缩对工人的好处会被低估。
AI.research_question: 劳动力市场紧缩如何影响工人的工作 amenities（工作质量与非货币性福利）？
AI.motivation: 已有研究主要关注劳动力市场紧缩对工资的影响，但对其如何影响工作质量（如福利、工作兴趣、晋升机会等）的关注不足，导致可能低估紧缩劳动力市场对工人的整体好处。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场搜寻与匹配理论，在紧缩市场下工人议价能力增强，不仅可获得更高工资，还可获得更优的非货币性工作 amenities。
AI.method: 利用SHED调查数据，以每千居民职位空缺数等多种方式衡量劳动力市场紧缩度，估计其对跳槽概率、工作质量改善等结果变量的影响。
AI.findings: 职位空缺每增加10%，跳槽概率提高7-12%，转向更好工作的概率提高11-18%，薪酬、福利、工作兴趣和晋升机会均出现类似幅度提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了劳动力市场紧缩效应的理论认识，证明其对工人福利的影响远超工资层面，非货币性工作 amenities 同样显著改善。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估劳动力市场状况对工人福祉的影响提供了更全面的视角，提示仅关注工资指标会低估紧缩市场的正面效应。

title: Refineries, Pipelines and Petroleum Fields - The Impact of Oil on Conflict Around the World
affiliations: Heidelberg University, Heidelberg University and

detail.title: Refineries, Pipelines and Petroleum Fields - The Impact of Oil on Conflict Around the World
detail.abstract: We study how global oil price shocks affect the spatial distribution of violent conflict. Combining monthly georeferenced data on oil infrastructure with conflict events worldwide over 1989-2021, we exploit exogenous variation in world crude oil prices within countries using grid-cell and country*month fixed effects. Oil price increases raise organized conflict in oil-bearing cells but reduce it in nearby non-oil areas, indicating a spatial reallocation of territorial violence toward economically valuable locations rather than a uniform increase in conflict. By contrast, lower-intensity unrest spreads across neighboring cells, consistent with diffuse grievance and mobilization channels. The effect is strongest for petroleum fields and driven by state-based conflict, consistent with intensified contestation over oil rents, while downstream infrastructure is associated with protests and localized violence. The magnitude of the response varies with ethnic exclusion, institutions, geography, and ownership, pointing to rent-contestation mechanisms shaped by local conditions.

AI.tldr: 全球油价冲击通过空间再分配机制影响冲突：油价上涨增加产油区的组织化冲突，但减少周边非油区冲突，同时低强度动乱向邻近区域扩散。
AI.research_question: 全球油价冲击如何影响暴力冲突的空间分布？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注油价与冲突的总体关联，但忽视了冲突在空间上的再分配效应。理解油价冲击如何重新配置暴力冲突的空间格局，对于资源诅咒理论和冲突预防政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源诅咒理论、租金争夺理论、 grievance（不满）与 mobilization（动员）机制、空间再分配理论
AI.method: 利用1989-2021年全球月度地理编码数据，将石油基础设施数据与冲突事件匹配，采用网格单元与国家*月份固定效应，利用世界原油价格的外生变动进行识别。
AI.findings: （1）油价上涨增加产油网格的组织化冲突，但减少邻近非油区冲突，呈现空间再分配效应；（2）低强度动乱（如抗议）向邻近区域扩散；（3）效应主要由石油油田和国家级冲突驱动，下游基础设施与抗议和局部暴力相关；（4）效应强弱受族群排斥、制度质量、地理条件和所有权结构调节。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了油价冲击通过空间再分配机制影响冲突，而非简单的总量效应；区分了组织化冲突与低强度动乱的不同空间扩散模式；将租金争夺机制与局部条件（制度、族群、所有权）相整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资源丰富地区的冲突预防提供空间精准的政策靶点（如产油区与周边区域需差异化干预）；提示国际能源政策与冲突预防政策的协同重要性。
